13940.label: Psalms 1:1
13940.text: Happy is the man that has not walked in the counsel of the wicked ones, And in the way of sinners has not stood, And in the seat of ridiculers has not sat.

13941.label: Psalms 1:2
13941.text: But his delight is in the law of Jehovah, And in his law he reads in an undertone day and night.

13942.label: Psalms 1:3
13942.text: And he will certainly become like a tree planted by streams of water, That gives its own fruit in its season And the foliage of which does not wither, And everything he does will succeed.

13943.label: Psalms 1:4
13943.text: The wicked are not like that,But are like the chaff that the wind drives away.

13944.label: Psalms 1:5
13944.text: That is why the wicked ones will not stand up in the judgment, Nor sinners in the assembly of righteous ones.

13945.label: Psalms 1:6
13945.text: For Jehovah is taking knowledge of the way of righteous ones, But the very way of wicked ones will perish.

13946.label: Psalms 2:1
13946.text: Why have the nations been in tumult And the national groups themselves kept muttering an empty thing?

13947.label: Psalms 2:2
13947.text: The kings of earth take their stand And high officials themselves have massed together as one Against Jehovah and against his anointed one,

13948.label: Psalms 2:3
13948.text: [Saying:] “Let us tear their bands apart And cast their cords away from us!”

13949.label: Psalms 2:4
13949.text: The very One sitting in the heavens will laugh;Jehovah himself will hold them in derision.

13950.label: Psalms 2:5
13950.text: At that time he will speak to them in his anger And in his hot displeasure he will disturb them,

13951.label: Psalms 2:6
13951.text: [Saying:] “I, even I, have installed my king Upon Zion, my holy mountain.”

13952.label: Psalms 2:7
13952.text: Let me refer to the decree of Jehovah;He has said to me: “You are my son; I, today, I have become your father.

13953.label: Psalms 2:8
13953.text: Ask of me, that I may give nations as your inheritance And the ends of the earth as your own possession.

13954.label: Psalms 2:9
13954.text: You will break them with an iron scepter, As though a potter’s vessel you will dash them to pieces.”

13955.label: Psalms 2:10
13955.text: And now, O kings, exercise insight;Let yourselves be corrected, O judges of the earth.

13956.label: Psalms 2:11
13956.text: Serve Jehovah with fear And be joyful with trembling.

13957.label: Psalms 2:12
13957.text: Kiss the son, that He may not become incensedAnd YOU may not perish [from] the way, For his anger flares up easily. Happy are all those taking refuge in him.

13959.label: Psalms 3:1
13959.text: O Jehovah, why have my adversaries become many? Why are many rising up against me?

13960.label: Psalms 3:2
13960.text: Many are saying of my soul:“There is no salvation for him by God.” Seʹlah.

13961.label: Psalms 3:3
13961.text: And yet you, O Jehovah, are a shield about me, My glory and the One lifting up my head.

13962.label: Psalms 3:4
13962.text: With my voice I shall call to Jehovah himself,And he will answer me from his holy mountain. Seʹlah.

13963.label: Psalms 3:5
13963.text: As for me, I will lie down that I may sleep;I shall certainly awake, for Jehovah himself keeps supporting me.

13964.label: Psalms 3:6
13964.text: I shall not be afraid of ten thousands of peopleWho have set themselves in array against me round about.

13965.label: Psalms 3:7
13965.text: Do arise, O Jehovah! Save me, O my God! For you will have to strike all my enemies on the jaw. The teeth of wicked ones you will have to break.

13966.label: Psalms 3:8
13966.text: Salvation belongs to Jehovah. Your blessing is upon your people. Seʹlah.

13968.label: Psalms 4:1
13968.text: When I call, answer me, O my righteous God. In the distress you must make broad space for me.Show me favor and hear my prayer.

13969.label: Psalms 4:2
13969.text: YOU sons of men, how long must my glory be for insult,[While] YOU keep loving empty things,[While] YOU keep seeking to find a lie? Seʹlah.

13970.label: Psalms 4:3
13970.text: So take knowledge that Jehovah will certainly distinguish his loyal one; Jehovah himself will hear when I call to him.

13971.label: Psalms 4:4
13971.text: BE agitated, but do not sin. Have YOUR say in YOUR heart, upon YOUR bed, and keep silent. Seʹlah.

13972.label: Psalms 4:5
13972.text: Sacrifice the sacrifices of righteousness, And trust in Jehovah.

13973.label: Psalms 4:6
13973.text: There are many saying: “Who will show us good?”Lift up the light of your face upon us, O Jehovah.

13974.label: Psalms 4:7
13974.text: You will certainly give a rejoicing in my heart Greater than in the time when their grain and their new wine have abounded.

13975.label: Psalms 4:8
13975.text: In peace I will both lie down and sleep, For you yourself alone, O Jehovah, make me dwell in security.

13977.label: Psalms 5:1
13977.text: To my sayings do give ear, O Jehovah;Do understand my sighing.

13978.label: Psalms 5:2
13978.text: Do pay attention to the sound of my cry for help, O my King and my God, because to you I pray.

13979.label: Psalms 5:3
13979.text: O Jehovah, in the morning you will hear my voice; In the morning I shall address myself to you and be on the watch.

13980.label: Psalms 5:4
13980.text: For you are not a God taking delight in wickedness; No one bad may reside for any time with you.

13981.label: Psalms 5:5
13981.text: No boasters may take their stand in front of your eyes. You do hate all those practicing what is hurtful;

13982.label: Psalms 5:6
13982.text: You will destroy those speaking a lie. A man of bloodshed and deception Jehovah detests.

13983.label: Psalms 5:7
13983.text: As for me, in the abundance of your loving-kindness I shall come into your house, I shall bow down toward your holy temple in fear of you.

13984.label: Psalms 5:8
13984.text: O Jehovah, lead me in your righteousness by reason of my foes; Make your way smooth before me.

13985.label: Psalms 5:9
13985.text: For in their mouth there is nothing trustworthy; Their inward part is adversity indeed. Their throat is an opened burial place; A smooth tongue they use.

13986.label: Psalms 5:10
13986.text: God will certainly hold them guilty; They will fall due to their own counsels. In the multitude of their transgressions let there be a dispersing of them, Because they have rebelled against you.

13987.label: Psalms 5:11
13987.text: But all those taking refuge in you will rejoice; To time indefinite they will cry out joyfully. And you will block approach to them,And those loving your name will exult in you.

13988.label: Psalms 5:12
13988.text: For you yourself will bless anyone righteous, O Jehovah;As with a large shield, with approval you will surround them.

13990.label: Psalms 6:1
13990.text: O Jehovah, do not in your anger reprove me, And do not in your rage correct me.

13991.label: Psalms 6:2
13991.text: Show me favor, O Jehovah, for I am fading away. Heal me, O Jehovah, for my bones have been disturbed.

13992.label: Psalms 6:3
13992.text: Yes, my own soul has been very much disturbed; And you, O Jehovah—how long?

13993.label: Psalms 6:4
13993.text: Do return, O Jehovah, do rescue my soul; Save me for the sake of your loving-kindness.

13994.label: Psalms 6:5
13994.text: For in death there is no mention of you; In Sheʹol who will laud you?

13995.label: Psalms 6:6
13995.text: I have grown weary with my sighing; All night long I make my couch swim; With my tears I make my own divan overflow.

13996.label: Psalms 6:7
13996.text: From vexation my eye has become weak, It has grown old because of all those showing hostility to me.

13997.label: Psalms 6:8
13997.text: Get away from me, all YOU practicers of what is hurtful, For Jehovah will certainly hear the sound of my weeping.

13998.label: Psalms 6:9
13998.text: Jehovah will indeed hear my request for favor; Jehovah himself will accept my own prayer.

13999.label: Psalms 6:10
13999.text: All my enemies will be very much ashamed and disturbed;They will turn back, they will be ashamed instantly.

14001.label: Psalms 7:1
14001.text: O Jehovah my God, in you I have taken refuge. Save me from all those persecuting me and deliver me,

14002.label: Psalms 7:2
14002.text: That no one may tear my soul to pieces as a lion does, Snatching [me] away when there is no deliverer.

14003.label: Psalms 7:3
14003.text: O Jehovah my God, if I have done this, If there exists any injustice in my hands,

14004.label: Psalms 7:4
14004.text: If I have repaid the one rewarding me with what is bad, Or [if] I have despoiled anyone showing hostility to me without success,

14005.label: Psalms 7:5
14005.text: Let an enemy pursue my soul And let him overtake and trample my life down to the very earthAnd cause my own glory to reside in the dust itself. Seʹlah.

14006.label: Psalms 7:6
14006.text: Do arise, O Jehovah, in your anger; Lift yourself up at the outbursts of fury of those showing hostility to me, And do awake for me, [since] you have given command for judgment itself.

14007.label: Psalms 7:7
14007.text: And let the very assembly of national groups surround you,And against it do you return on high.

14008.label: Psalms 7:8
14008.text: Jehovah himself will pass sentence on the peoples. Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness And according to my integrity in me.

14009.label: Psalms 7:9
14009.text: Please, may the badness of wicked ones come to an end, And may you establish the righteous one; And God as righteous is testing out heart and kidneys.

14010.label: Psalms 7:10
14010.text: The shield for me is upon God, a Savior of those upright in heart.

14011.label: Psalms 7:11
14011.text: God is a righteous Judge, And God is hurling denunciations every day.

14012.label: Psalms 7:12
14012.text: If anyone will not return, His sword he will sharpen, His bow he will certainly bend, and he will make it ready [for shooting].

14013.label: Psalms 7:13
14013.text: And for himself he must prepare the instruments of death; His arrows he will make flaming ones.

14014.label: Psalms 7:14
14014.text: Look! There is one that is pregnant with what is hurtful, And he has conceived trouble and is bound to give birth to falsehood.

14015.label: Psalms 7:15
14015.text: A pit he has excavated, and he proceeded to dig it; But he will fall into the hole [that] he went making.

14016.label: Psalms 7:16
14016.text: His trouble will return upon his own head, And upon the crown of his head his own violence will descend.

14017.label: Psalms 7:17
14017.text: I shall laud Jehovah according to his righteousness, And I will make melody to the name of Jehovah the Most High.

14019.label: Psalms 8:1
14019.text: O Jehovah our Lord, how majestic your name is in all the earth, You whose dignity is recounted above the heavens!

14020.label: Psalms 8:2
14020.text: Out of the mouth of children and sucklings you have founded strength, On account of those showing hostility to you, So as to make the enemy and the one taking his vengeance desist.

14021.label: Psalms 8:3
14021.text: When I see your heavens, the works of your fingers, The moon and the stars that you have prepared,

14022.label: Psalms 8:4
14022.text: What is mortal man that you keep him in mind, And the son of earthling man that you take care of him?

14023.label: Psalms 8:5
14023.text: You also proceeded to make him a little less than godlike ones, And with glory and splendor you then crowned him.

14024.label: Psalms 8:6
14024.text: You make him dominate over the works of your hands; Everything you have put under his feet:

14025.label: Psalms 8:7
14025.text: Small cattle and oxen, all of them, And also the beasts of the open field,

14026.label: Psalms 8:8
14026.text: The birds of heaven and the fish of the sea, Anything passing through the paths of the seas.

14027.label: Psalms 8:9
14027.text: O Jehovah our Lord, how majestic your name is in all the earth!

14029.label: Psalms 9:1
14029.text: I will laud [you], O Jehovah, with all my heart; I will declare all your wonderful works.

14030.label: Psalms 9:2
14030.text: I will rejoice and exult in you, I will make melody to your name, O Most High.

14031.label: Psalms 9:3
14031.text: When my enemies turn back, They will stumble and perish from before you.

14032.label: Psalms 9:4
14032.text: For you have executed my judgment and my cause; You have sat on the throne judging with righteousness.

14033.label: Psalms 9:5
14033.text: You have rebuked nations, you have destroyed the wicked one. Their name you have wiped out to time indefinite, even forever.

14034.label: Psalms 9:6
14034.text: O you enemy, [your] desolations have come to their perpetual finish, And the cities that you have uprooted. The very mention of them will certainly perish.

14035.label: Psalms 9:7
14035.text: As for Jehovah, he will sit to time indefinite, Firmly establishing his throne for judgment itself.

14036.label: Psalms 9:8
14036.text: And he himself will judge the productive land in righteousness; He will judicially try national groups in uprightness.

14037.label: Psalms 9:9
14037.text: And Jehovah will become a secure height for anyone crushed, A secure height in times of distress.

14038.label: Psalms 9:10
14038.text: And those knowing your name will trust in you, For you will certainly not leave those looking for you, O Jehovah.

14039.label: Psalms 9:11
14039.text: Make melody, YOU people, to Jehovah, who is dwelling in Zion; Tell among the peoples his deeds.

14040.label: Psalms 9:12
14040.text: For, when looking for bloodshed, he will certainly remember those very ones; He is sure not to forget the outcry of the afflicted ones.

14041.label: Psalms 9:13
14041.text: Show me favor, O Jehovah; see my affliction by those hating me, O you who are lifting me up from the gates of death,

14042.label: Psalms 9:14
14042.text: In order that I may declare all your praiseworthy deeds In the gates of the daughter of Zion, That I may be joyful in your salvation.

14043.label: Psalms 9:15
14043.text: The nations have sunk down into the pit that they have made; In the net that they hid, their own foot has been caught.

14044.label: Psalms 9:16
14044.text: Jehovah is known by the judgment that he has executed. By the activity of his own hands the wicked one has been ensnared. Hig·gaʹion. Seʹlah.

14045.label: Psalms 9:17
14045.text: Wicked people will turn back to Sheʹol, Even all the nations forgetting God.

14046.label: Psalms 9:18
14046.text: For not always will the poor one be forgotten, Nor will the hope of the meek ones ever perish.

14047.label: Psalms 9:19
14047.text: Do arise, O Jehovah! Let not mortal man prove superior in strength. Let the nations be judged before your face.

14048.label: Psalms 9:20
14048.text: Do put fear into them, O Jehovah, That the nations may know that they are but mortal men. Seʹlah.

14049.label: Psalms 10:1
14049.text: Why, O Jehovah, do you keep standing afar off? [Why] do you keep yourself hid in times of distress?

14050.label: Psalms 10:2
14050.text: In his haughtiness the wicked one hotly pursues the afflicted one; They get caught by the ideas that they have thought up.

14051.label: Psalms 10:3
14051.text: For the wicked has praised himself over the selfish longing of his soul, And the one making undue profit has blessed himself;נ [Nun]He has disrespected Jehovah.

14052.label: Psalms 10:4
14052.text: The wicked one according to his superciliousness makes no search; All his ideas are: “There is no God.”

14053.label: Psalms 10:5
14053.text: His ways keep prospering all the time. Your judicial decisions are high up out of his range; As for all those showing hostility to him, he puffs at them.

14054.label: Psalms 10:6
14054.text: He has said in his heart: “I shall not be made to totter; For generation after generation [I shall be] one who is in no calamity.”

14055.label: Psalms 10:7
14055.text: His mouth is full of oaths and of deceptions and of oppression. Under his tongue are trouble and what is hurtful.

14056.label: Psalms 10:8
14056.text: He sits in an ambush of settlements; From concealed places he will kill someone innocent. ע [ʽAʹyin]His eyes are on the lookout for someone unfortunate.

14057.label: Psalms 10:9
14057.text: He keeps lying in wait in the concealed place like a lion in his covert. He keeps lying in wait to carry off some afflicted one by force.He carries off the afflicted one by force when he draws his net shut.

14058.label: Psalms 10:10
14058.text: He is crushed, he bows down,And the army of dejected ones has to fall into his strong [claws].

14059.label: Psalms 10:11
14059.text: He has said in his heart: “God has forgotten. He has concealed his face. He will certainly never see [it].”

14060.label: Psalms 10:12
14060.text: Do arise, O Jehovah. O God, lift up your hand. Do not forget the afflicted ones.

14061.label: Psalms 10:13
14061.text: Why is it that the wicked one has disrespected God? He has said in his heart: “You will not require an accounting.”

14062.label: Psalms 10:14
14062.text: For you yourself have seen trouble and vexation.You keep looking on, to get [them] into your hand. To you the unfortunate one, the fatherless boy, commits [himself].You yourself have become [his] helper.

14063.label: Psalms 10:15
14063.text: Break the arm of the wicked and bad one. May you search after his wickedness [until] you find no more.

14064.label: Psalms 10:16
14064.text: Jehovah is King to time indefinite, even forever. The nations have perished out of his earth.

14065.label: Psalms 10:17
14065.text: The desire of the meek ones you will certainly hear, O Jehovah.You will prepare their heart. You will pay attention with your ear,

14066.label: Psalms 10:18
14066.text: To judge the fatherless boy and the crushed one, That mortal man who is of the earth may no more cause trembling.

14068.label: Psalms 11:1
14068.text: In Jehovah I have taken refuge. How dare YOU men say to my soul:“Flee as a bird to YOUR mountain!”

14069.label: Psalms 11:2
14069.text: For, look! the wicked ones themselves bend the bow, They do make ready their arrow upon the bowstring,To shoot in the gloom at the ones upright in heart.

14070.label: Psalms 11:3
14070.text: When the foundations themselves are torn down, What must anyone righteous do?

14071.label: Psalms 11:4
14071.text: Jehovah is in his holy temple. Jehovah—in the heavens is his throne. His own eyes behold, his own beaming eyes examine the sons of men.

14072.label: Psalms 11:5
14072.text: Jehovah himself examines the righteous one as well as the wicked one, And anyone loving violence His soul certainly hates.

14073.label: Psalms 11:6
14073.text: He will rain down upon the wicked ones traps, fire and sulphur And a scorching wind, as the portion of their cup.

14074.label: Psalms 11:7
14074.text: For Jehovah is righteous; he does love righteous acts. The upright are the ones that will behold his face.

14076.label: Psalms 12:1
14076.text: Do save [me], O Jehovah, for the loyal one has come to an end; For faithful people have vanished from the sons of men.

14077.label: Psalms 12:2
14077.text: Untruth they keep speaking one to the other; With a smooth lip they keep speaking even with a double heart.

14078.label: Psalms 12:3
14078.text: Jehovah will cut off all smooth lips,The tongue speaking great things,

14079.label: Psalms 12:4
14079.text: Those who have said: “With our tongue we shall prevail. Our lips are with us. Who will be a master to us?”

14080.label: Psalms 12:5
14080.text: “Because of the despoiling of the afflicted ones, because of the sighing of the poor ones, I shall at this time arise,” says Jehovah. “I shall put [him] in safety from anyone that puffs at him.”

14081.label: Psalms 12:6
14081.text: The sayings of Jehovah are pure sayings, As silver refined in a smelting furnace of earth, clarified seven times.

14082.label: Psalms 12:7
14082.text: You yourself, O Jehovah, will guard them; You will preserve each one from this generation to time indefinite.

14083.label: Psalms 12:8
14083.text: The wicked ones walk all around,Because vileness is exalted among the sons of men.

14085.label: Psalms 13:1
14085.text: How long, O Jehovah, will you forget me? Forever? How long will you conceal your face from me?

14086.label: Psalms 13:2
14086.text: How long shall I set resistance in my soul,Grief in my heart by day?How long will my enemy be exalted over me?

14087.label: Psalms 13:3
14087.text: Do look [upon me]; answer me, O Jehovah my God.Do make my eyes shine, that I may not fall asleep in death,

14088.label: Psalms 13:4
14088.text: That my enemy may not say: “I have won out over him!”[That] my adversaries themselves may [not] be joyful because I am made to stagger.

14089.label: Psalms 13:5
14089.text: As for me, in your loving-kindness I have trusted; Let my heart be joyful in your salvation.

14090.label: Psalms 13:6
14090.text: I will sing to Jehovah, for he has dealt rewardingly with me.

14092.label: Psalms 14:1
14092.text: The senseless one has said in his heart:“There is no Jehovah.” They have acted ruinously, they have acted detestably in [their] dealing.There is no one doing good.

14093.label: Psalms 14:2
14093.text: As for Jehovah, he has looked down from heaven itself upon the sons of men, To see whether there exists anyone having insight, anyone seeking Jehovah.

14094.label: Psalms 14:3
14094.text: They have all turned aside, they are [all] alike corrupt; There is no one doing good, Not even one.

14095.label: Psalms 14:4
14095.text: Have none of the practicers of what is hurtful got knowledge, Eating up my people as they have eaten bread? They have not called even upon Jehovah.

14096.label: Psalms 14:5
14096.text: There they were filled with a great dread, For Jehovah is among the generation of the righteous one.

14097.label: Psalms 14:6
14097.text: The counsel of the afflicted one YOU people would put to shame,Because Jehovah is his refuge.

14098.label: Psalms 14:7
14098.text: O that out of Zion there were the salvation of Israel! When Jehovah gathers back the captive ones of his people, Let Jacob be joyful, let Israel rejoice.

14100.label: Psalms 15:1
14100.text: O Jehovah, who will be a guest in your tent? Who will reside in your holy mountain?

14101.label: Psalms 15:2
14101.text: He who is walking faultlessly and practicing righteousness And speaking the truth in his heart.

14102.label: Psalms 15:3
14102.text: He has not slandered with his tongue. To his companion he has done nothing bad, And no reproach has he taken up against his intimate acquaintance.

14103.label: Psalms 15:4
14103.text: In his eyes anyone contemptible is certainly rejected, But those fearing Jehovah he honors. He has sworn to what is bad [for himself], and yet he does not alter.

14104.label: Psalms 15:5
14104.text: His money he has not given out on interest, And a bribe against the innocent one he has not taken. He that is doing these things will never be made to totter.

14106.label: Psalms 16:1
14106.text: Keep me, O God, for I have taken refuge in you.

14107.label: Psalms 16:2
14107.text: I have said to Jehovah: “You are Jehovah; my goodness is, not for your sake,

14108.label: Psalms 16:3
14108.text: [But] to the holy ones that are in the earth.They, even the majestic ones, are the ones in whom is all my delight.”

14109.label: Psalms 16:4
14109.text: Pains become many to those [who], when there is someone else, do hurry [after him]. I shall not pour out their drink offerings of blood, And I shall not carry their names upon my lips.

14110.label: Psalms 16:5
14110.text: Jehovah is the portion of my allotted share and of my cup. You are holding fast my lot.

14111.label: Psalms 16:6
14111.text: The measuring lines themselves have fallen for me in pleasant places. Really, [my own] possession has proved agreeable to me.

14112.label: Psalms 16:7
14112.text: I shall bless Jehovah, who has given me advice. Really, during the nights my kidneys have corrected me.

14113.label: Psalms 16:8
14113.text: I have placed Jehovah in front of me constantly. Because [he] is at my right hand, I shall not be made to totter.

14114.label: Psalms 16:9
14114.text: Therefore my heart does rejoice, and my glory is inclined to be joyful. Also, my own flesh will reside in security.

14115.label: Psalms 16:10
14115.text: For you will not leave my soul in Sheʹol. You will not allow your loyal one to see the pit.

14116.label: Psalms 16:11
14116.text: You will cause me to know the path of life. Rejoicing to satisfaction is with your face; There is pleasantness at your right hand forever.

14118.label: Psalms 17:1
14118.text: Do hear what is righteous, O Jehovah; do pay attention to my entreating cry; Do give ear to my prayer without lips of deception.

14119.label: Psalms 17:2
14119.text: From before you may my judgment go forth; May your own eyes behold uprightness.

14120.label: Psalms 17:3
14120.text: You have examined my heart, you have made inspection by night, You have refined me; you will discover [that] I have not schemed. My mouth will not transgress.

14121.label: Psalms 17:4
14121.text: As for the activities of men, By the word of your lips I myself have watched against the paths of the robber.

14122.label: Psalms 17:5
14122.text: Let my steps take hold on your tracks, [In which] my footsteps will certainly not be made to totter.

14123.label: Psalms 17:6
14123.text: I myself do call upon you, because you will answer me, O God. Incline your ear to me. Hear my saying.

14124.label: Psalms 17:7
14124.text: Make your acts of loving-kindnesses wonderful, O Savior of those seeking refugeFrom the revolters against your right hand.

14125.label: Psalms 17:8
14125.text: Keep me as the pupil of the eyeball, In the shadow of your wings may you conceal me,

14126.label: Psalms 17:9
14126.text: Because of the wicked who have despoiled me.The enemies against my soul themselves keep closing in upon me.

14127.label: Psalms 17:10
14127.text: They have enclosed [themselves] with their own fat; With their mouth they have spoken in haughtiness;

14128.label: Psalms 17:11
14128.text: As regards our steps, now they have surrounded us; They fix their eyes to incline to the earth.

14129.label: Psalms 17:12
14129.text: His likeness is that of a lion that yearns to tear to pieces And that of a young lion sitting in concealed places.

14130.label: Psalms 17:13
14130.text: Do rise up, O Jehovah; do confront him to the face; Make him bow down; do provide escape for my soul from the wicked one with your sword,

14131.label: Psalms 17:14
14131.text: From men, [by] your hand, O Jehovah, From men of [this] system of things, whose share is in [this] life, And whose belly you fill with your concealed treasure, Who are satisfied with sons And who do lay up for their children what they leave over.

14132.label: Psalms 17:15
14132.text: As for me, in righteousness I shall behold your face; I will be satisfied when awakening [to see] your form.

14134.label: Psalms 18:1
14134.text: I shall have affection for you, O Jehovah my strength.

14135.label: Psalms 18:2
14135.text: Jehovah is my crag and my stronghold and the Provider of escape for me. My God is my rock. I shall take refuge in him, My shield and my horn of salvation, my secure height.

14136.label: Psalms 18:3
14136.text: On the One to be praised, Jehovah, I shall call, And from my enemies I shall be saved.

14137.label: Psalms 18:4
14137.text: The ropes of death encircled me; Flash floods of good-for-nothing [men] also kept terrifying me.

14138.label: Psalms 18:5
14138.text: The very ropes of Sheʹol surrounded me; The snares of death confronted me.

14139.label: Psalms 18:6
14139.text: In my distress I kept calling upon Jehovah,And to my God I kept crying for help. Out of his temple he proceeded to hear my voice, And my own cry before him for help now came into his ears.

14140.label: Psalms 18:7
14140.text: And the earth began to shake and rock, And the foundations of the mountains themselves became agitated, And they kept shaking back and forth because he had been angered.

14141.label: Psalms 18:8
14141.text: Smoke went up at his nostrils, and fire itself from his mouth kept devouring; Coals themselves blazed forth from him.

14142.label: Psalms 18:9
14142.text: And he proceeded to bend the heavens down and descend. And thick gloom was beneath his feet.

14143.label: Psalms 18:10
14143.text: And he came riding upon a cherub and came flying, And he came darting upon the wings of a spirit.

14144.label: Psalms 18:11
14144.text: He then made darkness his concealment place, All around him as his booth,Dark waters, thick clouds.

14145.label: Psalms 18:12
14145.text: Out of the brightness in front of him there were his clouds that passed by, Hail and burning coals of fire.

14146.label: Psalms 18:13
14146.text: And in the heavens Jehovah began to thunder, And the Most High himself began to give his voice, Hail and burning coals of fire.

14147.label: Psalms 18:14
14147.text: And he kept sending out his arrows, that he might scatter them; And lightnings he shot out, that he might throw them into confusion.

14148.label: Psalms 18:15
14148.text: And the streambeds of waters became visible, And the foundations of the productive land became uncovered From your rebuke, O Jehovah, from the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

14149.label: Psalms 18:16
14149.text: He was sending from on high, he was taking me, He was drawing me out of great waters.

14150.label: Psalms 18:17
14150.text: He was delivering me from my strong enemy, And from those hating me; because they were stronger than I was.

14151.label: Psalms 18:18
14151.text: They kept confronting me in the day of my disaster, But Jehovah came to be as a support for me.

14152.label: Psalms 18:19
14152.text: And he proceeded to bring me out into a roomy place; He was rescuing me, because he had found delight in me.

14153.label: Psalms 18:20
14153.text: Jehovah rewards me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands he repays me.

14154.label: Psalms 18:21
14154.text: For I have kept the ways of Jehovah, And I have not wickedly departed from my God.

14155.label: Psalms 18:22
14155.text: For all his judicial decisions are in front of me, And his statutes I shall not remove from myself.

14156.label: Psalms 18:23
14156.text: And I will prove myself faultless with him, And I shall keep myself from error on my part.

14157.label: Psalms 18:24
14157.text: And let Jehovah repay me according to my righteousness, According to the cleanness of my hands in front of his eyes.

14158.label: Psalms 18:25
14158.text: With someone loyal you will act in loyalty; With the faultless, able-bodied man you will deal faultlessly;

14159.label: Psalms 18:26
14159.text: With the one keeping clean you will show yourself clean; And with the crooked one you will show yourself tortuous;

14160.label: Psalms 18:27
14160.text: Because the afflicted people you yourself will save; But the haughty eyes you will abase.

14161.label: Psalms 18:28
14161.text: For you yourself will light my lamp, O Jehovah; My God himself will make my darkness shine.

14162.label: Psalms 18:29
14162.text: For by you I can run against a marauder band; And by my God I can climb a wall.

14163.label: Psalms 18:30
14163.text: As for the [true] God, perfect is his way; The saying of Jehovah is a refined one. A shield he is to all those taking refuge in him.

14164.label: Psalms 18:31
14164.text: For who is a God besides Jehovah? And who is a rock except our God?

14165.label: Psalms 18:32
14165.text: The [true] God is the One girding me closely with vital energy, And he will grant my way to be perfect,

14166.label: Psalms 18:33
14166.text: Making my feet like those of the hinds, And upon places high for me he keeps me standing.

14167.label: Psalms 18:34
14167.text: He is teaching my hands for warfare, And my arms have pressed down a bow of copper.

14168.label: Psalms 18:35
14168.text: And you will give me your shield of salvation, And your own right hand will sustain me, And your own humility will make me great.

14169.label: Psalms 18:36
14169.text: You will make room large enough for my steps under me, And my ankles will certainly not wobble.

14170.label: Psalms 18:37
14170.text: I shall pursue my enemies and overtake them;And I shall not return until they are exterminated.

14171.label: Psalms 18:38
14171.text: I shall break them in pieces so that they will not be able to rise up; They will fall under my feet.

14172.label: Psalms 18:39
14172.text: And you will gird me with vital energy for warfare;You will make those rising against me collapse under me.

14173.label: Psalms 18:40
14173.text: And as for my enemies, you will certainly give me the back of [their] neck; And as for those hating me intensely, I shall silence them.

14174.label: Psalms 18:41
14174.text: They cry for help, but there is no savior, To Jehovah, but he actually does not answer them.

14175.label: Psalms 18:42
14175.text: And I shall pound them fine like dust before the wind; Like the mire of the streets I shall pour them out.

14176.label: Psalms 18:43
14176.text: You will provide me escape from the faultfinding of the people. You will appoint me the head of the nations. A people that I have not known—they will serve me.

14177.label: Psalms 18:44
14177.text: At mere hearsay they will be obedient to me; Foreigners themselves will come cringing to me.

14178.label: Psalms 18:45
14178.text: Foreigners themselves will fade away,And they will come quaking out from their bulwarks.

14179.label: Psalms 18:46
14179.text: Jehovah is living, and blessed be my Rock, And let the God of my salvation be exalted.

14180.label: Psalms 18:47
14180.text: The [true] God is the Giver of acts of vengeance to me; And he subdues the peoples under me.

14181.label: Psalms 18:48
14181.text: He is providing escape for me from my angry enemies; Above those who rise up against me you will lift me up, From the man of violence you will deliver me.

14182.label: Psalms 18:49
14182.text: That is why I shall laud you among the nations, O Jehovah, And to your name I will make melody.

14183.label: Psalms 18:50
14183.text: He is doing great acts of salvation for his king And exercising loving-kindness to his anointed one, To David and to his seed to time indefinite.

14185.label: Psalms 19:1
14185.text: The heavens are declaring the glory of God; And of the work of his hands the expanse is telling.

14186.label: Psalms 19:2
14186.text: One day after another day causes speech to bubble forth, And one night after another night shows forth knowledge.

14187.label: Psalms 19:3
14187.text: There is no speech, and there are no words;No voice on their part is being heard.

14188.label: Psalms 19:4
14188.text: Into all the earth their measuring line has gone out, And to the extremity of the productive land their utterances. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

14189.label: Psalms 19:5
14189.text: And it is like a bridegroom when coming out of his nuptial chamber; It exults as a mighty man does to run in a path.

14190.label: Psalms 19:6
14190.text: From one extremity of the heavens is its going forth,And its [finished] circuit is to their [other] extremities; And there is nothing concealed from its heat.

14191.label: Psalms 19:7
14191.text: The law of Jehovah is perfect, bringing back the soul. The reminder of Jehovah is trustworthy, making the inexperienced one wise.

14192.label: Psalms 19:8
14192.text: The orders from Jehovah are upright, causing the heart to rejoice; The commandment of Jehovah is clean, making the eyes shine.

14193.label: Psalms 19:9
14193.text: The fear of Jehovah is pure, standing forever.The judicial decisions of Jehovah are true; they have proved altogether righteous.

14194.label: Psalms 19:10
14194.text: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much refined gold; And sweeter than honey and the flowing honey of the combs.

14195.label: Psalms 19:11
14195.text: Also, your own servant has been warned by them; In the keeping of them there is a large reward.

14196.label: Psalms 19:12
14196.text: Mistakes—who can discern? From concealed sins pronounce me innocent.

14197.label: Psalms 19:13
14197.text: Also from presumptuous acts hold your servant back; Do not let them dominate me. In that case I shall be complete, And I shall have remained innocent from much transgression.

14198.label: Psalms 19:14
14198.text: Let the sayings of my mouth and the meditation of my heart Become pleasurable before you, O Jehovah my Rock and my Redeemer.

14200.label: Psalms 20:1
14200.text: May Jehovah answer you in the day of distress. May the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

14201.label: Psalms 20:2
14201.text: May he send your help out of the holy place, And sustain you out of Zion itself.

14202.label: Psalms 20:3
14202.text: May he remember all your gift offerings, And may he accept your burnt offering as being fat. Seʹlah.

14203.label: Psalms 20:4
14203.text: May he give to you according to your heart, And all your counsel may he fulfill.

14204.label: Psalms 20:5
14204.text: We will cry out joyfully because of your salvation, And in the name of our God we shall lift our banners. May Jehovah fulfill all your requests.

14205.label: Psalms 20:6
14205.text: Now I do know that Jehovah certainly saves his anointed one. He answers him from his holy heavens With the saving mighty acts of his right hand.

14206.label: Psalms 20:7
14206.text: Some concerning chariots and others concerning horses, But, as for us, concerning the name of Jehovah our God we shall make mention.

14207.label: Psalms 20:8
14207.text: Those very ones have broken down and fallen; But as for us, we have risen up, that we may be restored.

14208.label: Psalms 20:9
14208.text: O Jehovah, do save the king! He will answer us in the day that we call.

14210.label: Psalms 21:1
14210.text: O Jehovah, in your strength the king rejoices; And in your salvation how very joyful he wants to be!

14211.label: Psalms 21:2
14211.text: The desire of his heart you have given him, And the wish of his lips you have not withheld. Seʹlah.

14212.label: Psalms 21:3
14212.text: For you proceeded to meet him with blessings of good, [And] to place on his head a crown of refined gold.

14213.label: Psalms 21:4
14213.text: Life he asked of you. You gave [it] to him, Length of days to time indefinite, even forever.

14214.label: Psalms 21:5
14214.text: His glory is great in your salvation. Dignity and splendor you put upon him.

14215.label: Psalms 21:6
14215.text: For you constitute him highly blessed forever; You make him feel glad with the rejoicing at your face.

14216.label: Psalms 21:7
14216.text: For the king is trusting in Jehovah, Even in the loving-kindness of the Most High. He will not be caused to totter.

14217.label: Psalms 21:8
14217.text: Your hand will find all your enemies; Your own right hand will find those hating you.

14218.label: Psalms 21:9
14218.text: You will constitute them as a fiery furnace at the appointed time for your attention. Jehovah in his anger will swallow them up, and the fire will devour them.

14219.label: Psalms 21:10
14219.text: Their fruitage you will destroy from the very earth, And their offspring from the sons of men.

14220.label: Psalms 21:11
14220.text: For they have directed against you what is bad; They have thought out ideas that they are unable to carry out.

14221.label: Psalms 21:12
14221.text: For you will make them turn their backs in flight By your bowstrings that you make ready against their face.

14222.label: Psalms 21:13
14222.text: O be exalted in your strength, O Jehovah. We will sing and make melody to your mightiness.

14224.label: Psalms 22:1
14224.text: My God, my God, why have you left me? [Why are you] far from saving me, [From] the words of my roaring?

14225.label: Psalms 22:2
14225.text: O my God, I keep calling by day, and you do not answer; And by night, and there is no silence on my part.

14226.label: Psalms 22:3
14226.text: But you are holy, Inhabiting the praises of Israel.

14227.label: Psalms 22:4
14227.text: In you our fathers trusted; They trusted, and you kept providing them with escape.

14228.label: Psalms 22:5
14228.text: To you they cried out, and they got away safe; In you they trusted, and they did not come to shame.

14229.label: Psalms 22:6
14229.text: But I am a worm, and not a man, A reproach to men and despicable to the people.

14230.label: Psalms 22:7
14230.text: As for all those seeing me, they hold me in derision; They keep opening their mouths wide, they keep wagging [their] head:

14231.label: Psalms 22:8
14231.text: “He committed himself to Jehovah. Let Him provide him with escape! Let him deliver him, since he has taken delight in him!”

14232.label: Psalms 22:9
14232.text: For you were the One drawing me forth from the belly, The One making me trust while upon the breasts of my mother.

14233.label: Psalms 22:10
14233.text: Upon you I have been thrown from the womb; From the belly of my mother you have been my God.

14234.label: Psalms 22:11
14234.text: Do not keep far off from me, because distress is nearby, Because there is no other helper.

14235.label: Psalms 22:12
14235.text: Many young bulls have surrounded me; The powerful ones of Baʹshan themselves have got around me.

14236.label: Psalms 22:13
14236.text: They have opened against me their mouth, As a lion tearing in pieces and roaring.

14237.label: Psalms 22:14
14237.text: Like water I have been poured out, And all my bones have been separated from one another. My heart has become like wax; It has melted deep in my inward parts.

14238.label: Psalms 22:15
14238.text: My power has dried up just like a fragment of earthenware, And my tongue is made to stick to my gums; And in the dust of death you are setting me.

14239.label: Psalms 22:16
14239.text: For dogs have surrounded me; The assembly of evildoers themselves have enclosed me. Like a lion [they are at] my hands and my feet.

14240.label: Psalms 22:17
14240.text: I can count all my bones. They themselves look, they gaze upon me.

14241.label: Psalms 22:18
14241.text: They apportion my garments among themselves, And upon my clothing they cast lots.

14242.label: Psalms 22:19
14242.text: But you, O Jehovah, O do not keep far off. O you my strength, do make haste to my assistance.

14243.label: Psalms 22:20
14243.text: Do deliver from the sword my soul, My only one from the very paw of the dog;

14244.label: Psalms 22:21
14244.text: Save me from the mouth of the lion, And from the horns of wild bulls you must answer [and save] me.

14245.label: Psalms 22:22
14245.text: I will declare your name to my brothers; In the middle of the congregation I shall praise you.

14246.label: Psalms 22:23
14246.text: YOU fearers of Jehovah, praise him! All YOU the seed of Jacob, glorify him! And be frightened at him, all YOU the seed of Israel.

14247.label: Psalms 22:24
14247.text: For he has neither despised Nor loathed the affliction of the afflicted one; And he has not concealed his face from him, And when he cried to him for help he heard.

14248.label: Psalms 22:25
14248.text: From you my praise will be in the large congregation; My vows I shall pay in front of those fearing him.

14249.label: Psalms 22:26
14249.text: The meek ones will eat and be satisfied; Those seeking him will praise Jehovah. May YOUR hearts live forever.

14250.label: Psalms 22:27
14250.text: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn back to Jehovah. And all the families of the nations will bow down before you.

14251.label: Psalms 22:28
14251.text: For the kingship belongs to Jehovah, And he is dominating the nations.

14252.label: Psalms 22:29
14252.text: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and will bow down; Before him all those going down to the dust will bend down, And no one will ever preserve his own soul alive.

14253.label: Psalms 22:30
14253.text: A seed itself will serve him; It will be declared concerning Jehovah to the generation.

14254.label: Psalms 22:31
14254.text: They will come and tell of his righteousness To the people that is to be born, that he has done [this].

14256.label: Psalms 23:1
14256.text: Jehovah is my Shepherd. I shall lack nothing.

14257.label: Psalms 23:2
14257.text: In grassy pastures he makes me lie down; By well-watered resting-places he conducts me.

14258.label: Psalms 23:3
14258.text: My soul he refreshes. He leads me in the tracks of righteousness for his name’s sake.

14259.label: Psalms 23:4
14259.text: Even though I walk in the valley of deep shadow, I fear nothing bad, For you are with me; Your rod and your staff are the things that comfort me.

14260.label: Psalms 23:5
14260.text: You arrange before me a table in front of those showing hostility to me. With oil you have greased my head; My cup is well filled.

14261.label: Psalms 23:6
14261.text: Surely goodness and loving-kindness themselves will pursue me all the days of my life; And I will dwell in the house of Jehovah to the length of days.

14263.label: Psalms 24:1
14263.text: To Jehovah belong the earth and that which fills it, The productive land and those dwelling in it.

14264.label: Psalms 24:2
14264.text: For upon the seas he himself has solidly fixed it, And upon the rivers he keeps it firmly established.

14265.label: Psalms 24:3
14265.text: Who may ascend into the mountain of Jehovah, And who may rise up in his holy place?

14266.label: Psalms 24:4
14266.text: Anyone innocent in his hands and clean in heart, Who has not carried My soul to sheer worthlessness, Nor taken an oath deceitfully.

14267.label: Psalms 24:5
14267.text: He will carry away blessing from Jehovah And righteousness from his God of salvation.

14268.label: Psalms 24:6
14268.text: This is the generation of those seeking him,Of those searching for your face, O [God of] Jacob. Seʹlah.

14269.label: Psalms 24:7
14269.text: Raise YOUR heads, O YOU gates, And raise yourselves up, O YOU long-lasting entrances, That the glorious King may come in!

14270.label: Psalms 24:8
14270.text: Who, then, is this glorious King? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.

14271.label: Psalms 24:9
14271.text: Raise YOUR heads, O YOU gates; Yes, raise [them] up, O YOU long-lasting entrances,That the glorious King may come in!

14272.label: Psalms 24:10
14272.text: Who, then, is he, this glorious King?Jehovah of armies —he is the glorious King. Seʹlah.

14274.label: Psalms 25:1
14274.text: To you, O Jehovah, I raise my very soul.

14275.label: Psalms 25:2
14275.text: O my God, in you have I put my trust; O may I not be ashamed.May my enemies not exult over me.

14276.label: Psalms 25:3
14276.text: Also, none of those hoping in you will be ashamed. They will be ashamed who are dealing treacherously without success.

14277.label: Psalms 25:4
14277.text: Make me know your own ways, O Jehovah; Teach me your own paths.

14278.label: Psalms 25:5
14278.text: Make me walk in your truth and teach me, For you are my God of salvation. ו [Waw] In you I have hoped all day long.

14279.label: Psalms 25:6
14279.text: Remember your mercies, O Jehovah, and your loving-kindnesses, For they are from time indefinite.

14280.label: Psalms 25:7
14280.text: The sins of my youth and my revolts O do not remember. According to your loving-kindness do you yourself remember me, For the sake of your goodness, O Jehovah.

14281.label: Psalms 25:8
14281.text: Good and upright is Jehovah. That is why he instructs sinners in the way.

14282.label: Psalms 25:9
14282.text: He will cause the meek ones to walk in [his] judicial decision, And he will teach the meek ones his way.

14283.label: Psalms 25:10
14283.text: All the paths of Jehovah are loving-kindness and trueness For those observing his covenant and his reminders.

14284.label: Psalms 25:11
14284.text: For your name’s sake, O Jehovah, You must even forgive my error, for it is considerable.

14285.label: Psalms 25:12
14285.text: Who, now, is the man fearful of Jehovah? He will instruct him in the way [that] he will choose.

14286.label: Psalms 25:13
14286.text: His own soul will lodge in goodness itself, And his own offspring will take possession of the earth.

14287.label: Psalms 25:14
14287.text: The intimacy with Jehovah belongs to those fearful of him, Also his covenant, to cause them to know it.

14288.label: Psalms 25:15
14288.text: My eyes are constantly toward Jehovah, For he it is that brings my feet out of the net.

14289.label: Psalms 25:16
14289.text: Turn your face to me, and show me favor; For I am solitary and afflicted.

14290.label: Psalms 25:17
14290.text: Distresses of my heart have multiplied; From the stresses upon me O bring me out.

14291.label: Psalms 25:18
14291.text: See my affliction and my trouble, And pardon all my sins.

14292.label: Psalms 25:19
14292.text: See how many my enemies have become, And with a violent hatred they have hated me.

14293.label: Psalms 25:20
14293.text: Do guard my soul and deliver me. May I not be ashamed, for I have taken refuge in you.

14294.label: Psalms 25:21
14294.text: Let integrity and uprightness themselves safeguard me, For I have hoped in you.

14295.label: Psalms 25:22
14295.text: O God, redeem Israel out of all his distresses.

14297.label: Psalms 26:1
14297.text: Judge me, O Jehovah, for I myself have walked in my own integrity, And in Jehovah I have trusted, that I may not wobble.

14298.label: Psalms 26:2
14298.text: Examine me, O Jehovah, and put me to the test; Refine my kidneys and my heart.

14299.label: Psalms 26:3
14299.text: For your loving-kindness is in front of my eyes,And I have walked in your truth.

14300.label: Psalms 26:4
14300.text: I have not sat with men of untruth; And with those who hide what they are I do not come in.

14301.label: Psalms 26:5
14301.text: I have hated the congregation of evildoers, And with the wicked ones I do not sit.

14302.label: Psalms 26:6
14302.text: I shall wash my hands in innocency itself, And I will march around your altar, O Jehovah,

14303.label: Psalms 26:7
14303.text: To cause thanksgiving to be heard aloud, And to declare all your wonderful works.

14304.label: Psalms 26:8
14304.text: Jehovah, I have loved the dwelling of your house And the place of the residing of your glory.

14305.label: Psalms 26:9
14305.text: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, Nor my life along with bloodguilty men,

14306.label: Psalms 26:10
14306.text: In whose hands there is loose conduct, And whose right hand is full of bribery.

14307.label: Psalms 26:11
14307.text: As for me, in my integrity I shall walk. O redeem me and show me favor.

14308.label: Psalms 26:12
14308.text: My own foot will certainly stand on a level place; Among the congregated throngs I shall bless Jehovah.

14310.label: Psalms 27:1
14310.text: Jehovah is my light and my salvation. Of whom shall I be in fear? Jehovah is the stronghold of my life. Of whom shall I be in dread?

14311.label: Psalms 27:2
14311.text: When the evildoers approached against me to eat up my flesh, They being my adversaries and my enemies personally, They themselves stumbled and fell.

14312.label: Psalms 27:3
14312.text: Though against me an encampment should pitch tent, My heart will not fear. Though against me war should rise, Even then I shall be trusting.

14313.label: Psalms 27:4
14313.text: One thing I have asked from Jehovah —It is what I shall look for, That I may dwell in the house of Jehovah all the days of my life, To behold the pleasantness of Jehovah And to look with appreciation upon his temple.

14314.label: Psalms 27:5
14314.text: For he will hide me in his covert in the day of calamity; He will conceal me in the secret place of his tent; High on a rock he will put me.

14315.label: Psalms 27:6
14315.text: And now my head will be high above my enemies all around me; And I will sacrifice at his tent sacrifices of joyful shouting; I will sing and make melody to Jehovah.

14316.label: Psalms 27:7
14316.text: Hear, O Jehovah, when I call with my voice, And show me favor and answer me.

14317.label: Psalms 27:8
14317.text: Concerning you my heart has said: “Seek to find my face, YOU people.”Your face, O Jehovah, I shall seek to find.

14318.label: Psalms 27:9
14318.text: Do not conceal your face from me. Do not in anger turn your servant away. My assistance you must become. Do not forsake me and do not leave me, O my God of salvation.

14319.label: Psalms 27:10
14319.text: In case my own father and my own mother did leave me, Even Jehovah himself would take me up.

14320.label: Psalms 27:11
14320.text: Instruct me, O Jehovah, in your way, And lead me in the path of uprightness on account of my foes.

14321.label: Psalms 27:12
14321.text: Do not give me over to the soul of my adversaries; For against me false witnesses have risen up, And he who launches forth violence.

14322.label: Psalms 27:13
14322.text: If I had not had faith in seeing the goodness of Jehovah in the land of those alive —!

14323.label: Psalms 27:14
14323.text: Hope in Jehovah; be courageous and let your heart be strong. Yes, hope in Jehovah.

14325.label: Psalms 28:1
14325.text: To you, O Jehovah, I keep calling. O my Rock, do not be deaf to me, That you may not keep still toward me And I do not have to become like those going down to the pit.

14326.label: Psalms 28:2
14326.text: Hear the voice of my entreaties when I cry to you for help,When I raise my hands to the innermost room of your holy place.

14327.label: Psalms 28:3
14327.text: Do not draw me along with wicked people and with practicers of what is hurtful, Those who are speaking peace with their companions but in whose hearts is what is bad.

14328.label: Psalms 28:4
14328.text: Give to them according to their acting And according to the badness of their practices. According to the work of their hands do you give to them. Pay back to them their own doing.

14329.label: Psalms 28:5
14329.text: For they have no regard for the activities of Jehovah, Nor for the work of his hands. He will tear them down and not build them up.

14330.label: Psalms 28:6
14330.text: Blessed be Jehovah, for he has heard the voice of my entreaties.

14331.label: Psalms 28:7
14331.text: Jehovah is my strength and my shield. In him my heart has trusted, And I have been helped, so that my heart exults, And with my song I shall laud him.

14332.label: Psalms 28:8
14332.text: Jehovah is a strength to his people, And he is a stronghold of the grand salvation of his anointed one.

14333.label: Psalms 28:9
14333.text: Do save your people, and bless your inheritance; And shepherd them and carry them to time indefinite.

14335.label: Psalms 29:1
14335.text: Ascribe to Jehovah, O YOU sons of strong ones, Ascribe to Jehovah glory and strength.

14336.label: Psalms 29:2
14336.text: Ascribe to Jehovah the glory of his name. Bow down to Jehovah in holy adornment.

14337.label: Psalms 29:3
14337.text: The voice of Jehovah is over the waters; The glorious God himself has thundered. Jehovah is over many waters.

14338.label: Psalms 29:4
14338.text: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is splendid.

14339.label: Psalms 29:5
14339.text: The voice of Jehovah is breaking the cedars;Yes, Jehovah breaks the cedars of Lebʹa·non in pieces,

14340.label: Psalms 29:6
14340.text: And he makes them skip about like a calf, Lebʹa·non and Sirʹi·on like the sons of wild bulls.

14341.label: Psalms 29:7
14341.text: The voice of Jehovah is hewing with the flames of fire;

14342.label: Psalms 29:8
14342.text: The voice of Jehovah itself makes the wilderness writhe, Jehovah makes the wilderness of Kaʹdesh writhe.

14343.label: Psalms 29:9
14343.text: The voice of Jehovah itself makes the hinds writhe with birth pains And strips bare the forests. And in his temple each one is saying: “Glory!”

14344.label: Psalms 29:10
14344.text: Upon the deluge Jehovah has seated himself; And Jehovah sits as king to time indefinite.

14345.label: Psalms 29:11
14345.text: Jehovah himself will give strength indeed to his people. Jehovah himself will bless his people with peace.

14347.label: Psalms 30:1
14347.text: I shall exalt you, O Jehovah, for you have drawn me up And you have not let my enemies rejoice over me.

14348.label: Psalms 30:2
14348.text: O Jehovah my God, I cried to you for help, and you proceeded to heal me.

14349.label: Psalms 30:3
14349.text: O Jehovah, you have brought up my soul from Sheʹol itself; You have kept me alive, that I should not go down into the pit.

14350.label: Psalms 30:4
14350.text: Make melody to Jehovah, O YOU loyal ones of his, Give thanks to his holy memorial;

14351.label: Psalms 30:5
14351.text: Because being under his anger is for a moment, Being under his goodwill is for a lifetime. In the evening weeping may take up lodging, but in the morning there is a joyful cry.

14352.label: Psalms 30:6
14352.text: As for me, I have said in my ease: “Never shall I be made to totter.”

14353.label: Psalms 30:7
14353.text: O Jehovah, in your goodwill you have made my mountain to stand in strength. You concealed your face; I became one that is disturbed.

14354.label: Psalms 30:8
14354.text: To you, O Jehovah, I kept calling; And to Jehovah I kept making entreaty for favor.

14355.label: Psalms 30:9
14355.text: What profit is there in my blood when I go down to the pit? Will the dust laud you? Will it tell of your trueness?

14356.label: Psalms 30:10
14356.text: Hear, O Jehovah, and show me favor. O Jehovah, prove yourself my helper.

14357.label: Psalms 30:11
14357.text: You have changed my mourning into dancing for me; You have loosened my sackcloth, and you keep me girded with rejoicing,

14358.label: Psalms 30:12
14358.text: In order that [my] glory may make melody to you and not keep silent. O Jehovah my God, to time indefinite I will laud you.

14360.label: Psalms 31:1
14360.text: In you, O Jehovah, have I taken refuge. O may I never be ashamed. In your righteousness provide escape for me.

14361.label: Psalms 31:2
14361.text: Incline to me your ear. Deliver me speedily. Become for me a rocky stronghold, A house of strongholds to save me.

14362.label: Psalms 31:3
14362.text: For you are my crag and my stronghold; And for the sake of your name you will lead me and conduct me.

14363.label: Psalms 31:4
14363.text: You will bring me out of the net that they have hidden for me, For you are my fortress.

14364.label: Psalms 31:5
14364.text: Into your hand I entrust my spirit. You have redeemed me, O Jehovah the God of truth.

14365.label: Psalms 31:6
14365.text: I do hate those paying regard to worthless, vain idols; But as for me, in Jehovah I do trust.

14366.label: Psalms 31:7
14366.text: I will be joyful and rejoice in your loving-kindness, In that you have seen my affliction; You have known about the distresses of my soul,

14367.label: Psalms 31:8
14367.text: And you have not surrendered me into the hand of the enemy. You have made my feet stand in a roomy place.

14368.label: Psalms 31:9
14368.text: Show me favor, O Jehovah, for I am in sore straits. With vexation my eye has become weak, my soul and my belly.

14369.label: Psalms 31:10
14369.text: For with grief my life has come to an end, And my years in sighing. Because of my error my power has stumbled, And my very bones have become weak.

14370.label: Psalms 31:11
14370.text: From the standpoint of all those showing hostility to me I have become a reproach, And to my neighbors very much so, And a dread to my acquaintances. When seeing me out of doors, they have fled from me.

14371.label: Psalms 31:12
14371.text: Like someone dead [and] not in the heart, I have been forgotten; I have become like a damaged vessel;

14372.label: Psalms 31:13
14372.text: For I have heard the bad report by many, Fright being on all sides. When they mass together as one against me, It is to take away my soul that they do scheme.

14373.label: Psalms 31:14
14373.text: But I—in you I have put my trust, O Jehovah. I have said: “You are my God.”

14374.label: Psalms 31:15
14374.text: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies and from those pursuing me.

14375.label: Psalms 31:16
14375.text: Do cause your face to shine upon your servant. Save me in your loving-kindness.

14376.label: Psalms 31:17
14376.text: O Jehovah, may I not be ashamed, for I have called on you. May the wicked ones be ashamed; May they keep silent in Sheʹol.

14377.label: Psalms 31:18
14377.text: May false lips become speechless, That are speaking against the righteous one, unrestrainedly in haughtiness and contempt.

14378.label: Psalms 31:19
14378.text: How abundant your goodness is, which you have treasured up for those fearing you! [Which] you have rendered to those taking refuge in you,In front of the sons of men.

14379.label: Psalms 31:20
14379.text: You will conceal them in the secret place of your person From the banding together of men. You will hide them in your booth from the quarreling of tongues.

14380.label: Psalms 31:21
14380.text: Blessed be Jehovah, For he has rendered wonderful loving-kindness to me in a city under stress.

14381.label: Psalms 31:22
14381.text: As for me, I said when I became panicky: “I shall certainly be exterminated from in front of your eyes.” Surely you have heard the voice of my entreaties when I cried to you for help.

14382.label: Psalms 31:23
14382.text: O love Jehovah, all YOU loyal ones of his. The faithful ones Jehovah is safeguarding, But he is rewarding exceedingly anyone showing haughtiness.

14383.label: Psalms 31:24
14383.text: Be courageous, and may YOUR heart be strong, All YOU who are waiting for Jehovah.

14385.label: Psalms 32:1
14385.text: Happy is the one whose revolt is pardoned, whose sin is covered.

14386.label: Psalms 32:2
14386.text: Happy is the man to whose account Jehovah does not put error, And in whose spirit there is no deceit.

14387.label: Psalms 32:3
14387.text: When I kept silent my bones wore out through my groaning all day long.

14388.label: Psalms 32:4
14388.text: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me. My life’s moisture has been changed as in the dry heat of summer. Seʹlah.

14389.label: Psalms 32:5
14389.text: My sin I finally confessed to you, and my error I did not cover. I said: “I shall make confession over my transgressions to Jehovah.” And you yourself pardoned the error of my sins. Seʹlah.

14390.label: Psalms 32:6
14390.text: On this account every loyal one will pray to you At such a time only as you may be found. As for the flood of many waters, they will not touch him himself.

14391.label: Psalms 32:7
14391.text: You are a place of concealment for me; you will safeguard me from distress itself. With joyful cries at providing escape you will surround me. Seʹlah.

14392.label: Psalms 32:8
14392.text: “I shall make you have insight and instruct you in the way you should go. I will give advice with my eye upon you.

14393.label: Psalms 32:9
14393.text: Do not make yourselves like a horse or mule without understanding, Whose spiritedness is to be curbed even by bridle or halter Before [they] will come near to you.”

14394.label: Psalms 32:10
14394.text: Many are the pains that the wicked one has; But as for the one trusting in Jehovah, loving-kindness itself surrounds him.

14395.label: Psalms 32:11
14395.text: Rejoice in Jehovah and be joyful, YOU righteous ones; And cry out joyfully, all YOU who are upright in heart.

14396.label: Psalms 33:1
14396.text: Cry out joyfully, O YOU righteous ones, because of Jehovah. On the part of the upright ones praise is fitting.

14397.label: Psalms 33:2
14397.text: Give thanks to Jehovah on the harp; On an instrument of ten strings make melody to him.

14398.label: Psalms 33:3
14398.text: Sing to him a new song; Do YOUR best at playing on the strings along with joyful shouting.

14399.label: Psalms 33:4
14399.text: For the word of Jehovah is upright, And all his work is in faithfulness.

14400.label: Psalms 33:5
14400.text: He is a lover of righteousness and justice. With the loving-kindness of Jehovah the earth is filled.

14401.label: Psalms 33:6
14401.text: By the word of Jehovah the heavens themselves were made, And by the spirit of his mouth all their army.

14402.label: Psalms 33:7
14402.text: He is gathering as by a dam the waters of the sea, Putting in storehouses the surging waters.

14403.label: Psalms 33:8
14403.text: Let all [those of] the earth be in fear of Jehovah. At him let all the inhabitants of the productive land be frightened.

14404.label: Psalms 33:9
14404.text: For he himself said, and it came to be; He himself commanded, and it proceeded to stand so.

14405.label: Psalms 33:10
14405.text: Jehovah himself has broken up the counsel of the nations; He has thwarted the thoughts of the peoples.

14406.label: Psalms 33:11
14406.text: To time indefinite the very counsel of Jehovah will stand; The thoughts of his heart are to one generation after another generation.

14407.label: Psalms 33:12
14407.text: Happy is the nation whose God is Jehovah, The people whom he has chosen as his inheritance.

14408.label: Psalms 33:13
14408.text: From the heavens Jehovah has looked, He has seen all the sons of men.

14409.label: Psalms 33:14
14409.text: From the established place where he dwells He has gazed at all those dwelling on the earth.

14410.label: Psalms 33:15
14410.text: He is forming their hearts all together; He is considering all their works.

14411.label: Psalms 33:16
14411.text: There is no king saved by the abundance of military forces; A mighty man himself is not delivered by the abundance of power.

14412.label: Psalms 33:17
14412.text: The horse is a deception for salvation, And by the abundance of its vital energy it does not afford escape.

14413.label: Psalms 33:18
14413.text: Look! The eye of Jehovah is toward those fearing him, To those waiting for his loving-kindness,

14414.label: Psalms 33:19
14414.text: To deliver their soul from death itself, And to preserve them alive in famine.

14415.label: Psalms 33:20
14415.text: Our very soul has been in expectation of Jehovah. Our helper and our shield he is.

14416.label: Psalms 33:21
14416.text: For in him our heart rejoices; For in his holy name we have put our trust.

14417.label: Psalms 33:22
14417.text: Let your loving-kindness, O Jehovah, prove to be upon us, Even as we have kept waiting for you.

14419.label: Psalms 34:1
14419.text: I will bless Jehovah at all times; Constantly his praise will be in my mouth.

14420.label: Psalms 34:2
14420.text: In Jehovah my soul will make its boast; The meek ones will hear and will rejoice.

14421.label: Psalms 34:3
14421.text: O magnify Jehovah with me, YOU people,And let us exalt his name together.

14422.label: Psalms 34:4
14422.text: I inquired of Jehovah, and he answered me, And out of all my frights he delivered me.

14423.label: Psalms 34:5
14423.text: They looked to him and became radiant, And their very faces could not possibly be ashamed.

14424.label: Psalms 34:6
14424.text: This afflicted one called, and Jehovah himself heard. And out of all his distresses He saved him.

14425.label: Psalms 34:7
14425.text: The angel of Jehovah is camping all around those fearing him, And he rescues them.

14426.label: Psalms 34:8
14426.text: Taste and see that Jehovah is good, O YOU people;Happy is the able-bodied man that takes refuge in him.

14427.label: Psalms 34:9
14427.text: Fear Jehovah, YOU holy ones of his, For there is no lack to those fearing him.

14428.label: Psalms 34:10
14428.text: The maned young lions themselves have had little on hand and gone hungry; But as for those seeking Jehovah, they will not lack anything good.

14429.label: Psalms 34:11
14429.text: Come, YOU sons, listen to me; The fear of Jehovah is what I shall teach YOU.

14430.label: Psalms 34:12
14430.text: Who is the man that is delighting in life, That is loving enough days to see what is good?

14431.label: Psalms 34:13
14431.text: Safeguard your tongue against what is bad, And your lips against speaking deception.

14432.label: Psalms 34:14
14432.text: Turn away from what is bad, and do what is good; Seek to find peace, and pursue it.

14433.label: Psalms 34:15
14433.text: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous ones, And his ears are toward their cry for help.

14434.label: Psalms 34:16
14434.text: The face of Jehovah is against those doing what is bad, To cut off the mention of them from the very earth.

14435.label: Psalms 34:17
14435.text: They cried out, and Jehovah himself heard, And out of all their distresses he delivered them.

14436.label: Psalms 34:18
14436.text: Jehovah is near to those that are broken at heart; And those who are crushed in spirit he saves.

14437.label: Psalms 34:19
14437.text: Many are the calamities of the righteous one, But out of them all Jehovah delivers him.

14438.label: Psalms 34:20
14438.text: He is guarding all the bones of that one;Not one of them has been broken.

14439.label: Psalms 34:21
14439.text: Calamity will put the wicked one himself to death; And the very ones hating the righteous one will be held guilty.

14440.label: Psalms 34:22
14440.text: Jehovah is redeeming the soul of his servants; And none of those taking refuge in him will be held guilty.

14442.label: Psalms 35:1
14442.text: Do conduct my case, O Jehovah, against my opponents; War against those warring against me.

14443.label: Psalms 35:2
14443.text: Take hold of buckler and large shield, And do rise up in assistance of me,

14444.label: Psalms 35:3
14444.text: And draw spear and double ax to meet those pursuing me. Say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”

14445.label: Psalms 35:4
14445.text: May those be shamed and humiliated who are hunting for my soul. May those be turned back and be abashed who are scheming calamity for me.

14446.label: Psalms 35:5
14446.text: May they become like chaff before the wind, And let Jehovah’s angel be pushing [them] along.

14447.label: Psalms 35:6
14447.text: Let their way become darkness and slippery places, And let Jehovah’s angel be pursuing them.

14448.label: Psalms 35:7
14448.text: For without cause they have hid for me their netted pit; Without cause they have dug it for my soul.

14449.label: Psalms 35:8
14449.text: Let ruin come upon him without his knowing, And let his own net that he hid catch him; With ruin let him fall into it.

14450.label: Psalms 35:9
14450.text: But let my own soul be joyful in Jehovah; Let it exult in his salvation.

14451.label: Psalms 35:10
14451.text: Let all my bones themselves say: “O Jehovah, who is there like you, Delivering the afflicted one from one stronger than he is, And the afflicted and poor one from the one robbing him?”

14452.label: Psalms 35:11
14452.text: Violent witnesses rise up; What I have not known they ask me.

14453.label: Psalms 35:12
14453.text: They reward me with bad for good, Bereavement to my soul.

14454.label: Psalms 35:13
14454.text: As for me, when they became ill, my clothing was sackcloth, With fasting I afflicted my soul, And upon my bosom my own prayer would return.

14455.label: Psalms 35:14
14455.text: As for a companion, as for a brother of mine, I walked about like one mourning for a mother. Saddened, I bowed down.

14456.label: Psalms 35:15
14456.text: But at my limping they rejoiced and gathered together; They gathered together against me, Striking [me] down when I did not know it; They ripped [me] to pieces and did not keep silent.

14457.label: Psalms 35:16
14457.text: Among the apostate mockers for a cake There was a grinding of their teeth even against me.

14458.label: Psalms 35:17
14458.text: O Jehovah, how long will you keep seeing [it]? Do bring back my soul from their ravages, Even my only one from the maned young lions.

14459.label: Psalms 35:18
14459.text: I will laud you in the big congregation; Among a numerous people I shall praise you.

14460.label: Psalms 35:19
14460.text: O may those who for no reason are my enemies not rejoice over me; As for those hating me without cause, let them not wink the eye.

14461.label: Psalms 35:20
14461.text: For it is not peace that they speak; But against the quiet ones of the earthThings of deception they keep scheming.

14462.label: Psalms 35:21
14462.text: And they open wide their mouth even against me. They have said: “Aha! Aha! our eye has seen [it].”

14463.label: Psalms 35:22
14463.text: You have seen, O Jehovah. Do not keep silent. O Jehovah, do not keep yourself far from me.

14464.label: Psalms 35:23
14464.text: Do arouse yourself and awake to my judgment, O my God, even Jehovah, to my case at law.

14465.label: Psalms 35:24
14465.text: Judge me according to your righteousness, O Jehovah my God, And may they not rejoice over me.

14466.label: Psalms 35:25
14466.text: O may they not say in their heart: “Aha, our soul!” May they not say: “We have swallowed him up.”

14467.label: Psalms 35:26
14467.text: Let those be ashamed and abashed all together Who are joyful at my calamity. Let those be clothed with shame and humiliation who are assuming great airs against me.

14468.label: Psalms 35:27
14468.text: Let those cry out joyfully and rejoice who are delighting in my righteousness, And let them say constantly: “Let Jehovah be magnified, who takes delight in the peace of his servant.”

14469.label: Psalms 35:28
14469.text: And let my own tongue utter in an undertone your righteousness, All day long your praise.

14471.label: Psalms 36:1
14471.text: The utterance of transgression to the wicked one is in the midst of his heart; There is no dread of God in front of his eyes.

14472.label: Psalms 36:2
14472.text: For he has acted too smoothly to himself in his own eyes To find out his error so as to hate [it].

14473.label: Psalms 36:3
14473.text: The words of his mouth are hurtfulness and deception; He has ceased to have insight for doing good.

14474.label: Psalms 36:4
14474.text: Hurtfulness is what he keeps scheming upon his bed. He stations himself on a way that is not good. What is bad he does not reject.

14475.label: Psalms 36:5
14475.text: O Jehovah, your loving-kindness is in the heavens; Your faithfulness is up to the clouds.

14476.label: Psalms 36:6
14476.text: Your righteousness is like mountains of God; Your judicial decision is a vast watery deep. Man and beast you save, O Jehovah.

14477.label: Psalms 36:7
14477.text: How precious your loving-kindness is, O God! And in the shadow of your wings the sons of men themselves take refuge.

14478.label: Psalms 36:8
14478.text: They drink their fill of the fatness of your house; And of the torrent of your pleasures you cause them to drink.

14479.label: Psalms 36:9
14479.text: For with you is the source of life; By light from you we can see light.

14480.label: Psalms 36:10
14480.text: Continue your loving-kindness to those knowing you, And your righteousness to those upright in heart.

14481.label: Psalms 36:11
14481.text: O may not the foot of haughtiness come [against] me; As for the hand of wicked people, let it not make me a wanderer.

14482.label: Psalms 36:12
14482.text: There the practicers of hurtfulness have fallen; They have been pushed down and have been unable to get up.

14484.label: Psalms 37:1
14484.text: Do not show yourself heated up because of the evildoers. Do not be envious of those doing unrighteousness.

14485.label: Psalms 37:2
14485.text: For like grass they will speedily wither, And like green new grass they will fade away.

14486.label: Psalms 37:3
14486.text: Trust in Jehovah and do good; Reside in the earth, and deal with faithfulness.

14487.label: Psalms 37:4
14487.text: Also take exquisite delight in Jehovah, And he will give you the requests of your heart.

14488.label: Psalms 37:5
14488.text: Roll upon Jehovah your way, And rely upon him, and he himself will act.

14489.label: Psalms 37:6
14489.text: And he will certainly bring forth your righteousness as the light itself, And your justice as the midday.

14490.label: Psalms 37:7
14490.text: Keep silent before Jehovah And wait longingly for him. Do not show yourself heated up at anyone making his way successful, At the man carrying out [his] ideas.

14491.label: Psalms 37:8
14491.text: Let anger alone and leave rage; Do not show yourself heated up only to do evil.

14492.label: Psalms 37:9
14492.text: For evildoers themselves will be cut off, But those hoping in Jehovah are the ones that will possess the earth.

14493.label: Psalms 37:10
14493.text: And just a little while longer, and the wicked one will be no more; And you will certainly give attention to his place, and he will not be.

14494.label: Psalms 37:11
14494.text: But the meek ones themselves will possess the earth, And they will indeed find their exquisite delight in the abundance of peace.

14495.label: Psalms 37:12
14495.text: The wicked one is plotting against the righteous one, And at him he is grinding his teeth.

14496.label: Psalms 37:13
14496.text: Jehovah himself will laugh at him, For he certainly sees that his day will come.

14497.label: Psalms 37:14
14497.text: The wicked ones have drawn a sword itself and have bent their bow, To cause the afflicted and poor one to fall, To slaughter those who are upright in [their] way.

14498.label: Psalms 37:15
14498.text: Their own sword will enter into their heart, And their own bows will be broken.

14499.label: Psalms 37:16
14499.text: Better is the little of the righteous one Than the abundance of the many wicked ones.

14500.label: Psalms 37:17
14500.text: For the very arms of the wicked ones will be broken, But Jehovah will be supporting the righteous ones.

14501.label: Psalms 37:18
14501.text: Jehovah is aware of the days of the faultless ones, And their very inheritance will continue even to time indefinite.

14502.label: Psalms 37:19
14502.text: They will not be ashamed in the time of calamity, And in the days of famine they will be satisfied.

14503.label: Psalms 37:20
14503.text: For the wicked themselves will perish, And the enemies of Jehovah will be like the preciousness of pastures;They must come to their end. In smoke they must come to their end.

14504.label: Psalms 37:21
14504.text: The wicked one is borrowing and does not pay back, But the righteous one is showing favor and is making gifts.

14505.label: Psalms 37:22
14505.text: For those being blessed by him will themselves possess the earth, But those upon whom evil is called by him will be cut off.

14506.label: Psalms 37:23
14506.text: By Jehovah the very steps of an able-bodied man have been made ready, And in his way He takes delight.

14507.label: Psalms 37:24
14507.text: Although he may fall, he will not be hurled down, For Jehovah is supporting his hand.

14508.label: Psalms 37:25
14508.text: A young man I used to be, I have also grown old, And yet I have not seen anyone righteous left entirely, Nor his offspring looking for bread.

14509.label: Psalms 37:26
14509.text: All day long he is showing favor and lending, And so his offspring are in line for a blessing.

14510.label: Psalms 37:27
14510.text: Turn away from what is bad and do what is good, And so reside to time indefinite.

14511.label: Psalms 37:28
14511.text: For Jehovah is a lover of justice, And he will not leave his loyal ones. ע [ʽAʹyin]To time indefinite they will certainly be guarded; But as for the offspring of the wicked ones, they will indeed be cut off.

14512.label: Psalms 37:29
14512.text: The righteous themselves will possess the earth, And they will reside forever upon it.

14513.label: Psalms 37:30
14513.text: The mouth of the righteous is the one that utters wisdom in an undertone, And his is the tongue that speaks justly.

14514.label: Psalms 37:31
14514.text: The law of his God is in his heart; His steps will not wobble.

14515.label: Psalms 37:32
14515.text: The wicked one is keeping on the watch for the righteous And is seeking to put him to death.
