14516.label: Psalms 37:33
14516.text: As for Jehovah, he will not leave him to the hand of that one, And he will not pronounce him wicked when he is being judged.

14517.label: Psalms 37:34
14517.text: Hope in Jehovah and keep his way, And he will exalt you to take possession of the earth. When the wicked ones are cut off, you will see [it].

14518.label: Psalms 37:35
14518.text: I have seen the wicked a tyrant And spreading himself as a luxuriant [tree] in native soil.

14519.label: Psalms 37:36
14519.text: And yet he proceeded to pass away, and there he was not; And I kept seeking him, and he was not found.

14520.label: Psalms 37:37
14520.text: Watch the blameless one and keep the upright one in sight, For the future of [that] man will be peaceful.

14521.label: Psalms 37:38
14521.text: But the transgressors themselves will certainly be annihilated together; The future of wicked people will indeed be cut off.

14522.label: Psalms 37:39
14522.text: And the salvation of the righteous ones is from Jehovah; He is their fortress in the time of distress.

14523.label: Psalms 37:40
14523.text: And Jehovah will help them and provide them with escape. He will provide them with escape from wicked people and save them, Because they have taken refuge in him.

14525.label: Psalms 38:1
14525.text: O Jehovah, do not in your indignation reprove me, Nor in your rage correct me.

14526.label: Psalms 38:2
14526.text: For your own arrows have sunk themselves deep into me, And upon me your hand is come down.

14527.label: Psalms 38:3
14527.text: There is no sound spot in my flesh because of your denunciation. There is no peace in my bones on account of my sin.

14528.label: Psalms 38:4
14528.text: For my own errors have passed over my head; Like a heavy load they are too heavy for me.

14529.label: Psalms 38:5
14529.text: My wounds have become stinky, they have festered,Because of my foolishness.

14530.label: Psalms 38:6
14530.text: I have become disconcerted, I have bowed low to an extreme degree; All day long I have walked about sad.

14531.label: Psalms 38:7
14531.text: For my very loins have become full of burning,And there is no sound spot in my flesh.

14532.label: Psalms 38:8
14532.text: I have grown numb and become crushed to an extreme degree;I have roared due to the groaning of my heart.

14533.label: Psalms 38:9
14533.text: O Jehovah, in front of you is all my desire,And from you my sighing itself has not been concealed.

14534.label: Psalms 38:10
14534.text: My own heart has palpitated heavily, my power has left me,And the light of my own eyes also is not with me.

14535.label: Psalms 38:11
14535.text: As for my lovers and my companions, they keep standing away from my plague, And my close acquaintances themselves have stood off at a distance.

14536.label: Psalms 38:12
14536.text: But those seeking my soul lay out traps, And those working for a calamity to me have spoken of adversities, And deceptions they keep muttering all day long.

14537.label: Psalms 38:13
14537.text: As for me, like someone deaf, I would not listen; And like someone speechless, I would not open my mouth.

14538.label: Psalms 38:14
14538.text: And I came to be like a man that was not hearing,And in my mouth there were no counterarguments.

14539.label: Psalms 38:15
14539.text: For on you, O Jehovah, I waited; You yourself proceeded to answer, O Jehovah my God.

14540.label: Psalms 38:16
14540.text: For I said: “Otherwise they would rejoice at me; When my foot moved unsteadily, they would certainly assume great airs against me.”

14541.label: Psalms 38:17
14541.text: For I was ready to limp, And my pain was in front of me constantly.

14542.label: Psalms 38:18
14542.text: For I proceeded to tell about my own error; I began to be anxious over my sin.

14543.label: Psalms 38:19
14543.text: And my enemies who are alive became mighty, And those hating me for no reason became many.

14544.label: Psalms 38:20
14544.text: And they were rewarding me with bad for good; They kept resisting me in return for my pursuing what is good.

14545.label: Psalms 38:21
14545.text: Do not leave me, O Jehovah.O my God, do not keep far away from me.

14546.label: Psalms 38:22
14546.text: Do make haste to my assistance, O Jehovah my salvation.

14548.label: Psalms 39:1
14548.text: I said: “I will guard my ways To keep from sinning with my tongue. I will set a muzzle as a guard to my own mouth, As long as anyone wicked is in front of me.”

14549.label: Psalms 39:2
14549.text: I became speechless with silence; I kept quiet from what is good, And my being pained was ostracized.

14550.label: Psalms 39:3
14550.text: My heart grew hot inside me; During my sighing the fire kept burning.I spoke with my tongue:

14551.label: Psalms 39:4
14551.text: “Cause me, O Jehovah, to know my end, And the measure of my days—what it is, That I may know how transient I am.

14552.label: Psalms 39:5
14552.text: Look! You have made my days just a few; And my life’s duration is as nothing in front of you. Surely every earthling man, though standing firm, is nothing but an exhalation. Seʹlah.

14553.label: Psalms 39:6
14553.text: Surely in a semblance man walks about. Surely they are boisterous in vain. One piles up things and does not know who will be gathering them.

14554.label: Psalms 39:7
14554.text: And now for what have I hoped, O Jehovah? My expectation is toward you.

14555.label: Psalms 39:8
14555.text: From all my transgressions deliver me. Do not set me as a reproach of the senseless one.

14556.label: Psalms 39:9
14556.text: I kept speechless; I could not open my mouth, For you yourself acted.

14557.label: Psalms 39:10
14557.text: Remove from off me your plague. Due to the hostility of your hand I myself have come to an end.

14558.label: Psalms 39:11
14558.text: By reproofs against error you have corrected man, And you consume his desirable things just as a moth does.Surely every earthling man is an exhalation. Seʹlah.

14559.label: Psalms 39:12
14559.text: Do hear my prayer, O Jehovah,And to my cry for help do give ear. At my tears do not keep silent. For I am but an alien resident with you, A settler the same as all my forefathers.

14560.label: Psalms 39:13
14560.text: Look away from me, that I may brighten up Before I go away and I am not.”

14562.label: Psalms 40:1
14562.text: I earnestly hoped in Jehovah, And so he inclined [his ear] to me and heard my cry for help.

14563.label: Psalms 40:2
14563.text: He also proceeded to bring me up out of a roaring pit, Out of the mire of [the] sediment. Then he raised up my feet upon a crag; He firmly established my steps.

14564.label: Psalms 40:3
14564.text: Further, he put in my mouth a new song,Praise to our God. Many will see [it] and will fear, And they will trust in Jehovah.

14565.label: Psalms 40:4
14565.text: Happy is the able-bodied man that has put Jehovah as his trust And that has not turned his face to defiant people,Nor to those falling away to lies.

14566.label: Psalms 40:5
14566.text: Many things you yourself have done, O Jehovah my God, even your wonderful works and your thoughts toward us; There is none to be compared to you. Were I inclined to tell and speak [of them],They have become more numerous than I can recount.

14567.label: Psalms 40:6
14567.text: Sacrifice and offering you did not delight in; These ears of mine you opened up. Burnt offering and sin offering you did not ask for.

14568.label: Psalms 40:7
14568.text: In view of that, I said: “Here I have come, In the roll of the book it being written about me.

14569.label: Psalms 40:8
14569.text: To do your will, O my God, I have delighted, And your law is within my inward parts.

14570.label: Psalms 40:9
14570.text: I have told the good news of righteousness in the big congregation. Look! My lips I do not restrain. O Jehovah, you yourself know that well.

14571.label: Psalms 40:10
14571.text: Your righteousness I have not covered over within my heart. Your faithfulness and your salvation I have declared. I have not hidden your loving-kindness and your trueness in the big congregation.”

14572.label: Psalms 40:11
14572.text: You yourself, O Jehovah, do not restrain your pity from me. Let your loving-kindness and your trueness themselves constantly safeguard me.

14573.label: Psalms 40:12
14573.text: For calamities encircled me until there was no numbering of them. More errors of mine overtook me than I was able to see; They became more numerous than the hairs of my head, And my own heart left me.

14574.label: Psalms 40:13
14574.text: Be pleased, O Jehovah, to deliver me. O Jehovah, to my assistance do make haste.

14575.label: Psalms 40:14
14575.text: May those be ashamed and abashed all together Who are seeking my soul to sweep it away. May those turn back and be humiliated who are delighting in my calamity.

14576.label: Psalms 40:15
14576.text: Let those stare in amazement in consequence of their shame Who are saying to me: “Aha! Aha!”

14577.label: Psalms 40:16
14577.text: Let those exult and rejoice in you, All those who are seeking you. Let those say constantly: “May Jehovah be magnified,” Those who are loving salvation by you.

14578.label: Psalms 40:17
14578.text: But I am afflicted and poor. Jehovah himself takes account of me. You are my assistance and the Provider of escape for me. O my God, do not be too late.

14580.label: Psalms 41:1
14580.text: Happy is anyone acting with consideration toward the lowly one; In the day of calamity Jehovah will provide escape for him.

14581.label: Psalms 41:2
14581.text: Jehovah himself will guard him and preserve him alive. He will be pronounced happy in the earth; And you cannot possibly give him over to the soul of his enemies.

14582.label: Psalms 41:3
14582.text: Jehovah himself will sustain him upon a divan of illness; All his bed you will certainly change during his sickness.

14583.label: Psalms 41:4
14583.text: As for me, I said: “O Jehovah, show me favor. Do heal my soul, for I have sinned against you.”

14584.label: Psalms 41:5
14584.text: As for my enemies, they say what is bad concerning me: “When will he die and his name actually perish?”

14585.label: Psalms 41:6
14585.text: And if one does come to see [me], untruth is what his heart will speak; He will gather up for himself something hurtful;He will go out; on the outside he will speak [of it].

14586.label: Psalms 41:7
14586.text: Unitedly against me all those hating me whisper to one another; Against me they keep scheming something bad for me:

14587.label: Psalms 41:8
14587.text: “A good-for-nothing thing is poured out upon him; Now that he has lain down, he will not get up again.”

14588.label: Psalms 41:9
14588.text: Also the man at peace with me, in whom I trusted, Who was eating my bread, has magnified [his] heel against me.

14589.label: Psalms 41:10
14589.text: As for you, O Jehovah, show me favor and cause me to get up, That I may pay them back.

14590.label: Psalms 41:11
14590.text: By this I do know that you have found delight in me,Because my enemy does not shout in triumph over me.

14591.label: Psalms 41:12
14591.text: As for me, because of my integrity you have upheld me, And you will set me before your face to time indefinite.

14592.label: Psalms 41:13
14592.text: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel From time indefinite even to time indefinite. Amen and Amen.

14594.label: Psalms 42:1
14594.text: As the hind that longs for the water streams,So my very soul longs for you, O God.

14595.label: Psalms 42:2
14595.text: My soul indeed thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear [before] God?

14596.label: Psalms 42:3
14596.text: To me my tears have become food day and night, While [they] say to me all day long: “Where is your God?”

14597.label: Psalms 42:4
14597.text: These things I will remember, and I will pour out my soul within me. For I used to pass along with the throng,I used to walk slowly before them to the house of God, With the voice of a joyful cry and thanksgiving, Of a crowd celebrating a festival.

14598.label: Psalms 42:5
14598.text: Why are you in despair, O my soul, And why are you boisterous within me? Wait for God, For I shall yet laud him as the grand salvation of my person.

14599.label: Psalms 42:6
14599.text: O my God, within me my very soul is in despair. That is why I remember you, From the land of Jordan and the peaks of Herʹmon, From the little mountain.

14600.label: Psalms 42:7
14600.text: Watery deep to watery deep is callingAt the sound of your (water-) spouts. All your breakers and your waves —Over me they have passed.

14601.label: Psalms 42:8
14601.text: By day Jehovah will command his loving-kindness, And by night his song will be with me; There will be prayer to the God of my life.

14602.label: Psalms 42:9
14602.text: I will say to God my crag: “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I walk sad because of the oppression of the enemy?”

14603.label: Psalms 42:10
14603.text: With murder against my bones those showing hostility to me have reproached me, While they say to me all day long: “Where is your God?”

14604.label: Psalms 42:11
14604.text: Why are you in despair, O my soul, And why are you boisterous within me? Wait for God, For I shall yet laud him as the grand salvation of my person and as my God.

14605.label: Psalms 43:1
14605.text: Judge me, O God,And do conduct my legal case against a nation not loyal. From the man of deception and unrighteousness may you provide me with escape.

14606.label: Psalms 43:2
14606.text: For you are the God of my fortress. Why have you cast me off?Why do I walk about sad because of the oppression by the enemy?

14607.label: Psalms 43:3
14607.text: Send out your light and your truth. May these themselves lead me. May they bring me to your holy mountain and to your grand tabernacle.

14608.label: Psalms 43:4
14608.text: And I will come to the altar of God, To God, my exultant rejoicing. And I will laud you on the harp, O God, my God.

14609.label: Psalms 43:5
14609.text: Why are you in despair, O my soul, And why are you boisterous within me?Wait for God, For I shall yet laud him as the grand salvation of my person and as my God.

14611.label: Psalms 44:1
14611.text: O God, with our ears we have heard,Our forefathers themselves have recounted to us The activity that you performed in their days, In the days of long ago.

14612.label: Psalms 44:2
14612.text: You yourself by your hand drove away even nations, And you proceeded to plant them [instead]. You went breaking national groups and sending them away.

14613.label: Psalms 44:3
14613.text: For it was not by their own sword that they took possession of the land, And their own arm was not what brought them salvation. For it was your right hand and your arm and the light of your face,Because you took pleasure in them.

14614.label: Psalms 44:4
14614.text: You yourself are my King, O God. Command grand salvation for Jacob.

14615.label: Psalms 44:5
14615.text: By you we shall push our adversaries themselves; In your name we shall tread down those rising up against us.

14616.label: Psalms 44:6
14616.text: For it was not in my bow that I kept trusting And it was not my sword that was saving me.

14617.label: Psalms 44:7
14617.text: For you saved us from our adversaries, And those intensely hating us you put to shame.

14618.label: Psalms 44:8
14618.text: In God we will offer praise all day long, And to time indefinite your name we shall laud. Seʹlah.

14619.label: Psalms 44:9
14619.text: But now you have cast off and keep humiliating us, And you do not go forth with our armies.

14620.label: Psalms 44:10
14620.text: You keep making us turn back from the adversary, And the very ones intensely hating us have pillaged for themselves.

14621.label: Psalms 44:11
14621.text: You give us up like sheep, as something to eat, And among the nations you have scattered us.

14622.label: Psalms 44:12
14622.text: You sell your people for no value at all, And you have made no wealth by the price for them.

14623.label: Psalms 44:13
14623.text: You set us as a reproach to our neighbors, A derision and jeering to those all around us.

14624.label: Psalms 44:14
14624.text: You set us as a proverbial saying among the nations, A shaking of the head among the national groups.

14625.label: Psalms 44:15
14625.text: All day long my humiliation is in front of me,And the shame of my own face has covered me,

14626.label: Psalms 44:16
14626.text: Due to the voice of the one reproaching and speaking abusively,Because of the enemy and the one taking his revenge.

14627.label: Psalms 44:17
14627.text: All this is what has come upon us, and we have not forgotten you, And we have not acted falsely in your covenant.

14628.label: Psalms 44:18
14628.text: Our heart has not turned faithlessly back, Nor do our footsteps deviate from your path.

14629.label: Psalms 44:19
14629.text: For you have crushed us in the place of jackals, And you cover us over with deep shadow.

14630.label: Psalms 44:20
14630.text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or we spread out our palms to a strange god,

14631.label: Psalms 44:21
14631.text: Will not God himself search this out? For he is aware of the secrets of the heart.

14632.label: Psalms 44:22
14632.text: But for your sake we have been killed all day long;We have been accounted as sheep for slaughtering.

14633.label: Psalms 44:23
14633.text: Do arouse yourself. Why do you keep sleeping, O Jehovah? Do awake. Do not keep casting off forever.

14634.label: Psalms 44:24
14634.text: Why do you keep your very face concealed?Why do you forget our affliction and our oppression?

14635.label: Psalms 44:25
14635.text: For our soul has bowed down to the dust itself; Our belly has clung to the very earth.

14636.label: Psalms 44:26
14636.text: Do arise in assistance to us And redeem us for the sake of your loving-kindness.

14638.label: Psalms 45:1
14638.text: My heart has become astir with a goodly matter. I am saying: “My works are concerning a king.” May my tongue be the stylus of a skilled copyist.

14639.label: Psalms 45:2
14639.text: You are indeed more handsome than the sons of men. Charm has been poured out upon your lips. That is why God has blessed you to time indefinite.

14640.label: Psalms 45:3
14640.text: Gird your sword upon [your] thigh, O mighty one, [With] your dignity and your splendor.

14641.label: Psalms 45:4
14641.text: And in your splendor go on to success; Ride in the cause of truth and humility [and] righteousness, And your right hand will instruct you in fear-inspiring things.

14642.label: Psalms 45:5
14642.text: Your arrows are sharp—under you peoples keep falling —In the heart of the enemies of the king.

14643.label: Psalms 45:6
14643.text: God is your throne to time indefinite, even forever; The scepter of your kingship is a scepter of uprightness.

14644.label: Psalms 45:7
14644.text: You have loved righteousness and you hate wickedness. That is why God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of exultation more than your partners.

14645.label: Psalms 45:8
14645.text: All your garments are myrrh and aloeswood [and] cassia; Out from the grand ivory palace stringed instruments themselves have made you rejoice.

14646.label: Psalms 45:9
14646.text: The daughters of kings are among your precious women. The queenly consort has taken her stand at your right hand in gold of Oʹphir.

14647.label: Psalms 45:10
14647.text: Listen, O daughter, and see, and incline your ear;And forget your people and your father’s house.

14648.label: Psalms 45:11
14648.text: And the king will long for your prettiness, For he is your lord, So bow down to him.

14649.label: Psalms 45:12
14649.text: The daughter of Tyre also with a gift —The rich ones of the people will soften your own face.

14650.label: Psalms 45:13
14650.text: The king’s daughter is all glorious within [the house]; Her clothing is with settings of gold.

14651.label: Psalms 45:14
14651.text: In woven apparel she will be brought to the king. The virgins in her train as her companions are being brought in to you.

14652.label: Psalms 45:15
14652.text: They will be brought with rejoicing and joyfulness;They will enter into the palace of the king.

14653.label: Psalms 45:16
14653.text: In place of your forefathers there will come to be your sons, Whom you will appoint as princes in all the earth.

14654.label: Psalms 45:17
14654.text: I will make mention of your name throughout all generations to come. That is why peoples themselves will laud you to time indefinite, even forever.

14656.label: Psalms 46:1
14656.text: God is for us a refuge and strength, A help that is readily to be found during distresses.

14657.label: Psalms 46:2
14657.text: That is why we shall not fear, though the earth undergo change And though the mountains totter into the heart of the vast sea;

14658.label: Psalms 46:3
14658.text: Though its waters be boisterous, foam over, Though the mountains rock at its uproar. Seʹlah.

14659.label: Psalms 46:4
14659.text: There is a river the streams of which make the city of God rejoice, The holiest grand tabernacle of the Most High.

14660.label: Psalms 46:5
14660.text: God is in the midst of [the city]; it will not be made to totter. God will help it at the appearance of morning.

14661.label: Psalms 46:6
14661.text: The nations became boisterous, the kingdoms tottered;He sounded with his voice, the earth proceeded to melt.

14662.label: Psalms 46:7
14662.text: Jehovah of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is a secure height for us. Seʹlah.

14663.label: Psalms 46:8
14663.text: Come, YOU people, behold the activities of Jehovah, How he has set astonishing events on the earth.

14664.label: Psalms 46:9
14664.text: He is making wars to cease to the extremity of the earth. The bow he breaks apart and does cut the spear in pieces; The wagons he burns in the fire.

14665.label: Psalms 46:10
14665.text: “Give in, YOU people, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”

14666.label: Psalms 46:11
14666.text: Jehovah of armies is with us; The God of Jacob is a secure height for us. Seʹlah.

14668.label: Psalms 47:1
14668.text: All YOU peoples, clap YOUR hands. Shout in triumph to God with the sound of a joyful cry.

14669.label: Psalms 47:2
14669.text: For Jehovah, the Most High, is fear-inspiring, A great King over all the earth.

14670.label: Psalms 47:3
14670.text: He will subdue peoples under us And national groups under our feet.

14671.label: Psalms 47:4
14671.text: He will choose for us our inheritance, The pride of Jacob, whom he has loved. Seʹlah.

14672.label: Psalms 47:5
14672.text: God has ascended with joyful shouting, Jehovah with the sound of the horn.

14673.label: Psalms 47:6
14673.text: MAKE melody to God, make melody. Make melody to our King, make melody.

14674.label: Psalms 47:7
14674.text: For God is King of all the earth; MAKE melody, acting with discretion.

14675.label: Psalms 47:8
14675.text: God has become king over the nations. God himself has taken his seat upon his holy throne.

14676.label: Psalms 47:9
14676.text: The nobles of the peoples themselves have gathered together, [With] the people of the God of Abraham. For to God the shields of the earth belong. He is very high in his ascent.

14678.label: Psalms 48:1
14678.text: Jehovah is great and much to be praised In the city of our God, [in] his holy mountain.

14679.label: Psalms 48:2
14679.text: Pretty for loftiness, the exultation of the whole earth, Is Mount Zion on the remote sides of the north, The town of the grand King.

14680.label: Psalms 48:3
14680.text: In her dwelling towers God himself has become known as a secure height.

14681.label: Psalms 48:4
14681.text: For, look! the kings themselves have met by appointment, They have passed by together.

14682.label: Psalms 48:5
14682.text: They themselves saw; [and] so they were amazed.They got disturbed, they were sent running in panic.

14683.label: Psalms 48:6
14683.text: Trembling itself took hold of them there, Birth pangs like those of a woman giving birth.

14684.label: Psalms 48:7
14684.text: With an east wind you wreck the ships of Tarʹshish.

14685.label: Psalms 48:8
14685.text: Just as we have heard, so we have seen In the city of Jehovah of armies, in the city of our God. God himself will firmly establish it to time indefinite. Seʹlah.

14686.label: Psalms 48:9
14686.text: We have pondered, O God, over your loving-kindness In the midst of your temple.

14687.label: Psalms 48:10
14687.text: Like your name, O God, so your praise isTo the borders of the earth.Your right hand is full of righteousness itself.

14688.label: Psalms 48:11
14688.text: May Mount Zion rejoice,May the dependent towns of Judah be joyful, on account of your judicial decisions.

14689.label: Psalms 48:12
14689.text: March around Zion, YOU people, and go about it, Count its towers.

14690.label: Psalms 48:13
14690.text: Set YOUR hearts upon its rampart. Inspect its dwelling towers,In order that YOU may recount it to the future generation.

14691.label: Psalms 48:14
14691.text: For this God is our God to time indefinite, even forever. He himself will guide us until [we] die.

14693.label: Psalms 49:1
14693.text: Hear this, all YOU peoples.Give ear, all YOU inhabitants of the system of things,

14694.label: Psalms 49:2
14694.text: YOU sons of humankind as well as YOU sons of man, You rich one and you poor one together.

14695.label: Psalms 49:3
14695.text: My own mouth will speak things of wisdom, And the meditation of my heart will be of things of understanding.

14696.label: Psalms 49:4
14696.text: To a proverbial utterance I shall incline my ear; On a harp I shall open up my riddle.

14697.label: Psalms 49:5
14697.text: Why should I be afraid in the days of evil, [When] the very error of my supplanters surrounds me?

14698.label: Psalms 49:6
14698.text: Those who are trusting in their means of maintenance, And who keep boasting about the abundance of their riches,

14699.label: Psalms 49:7
14699.text: Not one of them can by any means redeem even a brother, Nor give to God a ransom for him;

14700.label: Psalms 49:8
14700.text: (And the redemption price of their soul is so precious That it has ceased to time indefinite)

14701.label: Psalms 49:9
14701.text: That he should still live forever [and] not see the pit.

14702.label: Psalms 49:10
14702.text: For he sees that even the wise ones die, Together the stupid one and the unreasoning one perish, And they must leave to others their means of maintenance.

14703.label: Psalms 49:11
14703.text: Their inward wish is that their houses may be to time indefinite, Their tabernacles to generation after generation. They have called their landed estates by their names.

14704.label: Psalms 49:12
14704.text: And yet earthling man, though in honor, cannot keep lodging; He is indeed comparable with the beasts that have been destroyed.

14705.label: Psalms 49:13
14705.text: This is the way of those who have stupidity, And of those coming after them who take pleasure in their very mouthings. Seʹlah.

14706.label: Psalms 49:14
14706.text: Like sheep they have been appointed to Sheʹol itself; Death itself will shepherd them; And the upright ones will have them in subjection in the morning, And their forms are due to wear away; Sheʹol rather than a lofty abode is for each one.

14707.label: Psalms 49:15
14707.text: However, God himself will redeem my soul from the hand of Sheʹol, For he will receive me. Seʹlah.

14708.label: Psalms 49:16
14708.text: Do not be afraid because some man gains riches, Because the glory of his house increases,

14709.label: Psalms 49:17
14709.text: For at his death he cannot take along anything at all; His glory will not go down along with him himself.

14710.label: Psalms 49:18
14710.text: For during his lifetime he kept blessing his own soul; (And people will laud you because you do well for yourself)

14711.label: Psalms 49:19
14711.text: [His soul] finally comes only as far as the generation of his forefathers. Nevermore will they see the light.

14712.label: Psalms 49:20
14712.text: Earthling man, although in honor, who does not understand, Is indeed comparable with the beasts that have been destroyed.

14714.label: Psalms 50:1
14714.text: The Divine One, God, Jehovah, has himself spoken, And he proceeds to call the earth, From the rising of the sun until its setting.

14715.label: Psalms 50:2
14715.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of prettiness, God himself has beamed forth.

14716.label: Psalms 50:3
14716.text: Our God will come and cannot possibly keep silent. Before him there devours a fire, And all around him it has become exceedingly stormy weather.

14717.label: Psalms 50:4
14717.text: He calls to the heavens above and to the earth So as to execute judgment on his people:

14718.label: Psalms 50:5
14718.text: “Gather to me my loyal ones, Those concluding my covenant over sacrifice.”

14719.label: Psalms 50:6
14719.text: And the heavens tell of his righteousness, For God himself is Judge. Seʹlah.

14720.label: Psalms 50:7
14720.text: “Do listen, O my people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will bear witness against you. I am God, your God.

14721.label: Psalms 50:8
14721.text: Not concerning your sacrifices do I reprove you, Nor [concerning] your whole burnt offerings [that are] in front of me constantly.

14722.label: Psalms 50:9
14722.text: I will not take out of your house a bull, Out of your pens he-goats.

14723.label: Psalms 50:10
14723.text: For to me belongs every wild animal of the forest, The beasts upon a thousand mountains.

14724.label: Psalms 50:11
14724.text: I well know every winged creature of the mountains, And the animal throngs of the open field are with me.

14725.label: Psalms 50:12
14725.text: If I were hungry, I would not say it to you;For to me the productive land and its fullness belong.

14726.label: Psalms 50:13
14726.text: Shall I eat the flesh of powerful [bulls], And the blood of he-goats shall I drink?

14727.label: Psalms 50:14
14727.text: Offer thanksgiving as your sacrifice to God, And pay to the Most High your vows;

14728.label: Psalms 50:15
14728.text: And call me in the day of distress. I shall rescue you, and you will glorify me.”

14729.label: Psalms 50:16
14729.text: But to the wicked one God will have to say: “What right do you have to enumerate my regulations, And that you may bear my covenant in your mouth?

14730.label: Psalms 50:17
14730.text: Why, you—you have hated discipline, And you keep throwing my words behind you.

14731.label: Psalms 50:18
14731.text: Whenever you saw a thief, you were even pleased with him; And your sharing was with adulterers.

14732.label: Psalms 50:19
14732.text: Your mouth you have let loose to what is bad, And your tongue you keep attached to deception.

14733.label: Psalms 50:20
14733.text: You sit [and] speak against your own brother, Against the son of your mother you give away a fault.

14734.label: Psalms 50:21
14734.text: These things you have done, and I kept silent. You imagined that I would positively become like you. I am going to reprove you, and I will set things in order before your eyes.

14735.label: Psalms 50:22
14735.text: Understand this, please, YOU forgetters of God, That I may not tear [YOU] to pieces without there being any deliverer.

14736.label: Psalms 50:23
14736.text: The one offering thanksgiving as his sacrifice is the one that glorifies me; And as for the one keeping a set way,I will cause him to see salvation by God.”

14738.label: Psalms 51:1
14738.text: Show me favor, O God, according to your loving-kindness. According to the abundance of your mercies wipe out my transgressions.

14739.label: Psalms 51:2
14739.text: Thoroughly wash me from my error, And cleanse me even from my sin.

14740.label: Psalms 51:3
14740.text: For my transgressions I myself know, And my sin is in front of me constantly.

14741.label: Psalms 51:4
14741.text: Against you, you alone, I have sinned, And what is bad in your eyes I have done, In order that you may prove to be righteous when you speak, That you may be in the clear when you judge.

14742.label: Psalms 51:5
14742.text: Look! With error I was brought forth with birth pains, And in sin my mother conceived me.

14743.label: Psalms 51:6
14743.text: Look! You have taken delight in truthfulness itself in the inward parts; And in the secret self may you cause me to know sheer wisdom.

14744.label: Psalms 51:7
14744.text: May you purify me from sin with hyssop, that I may be clean; May you wash me, that I may become whiter even than snow.

14745.label: Psalms 51:8
14745.text: May you cause me to hear exultation and rejoicing, That the bones that you have crushed may be joyful.

14746.label: Psalms 51:9
14746.text: Conceal your face from my sins, And wipe out even all my errors.

14747.label: Psalms 51:10
14747.text: Create in me even a pure heart, O God, And put within me a new spirit, a steadfast one.

14748.label: Psalms 51:11
14748.text: Do not throw me away from before your face; And your holy spirit O do not take away from me.

14749.label: Psalms 51:12
14749.text: Do restore to me the exultation of salvation by you, And may you support me even with a willing spirit.

14750.label: Psalms 51:13
14750.text: I will teach transgressors your ways, That sinners themselves may turn right back to you.

14751.label: Psalms 51:14
14751.text: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God the God of my salvation, That my tongue may joyfully tell about your righteousness.

14752.label: Psalms 51:15
14752.text: O Jehovah, may you open these lips of mine, That my own mouth may tell forth your praise.

14753.label: Psalms 51:16
14753.text: For you do not take delight in sacrifice—otherwise I would give [it]; In whole burnt offering you do not find pleasure.

14754.label: Psalms 51:17
14754.text: The sacrifices to God are a broken spirit; A heart broken and crushed, O God, you will not despise.

14755.label: Psalms 51:18
14755.text: In your goodwill do deal well with Zion; May you build the walls of Jerusalem.

14756.label: Psalms 51:19
14756.text: In that case you will be delighted with sacrifices of righteousness, With burnt sacrifice and whole offering; In that case bulls will be offered up on your very own altar.

14758.label: Psalms 52:1
14758.text: Why do you make your boast over what is bad, O you mighty one? The loving-kindness of God is all day long.

14759.label: Psalms 52:2
14759.text: Adversities your tongue schemes up, sharpened like a razor, Working deceitfully.

14760.label: Psalms 52:3
14760.text: You have loved what is bad more than what is good, Falsehood more than speaking righteousness. Seʹlah.

14761.label: Psalms 52:4
14761.text: You have loved all devouring words, O you deceitful tongue.

14762.label: Psalms 52:5
14762.text: God himself will also pull you down forever; He will knock you down and tear you away from [your] tent, And he will certainly root you out of the land of the living ones. Seʹlah.

14763.label: Psalms 52:6
14763.text: And the righteous ones will see [it] and will be afraid, And over him they will laugh.

14764.label: Psalms 52:7
14764.text: Here is the able-bodied man that does not put God as his fortress, But that trusts in the abundance of his riches, That takes shelter in adversities by him.

14765.label: Psalms 52:8
14765.text: But I shall be like a luxuriant olive tree in God’s house;I do trust in the loving-kindness of God to time indefinite, even forever.

14766.label: Psalms 52:9
14766.text: I will laud you to time indefinite, for you have taken action; And I shall hope in your name, because it is good, in front of your loyal ones.

14768.label: Psalms 53:1
14768.text: The senseless one has said in his heart:“There is no Jehovah.” They have acted ruinously and have acted detestably in unrighteousness; There is no one doing good.

14769.label: Psalms 53:2
14769.text: As for God, he has looked down from heaven itself upon the sons of men, To see whether there exists anyone having insight, anyone seeking Jehovah.

14770.label: Psalms 53:3
14770.text: They have all of them turned back, they are [all] alike corrupt; There is no one doing good, Not even one.

14771.label: Psalms 53:4
14771.text: Have none of the practicers of what is hurtful got knowledge, Eating up my people as they have eaten bread? They have not called even upon Jehovah.

14772.label: Psalms 53:5
14772.text: There they were filled with a great dread, Where there had proved to be no dread; For God himself will certainly scatter the bones of anyone camping against you. You will certainly put [them] to shame, for Jehovah himself has rejected them.

14773.label: Psalms 53:6
14773.text: O that out of Zion there were the grand salvation of Israel! When Jehovah gathers back the captive ones of his people, Let Jacob be joyful, let Israel rejoice.

14775.label: Psalms 54:1
14775.text: O God, by your name save me, And with your mightiness may you plead my cause.

14776.label: Psalms 54:2
14776.text: O God, hear my prayer; Do give ear to the sayings of my mouth.

14777.label: Psalms 54:3
14777.text: For there are strangers that have risen up against me,And tyrants that do seek my soul. They have not set God in front of them. Seʹlah.

14778.label: Psalms 54:4
14778.text: Look! God is my helper; Jehovah is among those supporting my soul.

14779.label: Psalms 54:5
14779.text: He will repay the bad to my foes; In your trueness silence them.

14780.label: Psalms 54:6
14780.text: In willingness I will sacrifice to you. I shall laud your name, O Jehovah, for it is good.

14781.label: Psalms 54:7
14781.text: For out of every distress he delivered me, And upon my enemies my eye has looked.

14783.label: Psalms 55:1
14783.text: Do give ear, O God, to my prayer; And do not hide yourself from my request for favor.

14784.label: Psalms 55:2
14784.text: Do pay attention to me and answer me. I am driven restlessly about by my concern, And I cannot but show disquietude,

14785.label: Psalms 55:3
14785.text: Due to the voice of the enemy, because of the pressure of the wicked one. For they keep dropping upon me what is hurtful, And in anger they harbor animosity against me.

14786.label: Psalms 55:4
14786.text: My very heart is in severe pain within me, And the frights of death itself have fallen upon me.

14787.label: Psalms 55:5
14787.text: Fear, yes, trembling itself enters into me, And shuddering covers me.

14788.label: Psalms 55:6
14788.text: And I keep saying: “O that I had wings as a dove has! I would fly away and reside.

14789.label: Psalms 55:7
14789.text: Look! I would go far away in flight; I would lodge in the wilderness. —Seʹlah—

14790.label: Psalms 55:8
14790.text: I would hasten to a place of escape for meFrom the rushing wind, from the tempest.”

14791.label: Psalms 55:9
14791.text: Confuse, O Jehovah, divide their tongue, For I have seen violence and disputing in the city.

14792.label: Psalms 55:10
14792.text: Day and night they go round about it upon its walls; And hurtfulness and trouble are within it.

14793.label: Psalms 55:11
14793.text: Adversities are within it;And from its public square oppression and deception have not moved away.

14794.label: Psalms 55:12
14794.text: For it was not an enemy that proceeded to reproach me; Otherwise I could put up with it.It was not an intense hater of me that assumed great airs against me; Otherwise I could conceal myself from him.

14795.label: Psalms 55:13
14795.text: But it was you, a mortal man who was as my equal, One familiar to me and my acquaintance,

14796.label: Psalms 55:14
14796.text: Because we used to enjoy sweet intimacy together; Into the house of God we used to walk with the throng.

14797.label: Psalms 55:15
14797.text: Desolations [be] upon them! Let them go down into Sheʹol alive; For during their alien residence bad things have been within them.

14798.label: Psalms 55:16
14798.text: As for me, to God I shall call out; And Jehovah himself will save me.

14799.label: Psalms 55:17
14799.text: Evening and morning and noontime I cannot but show concern and I moan, And he hears my voice.

14800.label: Psalms 55:18
14800.text: He will certainly redeem [and put] my soul in peace from the fight that is against me, For in multitudes they have come to be against me.

14801.label: Psalms 55:19
14801.text: God will hear and answer them, Even He that is sitting [enthroned] as in the past —Seʹlah—Those with whom there are no changings And who have not feared God.

14802.label: Psalms 55:20
14802.text: He has thrust out his hands against those at peace with him; He has profaned his covenant.

14803.label: Psalms 55:21
14803.text: Smoother than butter are [the words of] his mouth, But his heart is disposed to fight. His words are softer than oil, But they are drawn swords.

14804.label: Psalms 55:22
14804.text: Throw your burden upon Jehovah himself, And he himself will sustain you. Never will he allow the righteous one to totter.

14805.label: Psalms 55:23
14805.text: But you yourself, O God, will bring them down to the lowest pit. As for bloodguilty and deceitful men, they will not live out half their days. But as for me, I shall trust in you.

14807.label: Psalms 56:1
14807.text: Show me favor, O God, because mortal man has snapped at me. Warring all day long, he keeps oppressing me.

14808.label: Psalms 56:2
14808.text: My foes have kept snapping all day long, For there are many warring against me high-mindedly.

14809.label: Psalms 56:3
14809.text: Whatever day I get afraid, I, for my part, shall trust even in you.

14810.label: Psalms 56:4
14810.text: In union with God I shall praise his word. In God I have put my trust; I shall not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

14811.label: Psalms 56:5
14811.text: All day long they keep hurting my personal affairs;All their thoughts are against me for bad.

14812.label: Psalms 56:6
14812.text: They attack, they conceal themselves, They, for their part, keep observing my very steps, While they have waited for my soul.

14813.label: Psalms 56:7
14813.text: On account of [their] hurtfulness cast them forth. In anger bring down even the peoples, O God.

14814.label: Psalms 56:8
14814.text: My being a fugitive you yourself have reported. Do put my tears in your skin bottle. Are they not in your book?

14815.label: Psalms 56:9
14815.text: At that time my enemies will turn back, on the day that I call; This I well know, that God is for me.

14816.label: Psalms 56:10
14816.text: In union with God I shall praise [his] word;In union with Jehovah I shall praise [his] word.

14817.label: Psalms 56:11
14817.text: In God I have put my trust. I shall not be afraid. What can earthling man do to me?

14818.label: Psalms 56:12
14818.text: Upon me, O God, there are vows to you. I shall render expressions of thanksgiving to you.

14819.label: Psalms 56:13
14819.text: For you have delivered my soul from death —[Have you] not [delivered] my feet from stumbling? —That [I] may walk about before God in the light of those alive.

14821.label: Psalms 57:1
14821.text: Show me favor, O God, show me favor, For in you my soul has taken refuge; And in the shadow of your wings I take refuge until the adversities pass over.

14822.label: Psalms 57:2
14822.text: I call to God the Most High, to the [true] God who is bringing [them] to an end on my account.

14823.label: Psalms 57:3
14823.text: He will send from heaven and save me. He will certainly confuse the one snapping at me. Seʹlah.God will send his loving-kindness and his trueness.

14824.label: Psalms 57:4
14824.text: My soul is in the middle of lions; I cannot but lie down among devourers, [even] the sons of men, Whose teeth are spears and arrows, And whose tongue is a sharp sword.

14825.label: Psalms 57:5
14825.text: O be exalted above the heavens, O God; Let your glory be above all the earth.

14826.label: Psalms 57:6
14826.text: A net they have prepared for my steps; My soul has become bowed down. They excavated before me a pitfall;They have fallen into the midst of it. Seʹlah.

14827.label: Psalms 57:7
14827.text: My heart is steadfast, O God, My heart is steadfast.I will sing and make melody.

14828.label: Psalms 57:8
14828.text: Do awake, O my glory; Do awake, O stringed instrument; you too, O harp. I will awaken the dawn.

14829.label: Psalms 57:9
14829.text: I shall laud you among the peoples, O Jehovah; I shall make melody to you among the national groups.

14830.label: Psalms 57:10
14830.text: For your loving-kindness is great up to the heavens, And your trueness up to the skies.

14831.label: Psalms 57:11
14831.text: Do be exalted above the heavens, O God; Let your glory be above all the earth.

14833.label: Psalms 58:1
14833.text: [In YOUR] silence can YOU really speak about righteousness itself? Can YOU judge in uprightness itself, O YOU sons of men?

14834.label: Psalms 58:2
14834.text: How much, rather, do YOU with the heart practice outright unrighteousness in the earth, [And] prepare the road for the very violence of YOUR hands!

14835.label: Psalms 58:3
14835.text: The wicked ones have been perverts from the womb; They have wandered about from the belly onward;They are speaking lies.

14836.label: Psalms 58:4
14836.text: The venom of theirs is like the venom of the serpent, Deaf like the cobra that stops up its ear,

14837.label: Psalms 58:5
14837.text: That will not listen to the voice of charmers, Though someone wise is binding with spells.

14838.label: Psalms 58:6
14838.text: O God, knock out their teeth in their mouth. Break down the very jawbones of maned young lions, O Jehovah.

14839.label: Psalms 58:7
14839.text: May they dissolve as into waters that go their way; May he bend [the bow for] his arrows as they collapse.

14840.label: Psalms 58:8
14840.text: Like a snail melting away he walks; Like a miscarriage of a woman they will certainly not behold the sun.

14841.label: Psalms 58:9
14841.text: Before YOUR pots feel the [kindled] bramble, The live green as well as the burning, he will carry them off as a stormy wind.

14842.label: Psalms 58:10
14842.text: The righteous one will rejoice because he has beheld the vengeance. His steps he will bathe in the blood of the wicked one.

14843.label: Psalms 58:11
14843.text: And mankind will say: “Surely there is fruitage for the righteous one. Surely there exists a God that is judging in the earth.”

14845.label: Psalms 59:1
14845.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; From those rising up against me may you protect me.

14846.label: Psalms 59:2
14846.text: Deliver me from the practicers of what is hurtful, And from bloodguilty men save me.

14847.label: Psalms 59:3
14847.text: For, look! they have lain in wait for my soul; Strong ones make an attack upon me, For no revolt on my part, nor any sin on my part, O Jehovah.

14848.label: Psalms 59:4
14848.text: Though there is no error, they run and get themselves ready. Do rouse yourself at my calling and see.

14849.label: Psalms 59:5
14849.text: And you, O Jehovah God of armies, are the God of Israel. Do wake up to turn your attention to all the nations. Do not show favor to any hurtful traitors. Seʹlah.

14850.label: Psalms 59:6
14850.text: They keep returning at evening time; They keep barking like a dog and go all around the city.

14851.label: Psalms 59:7
14851.text: Look! They make a bubbling forth with their mouth; Swords are on their lips, For who is listening?

14852.label: Psalms 59:8
14852.text: But you yourself, O Jehovah, will laugh at them; You will hold all the nations in derision.

14853.label: Psalms 59:9
14853.text: O my Strength, toward you I will keep watch; For God is my secure height.

14854.label: Psalms 59:10
14854.text: The God of loving-kindness to me will himself confront me; God himself will cause me to look upon my foes.

14855.label: Psalms 59:11
14855.text: Do not kill them, that my people may not forget. By your vital energy make them wander about, And bring them down, O our shield Jehovah,

14856.label: Psalms 59:12
14856.text: [For] the sin of their mouth, the word of their lips; And may they be caught in their pride, Even for the cursing and the deception that they rehearse.

14857.label: Psalms 59:13
14857.text: Bring [them] to an end in rage; Bring [them] to an end, that they may not be;And may they know that God is ruling in Jacob to the ends of the earth. Seʹlah.

14858.label: Psalms 59:14
14858.text: And let them return at evening time;Let them bark like a dog and go all around the city.

14859.label: Psalms 59:15
14859.text: Let those very ones wander about for something to eat; Let them not be satisfied or stay overnight.

14860.label: Psalms 59:16
14860.text: But as for me, I shall sing of your strength, And in the morning I shall joyfully tell about your loving-kindness. For you have proved to be a secure height for me And a place to which to flee in the day of my distress.

14861.label: Psalms 59:17
14861.text: O my Strength, to you I will make melody, For God is my secure height, the God of loving-kindness to me.

14863.label: Psalms 60:1
14863.text: O God, you have cast us off, you have broken through us, You have become incensed. You should restore us.

14864.label: Psalms 60:2
14864.text: You have caused the earth to rock, you have split it open. Heal its breaches, for it has tottered.

14865.label: Psalms 60:3
14865.text: You have caused your people to see hardship. You have made us drink wine sending us reeling.

14866.label: Psalms 60:4
14866.text: You have given to those fearing you a signal To flee zigzag on account of the bow. Seʹlah.

14867.label: Psalms 60:5
14867.text: In order that your beloved ones may be rescued, O do save with your right hand and answer us.

14868.label: Psalms 60:6
14868.text: God himself has spoken in his holiness: “I will exult, I will give out Sheʹchem as a portion; And the low plain of Sucʹcoth I shall measure off.

14869.label: Psalms 60:7
14869.text: Gilʹe·ad belongs to me and Ma·nasʹseh belongs to me, And Eʹphra·im is the fortress of my head one;Judah is my commander’s staff.

14870.label: Psalms 60:8
14870.text: Moʹab is my washing pot. Over Eʹdom I shall throw my sandal. Over Phi·lisʹti·a I shall shout in triumph.”

14871.label: Psalms 60:9
14871.text: Who will bring me to the besieged city? Who will certainly lead me as far as Eʹdom?

14872.label: Psalms 60:10
14872.text: Is it not you, O God, who have cast us off And who do not go forth with our armies as God?

14873.label: Psalms 60:11
14873.text: Do give us assistance from distress, As salvation by earthling man is worthless.

14874.label: Psalms 60:12
14874.text: By God we shall gain vital energy, And he himself will tread down our adversaries.

14876.label: Psalms 61:1
14876.text: Do hear, O God, my entreating cry. Do pay attention to my prayer.

14877.label: Psalms 61:2
14877.text: From the extremity of the earth I shall cry, even to you, when my heart grows feeble. Onto a rock that is higher than I am may you lead me.

14878.label: Psalms 61:3
14878.text: For you have proved to be a refuge for me, A strong tower in the face of the enemy.

14879.label: Psalms 61:4
14879.text: I will be a guest in your tent for times indefinite; I will take refuge in the concealment of your wings. Seʹlah.

14880.label: Psalms 61:5
14880.text: For you yourself, O God, have listened to my vows. You have given [me] the possession of those fearing your name.

14881.label: Psalms 61:6
14881.text: Days you will add to the days of the king; His years will be like generation after generation.

14882.label: Psalms 61:7
14882.text: He will dwell to time indefinite before God; O assign loving-kindness and trueness, that these may safeguard him.

14883.label: Psalms 61:8
14883.text: So I will make melody to your name forever, That I may pay my vows day after day.

14885.label: Psalms 62:1
14885.text: Indeed toward God is my soul [waiting in] silence. From him my salvation is.

14886.label: Psalms 62:2
14886.text: Indeed he is my rock and my salvation, my secure height; I shall not be made to totter very much.

14887.label: Psalms 62:3
14887.text: How long will YOU carry on frantically against the man whom YOU would murder? All of YOU are like a leaning wall, a stone wall that is being pushed in.

14888.label: Psalms 62:4
14888.text: Indeed they give advice so as to allure from one’s own dignity; They take pleasure in a lie. With their mouth they bless, but inside themselves they call down evil. Seʹlah.

14889.label: Psalms 62:5
14889.text: Indeed toward God wait silently, O my soul, Because from him is my hope.

14890.label: Psalms 62:6
14890.text: Indeed he is my rock and my salvation, my secure height; I shall not be made to totter.

14891.label: Psalms 62:7
14891.text: Upon God are my salvation and my glory. My strong rock, my refuge is in God.

14892.label: Psalms 62:8
14892.text: Trust in him at all times, O people. Before him pour out YOUR heart. God is a refuge for us. Seʹlah.

14893.label: Psalms 62:9
14893.text: Indeed the sons of earthling man are an exhalation, The sons of mankind are a lie. When laid upon the scales they are all together lighter than an exhalation.

14894.label: Psalms 62:10
14894.text: Do not put YOUR trust in defrauding, Nor become vain in sheer robbery. In case the means of maintenance should thrive, do not set YOUR heart [on them].

14895.label: Psalms 62:11
14895.text: Once God has spoken, twice I have heard even this, That strength belongs to God.

14896.label: Psalms 62:12
14896.text: Also loving-kindness belongs to you, O Jehovah, For you yourself pay back to each one according to his work.

14898.label: Psalms 63:1
14898.text: O God, you are my God, I keep looking for you. My soul does thirst for you. For you my flesh has grown faint [with longing]In a land dry and exhausted, where there is no water.

14899.label: Psalms 63:2
14899.text: Thus I have beheld you in the holy place, At seeing your strength and your glory.

14900.label: Psalms 63:3
14900.text: Because your loving-kindness is better than life, My own lips will commend you.

14901.label: Psalms 63:4
14901.text: Thus I shall bless you during my lifetime; In your name I shall raise my palms.

14902.label: Psalms 63:5
14902.text: As with the best part, even fatness, my soul is satisfied, And with lips of joyful cries my mouth offers praise.

14903.label: Psalms 63:6
14903.text: When I have remembered you upon my lounge, During the night watches I meditate on you.

14904.label: Psalms 63:7
14904.text: For you have proved to be of assistance to me, And in the shadow of your wings I cry out joyfully.

14905.label: Psalms 63:8
14905.text: My soul has closely followed you; On me your right hand keeps fast hold.

14906.label: Psalms 63:9
14906.text: As for those who keep seeking my soul for [its] ruin, They will come into the lowest parts of the earth.

14907.label: Psalms 63:10
14907.text: They will be delivered over to the power of the sword; They will become a mere portion for foxes.

14908.label: Psalms 63:11
14908.text: And the king himself will rejoice in God. Every one swearing by him will boast, For the mouth of those speaking falsehood will be stopped up.

14910.label: Psalms 64:1
14910.text: Hear, O God, my voice in my concern. From the dreadfulness of the enemy may you safeguard my life.

14911.label: Psalms 64:2
14911.text: May you conceal me from the confidential talk of evildoers, From the tumult of practicers of hurtfulness,

14912.label: Psalms 64:3
14912.text: Who have sharpened their tongue just like a sword, Who have aimed their arrow, bitter speech,

14913.label: Psalms 64:4
14913.text: To shoot from concealed places at someone blameless. All of a sudden they shoot at him and do not fear.

14914.label: Psalms 64:5
14914.text: They hold themselves down to bad speech; They make statements about hiding traps. They have said: “Who sees them?”

14915.label: Psalms 64:6
14915.text: They keep searching out unrighteous things; They have hidden a shrewd device well searched out, And the inward part of each one, even [his] heart, is deep.

14916.label: Psalms 64:7
14916.text: But God will shoot at them with an arrow suddenly. Wounds have resulted to them,

14917.label: Psalms 64:8
14917.text: And they cause one to stumble. [But] their tongue is against their own selves. All those looking upon them will shake their head,

14918.label: Psalms 64:9
14918.text: And all earthling men will become afraid; And they will tell of the activity of God, And they will certainly have insight into his work.

14919.label: Psalms 64:10
14919.text: And the righteous one will rejoice in Jehovah and will indeed take refuge in him; And all the upright in heart will boast.

14921.label: Psalms 65:1
14921.text: For you there is praise—silence—, O God, in Zion; And to you the vow will be paid.

14922.label: Psalms 65:2
14922.text: O Hearer of prayer, even to you people of all flesh will come.

14923.label: Psalms 65:3
14923.text: Things of error have proved mightier than I am. As for our transgressions, you yourself will cover them.

14924.label: Psalms 65:4
14924.text: Happy is the one you choose and cause to approach, That he may reside in your courtyards. We will certainly be satisfied with the goodness of your house, The holy place of your temple.

14925.label: Psalms 65:5
14925.text: With fear-inspiring things in righteousness you will answer us, O God of our salvation, The Trust of all the borders of the earth and those far away on the sea.

14926.label: Psalms 65:6
14926.text: He is firmly establishing the mountains with his power; He is indeed girded with mightiness.

14927.label: Psalms 65:7
14927.text: He is stilling the noise of the seas, The noise of their waves and the turmoil of the national groups.

14928.label: Psalms 65:8
14928.text: And the inhabitants of the uttermost parts will be afraid of your signs; The goings forth of the morning and evening you cause to cry out joyfully.

14929.label: Psalms 65:9
14929.text: You have turned your attention to the earth, that you may give it abundance; You enrich it very much.The stream from God is full of water. You prepare their grain, For that is the way you prepare the earth.

14930.label: Psalms 65:10
14930.text: There is a drenching of its furrows, a leveling off of its clods; With copious showers you soften it; you bless its very sprouts.

14931.label: Psalms 65:11
14931.text: You have crowned the year with your goodness, And your very tracks drip with fatness.

14932.label: Psalms 65:12
14932.text: The pasture grounds of the wilderness keep dripping, And with joyfulness the very hills gird themselves.

14933.label: Psalms 65:13
14933.text: The pastures have become clothed with flocks, And the low plains themselves are enveloped with grain. They shout in triumph, yes, they sing.

14935.label: Psalms 66:1
14935.text: Shout in triumph to God, all [YOU people of] the earth.

14936.label: Psalms 66:2
14936.text: Make melody to the glory of his name. Render his praise glorious.

14937.label: Psalms 66:3
14937.text: Say to God: “How fear-inspiring your works are! Because of the abundance of your strength your enemies will come cringing to you.

14938.label: Psalms 66:4
14938.text: All [people of] the earth will bow down to you, And they will make melody to you, they will make melody to your name.” Seʹlah.

14939.label: Psalms 66:5
14939.text: Come, YOU people, and see the activities of God. His dealing with the sons of men is fear-inspiring.

14940.label: Psalms 66:6
14940.text: He has changed the sea into dry land; Through the river they went crossing over on foot. There we began to rejoice in him.

14941.label: Psalms 66:7
14941.text: He is ruling by his mightiness to time indefinite. Upon the nations his own eyes keep watch. As for those who are stubborn, let them not be exalted in themselves. Seʹlah.

14942.label: Psalms 66:8
14942.text: Bless our God, O YOU peoples, And cause the voice of praise to him to be heard.

14943.label: Psalms 66:9
14943.text: He is setting our soul in life, And he has not allowed our foot to totter.

14944.label: Psalms 66:10
14944.text: For you have examined us, O God; You have refined us as when refining silver.

14945.label: Psalms 66:11
14945.text: You have brought us into a hunting net; You have put pressure on our hips.

14946.label: Psalms 66:12
14946.text: You have made mortal man to ride over our head; We have come through fire and through water, And you proceeded to bring us forth to relief.

14947.label: Psalms 66:13
14947.text: I shall come into your house with whole burnt offerings; I shall pay to you my vows

14948.label: Psalms 66:14
14948.text: That my lips have opened up to say And that my mouth has spoken when I was in sore straits.

14949.label: Psalms 66:15
14949.text: Whole burnt offerings of fatlings I shall offer up to you, With the sacrificial smoke of rams.I shall render up a bull with he-goats. Seʹlah.

14950.label: Psalms 66:16
14950.text: Come, listen, all YOU who fear God, and I will relate What he has done for my soul.

14951.label: Psalms 66:17
14951.text: To him I called with my mouth, And there was an extolling with my tongue.

14952.label: Psalms 66:18
14952.text: If I have regarded anything hurtful in my heart,Jehovah will not hear [me].

14953.label: Psalms 66:19
14953.text: Truly God has heard; He has paid attention to the voice of my prayer.

14954.label: Psalms 66:20
14954.text: Blessed be God, who has not turned aside my prayer,Nor his loving-kindness from me.

14956.label: Psalms 67:1
14956.text: God himself will show us favor and bless us; He will make his face shine upon us —Seʹlah—

14957.label: Psalms 67:2
14957.text: That your way may be known in the earth, Your salvation even among all the nations.

14958.label: Psalms 67:3
14958.text: Let peoples laud you, O God; Let the peoples, all of them, laud you.

14959.label: Psalms 67:4
14959.text: Let national groups rejoice and cry out joyfully, For you will judge the peoples with uprightness; And as for national groups, on the earth you will lead them. Seʹlah.

14960.label: Psalms 67:5
14960.text: Let peoples laud you, O God; Let peoples, all of them, laud you.

14961.label: Psalms 67:6
14961.text: The earth itself will certainly give its produce; God, our God, will bless us.

14962.label: Psalms 67:7
14962.text: God will bless us, And all the ends of the earth will fear him.

14964.label: Psalms 68:1
14964.text: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered, And let those who intensely hate him flee because of him.

14965.label: Psalms 68:2
14965.text: As smoke is driven away, may you drive [them] away; As wax melts because of the fire, Let the wicked ones perish from before God.

14966.label: Psalms 68:3
14966.text: But as for the righteous, let them rejoice, Let them be elated before God, And let them exult with rejoicing.

14967.label: Psalms 68:4
14967.text: Sing YOU to God, make melody to his name; Raise up [a song] to the One riding through the desert plains As Jah, which is his name; and jubilate before him;

14968.label: Psalms 68:5
14968.text: A father of fatherless boys and a judge of widows Is God in his holy dwelling.

14969.label: Psalms 68:6
14969.text: God is causing the solitary ones to dwell in a house; He is bringing forth prisoners into full prosperity. However, as for the stubborn, they have to reside in a scorched land.

14970.label: Psalms 68:7
14970.text: O God, when you went forth before your people, When you marched through the desert —Seʹlah—

14971.label: Psalms 68:8
14971.text: The earth itself rocked, Heaven itself also dripped because of God; This Siʹnai [rocked] because of God, the God of Israel.

14972.label: Psalms 68:9
14972.text: A copious downpour you began causing to fall, O God; Your inheritance, even when it was weary—you yourself reinvigorated it.

14973.label: Psalms 68:10
14973.text: Your tent community —they have dwelt in it; With your goodness you proceeded to make it ready for the afflicted one, O God.

14974.label: Psalms 68:11
14974.text: Jehovah himself gives the saying; The women telling the good news are a large army.

14975.label: Psalms 68:12
14975.text: Even the kings of armies flee, they flee. As for her who abides at home, she shares in the spoil.

14976.label: Psalms 68:13
14976.text: Although YOU men kept lying between the [camp] ash heaps, There will be the wings of a dove covered with silverAnd its pinions with yellowish-green gold.

14977.label: Psalms 68:14
14977.text: When the Almighty One scattered abroad the kings in it, It began to snow in Zalʹmon.

14978.label: Psalms 68:15
14978.text: The mountainous region of Baʹshan is a mountain of God; The mountainous region of Baʹshan is a mountain of peaks.

14979.label: Psalms 68:16
14979.text: Why do YOU, O YOU mountains of peaks, keep watching enviouslyThe mountain that God has desired for himself to dwell in? Even Jehovah himself will reside [there] forever.

14980.label: Psalms 68:17
14980.text: The war chariots of God are in tens of thousands, thousands over and over again. Jehovah himself has come from Siʹnai into the holy place.

14981.label: Psalms 68:18
14981.text: You have ascended on high; You have carried away captives; You have taken gifts in the form of men, Yes, even the stubborn ones, to reside [among them], O Jah God.

14982.label: Psalms 68:19
14982.text: Blessed be Jehovah, who daily carries the load for us, The [true] God of our salvation. Seʹlah.

14983.label: Psalms 68:20
14983.text: The [true] God is for us a God of saving acts; And to Jehovah the Sovereign Lord belong the ways out from death.

14984.label: Psalms 68:21
14984.text: Indeed God himself will break the head of his enemies in pieces, The hairy crown of the head of anyone walking about in his guiltiness.

14985.label: Psalms 68:22
14985.text: Jehovah has said: “From Baʹshan I shall bring back, I shall bring [them] back from the depths of the sea,

14986.label: Psalms 68:23
14986.text: In order that you may wash your foot in blood, That the tongue of your dogs may have its portion from the enemies.”

14987.label: Psalms 68:24
14987.text: They have seen your processions, O God, The processions of my God, my King, into the holy place.

14988.label: Psalms 68:25
14988.text: The singers went in front, the players on stringed instruments after them; In between were the maidens beating tambourines.

14989.label: Psalms 68:26
14989.text: In congregated throngs bless God, Jehovah, [O YOU who are] from the Source of Israel.

14990.label: Psalms 68:27
14990.text: There is little Benjamin subduing them, The princes of Judah with their shouting crowd,The princes of Zebʹu·lun, the princes of Naphʹta·li.

14991.label: Psalms 68:28
14991.text: Your God has laid command upon your strength. Do show strength, O God, you who have acted for us.

14992.label: Psalms 68:29
14992.text: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, Kings will bring gifts to you yourself.

14993.label: Psalms 68:30
14993.text: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, the assembly of bulls, With the calves of the peoples, each one stamping down on pieces of silver. He has scattered the peoples that take delight in fights.

14994.label: Psalms 68:31
14994.text: Bronzeware things will come out of Egypt; Cush itself will quickly stretch out its hands [with gifts] to God.

14995.label: Psalms 68:32
14995.text: O YOU kingdoms of the earth, sing to God, Make melody to Jehovah —Seʹlah—

14996.label: Psalms 68:33
14996.text: To the One riding on the ancient heaven of heavens. Lo! He sounds with his voice, a strong voice.

14997.label: Psalms 68:34
14997.text: ASCRIBE strength to God. Over Israel his eminence is and his strength is in the clouds.

14998.label: Psalms 68:35
14998.text: God is fear-inspiring out of your grand sanctuary. The God of Israel he is, giving strength, even might to the people. Blessed be God.

15000.label: Psalms 69:1
15000.text: Save me, O God, for the waters have come clear to the soul.

15001.label: Psalms 69:2
15001.text: I have sunk down in deep mire, where there is no standing ground. I have come into profound waters,And a flowing stream itself has washed me away.

15002.label: Psalms 69:3
15002.text: I have become tired by my calling out; My throat has become hoarse.My eyes have failed while waiting for my God.

15003.label: Psalms 69:4
15003.text: Those hating me without a cause have become even more than the hairs of my head. Those bringing me to silence, being my enemies for no reason, have become numerous. What I had not taken by robbery I then proceeded to give back.

15004.label: Psalms 69:5
15004.text: O God, you yourself have come to know my foolishness,And from you my own guiltiness has not been hidden.

15005.label: Psalms 69:6
15005.text: O may those hoping in you not be ashamed because of me, O Sovereign Lord, Jehovah of armies. O may those seeking you not be humiliated because of me, O God of Israel.

15006.label: Psalms 69:7
15006.text: For on your account I have borne reproach, Humiliation has covered my face.

15007.label: Psalms 69:8
15007.text: I have become one estranged to my brothers, And a foreigner to the sons of my mother.

15008.label: Psalms 69:9
15008.text: For sheer zeal for your house has eaten me up, And the very reproaches of those reproaching you have fallen upon me.

15009.label: Psalms 69:10
15009.text: And I proceeded to weep with the fasting of my soul, But it came to be for reproaches to me.

15010.label: Psalms 69:11
15010.text: When I made sackcloth my clothing,Then I became to them a proverbial saying.

15011.label: Psalms 69:12
15011.text: Those sitting in the gate began concerning themselves about me, And [I was] the subject of the songs of drinkers of intoxicating liquor.

15012.label: Psalms 69:13
15012.text: But as for me, my prayer was to you, O Jehovah, At an acceptable time, O God. In the abundance of your loving-kindness answer me with the truth of salvation by you.

15013.label: Psalms 69:14
15013.text: Deliver me from the mire, that I may not sink down. O may I be delivered from those hating me and from the deep waters.

15014.label: Psalms 69:15
15014.text: O may not the flowing stream of waters wash me away, Nor the depth swallow me up,Nor the well close its mouth over me.

15015.label: Psalms 69:16
15015.text: Answer me, O Jehovah, for your loving-kindness is good. According to the multitude of your mercies turn to me,

15016.label: Psalms 69:17
15016.text: And do not conceal your face from your servant. Because I am in sore straits, answer me quickly.

15017.label: Psalms 69:18
15017.text: Do come near to my soul, reclaim it; On account of my enemies redeem me.

15018.label: Psalms 69:19
15018.text: You yourself have come to know my reproach and my shame and my humiliation. All those showing hostility to me are in front of you.

15019.label: Psalms 69:20
15019.text: Reproach itself has broken my heart, and [the wound] is incurable. And I kept hoping for someone to show sympathy, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.

15020.label: Psalms 69:21
15020.text: But for food they gave [me] a poisonous plant, And for my thirst they tried to make me drink vinegar.

15021.label: Psalms 69:22
15021.text: Let their table before them become a trap, And what is for their welfare a snare.

15022.label: Psalms 69:23
15022.text: Let their eyes become darkened so as not to see; And cause their very hips to wobble constantly.

15023.label: Psalms 69:24
15023.text: Pour out upon them your denunciation, And may your own burning anger overtake them.

15024.label: Psalms 69:25
15024.text: Let their walled camp become desolate; In their tents may there come to be no dweller.

15025.label: Psalms 69:26
15025.text: For the one whom you yourself have struck they have pursued, And the pains of those pierced by you they keep recounting.

15026.label: Psalms 69:27
15026.text: Do give error upon their error, And may they not come into your righteousness.

15027.label: Psalms 69:28
15027.text: Let them be wiped out of the book of the living ones, And with the righteous ones may they not be written in.

15028.label: Psalms 69:29
15028.text: But I am afflicted and aching. May your own salvation, O God, protect me.

15029.label: Psalms 69:30
15029.text: I will praise the name of God with song, And I will magnify him with thanksgiving.

15030.label: Psalms 69:31
15030.text: This will also be more pleasing to Jehovah than a bull, Than a young bull displaying horns, splitting the hoof.

15031.label: Psalms 69:32
15031.text: The meek ones will certainly see [it]; they will rejoice. YOU who are seeking God, let YOUR heart also keep alive.

15032.label: Psalms 69:33
15032.text: For Jehovah is listening to the poor ones, And he will indeed not despise his very own prisoners.

15033.label: Psalms 69:34
15033.text: Let heaven and earth praise him, The seas and everything moving about in them.

15034.label: Psalms 69:35
15034.text: For God himself will save Zion And will build the cities of Judah; And they will certainly dwell there and take possession of it.

15035.label: Psalms 69:36
15035.text: And the offspring of his servants themselves will inherit it, And those loving his name will be the ones to reside in it.

15037.label: Psalms 70:1
15037.text: O God, to deliver me, O Jehovah, to my assistance do make haste.

15038.label: Psalms 70:2
15038.text: May those be ashamed and abashed who are seeking my soul. May those turn back and be humiliated who are taking delight in my calamity.

15039.label: Psalms 70:3
15039.text: May those go back by reason of their shame who are saying: “Aha, aha!”

15040.label: Psalms 70:4
15040.text: May those exult and rejoice in you, all of whom are seeking you, And may they say constantly: “God be magnified!”—those loving your salvation.

15041.label: Psalms 70:5
15041.text: But I am afflicted and poor. O God, do act quickly for me. You are my help and the Provider of escape for me. O Jehovah, do not be too late.

15042.label: Psalms 71:1
15042.text: In you, O Jehovah, I have taken refuge. O may I never be ashamed.

15043.label: Psalms 71:2
15043.text: In your righteousness may you deliver me and provide me with escape. Incline to me your ear and save me.

15044.label: Psalms 71:3
15044.text: Become to me a rock fortress into which to enter constantly. You must command to save me, For you are my crag and my stronghold.

15045.label: Psalms 71:4
15045.text: O my God, provide me with escape from the hand of the wicked one, From the palm of the one acting unjustly and oppressively.

15046.label: Psalms 71:5
15046.text: For you are my hope, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah, my confidence from my youth.

15047.label: Psalms 71:6
15047.text: Upon you I have supported myself from the belly; You are the One severing me even from the inward parts of my mother. In you my praise is constantly.

15048.label: Psalms 71:7
15048.text: I have become just like a miracle to many people; But you are my strong refuge.

15049.label: Psalms 71:8
15049.text: My mouth is filled with your praise, All day long with your beauty.

15050.label: Psalms 71:9
15050.text: Do not throw me away in the time of old age; Just when my power is failing, do not leave me.

15051.label: Psalms 71:10
15051.text: For my enemies have said in regard to me, And the very ones keeping watch for my soul have jointly exchanged counsel,

15052.label: Psalms 71:11
15052.text: Saying: “God himself has left him. Pursue and catch him, for there is no deliverer.”

15053.label: Psalms 71:12
15053.text: O God, do not keep far away from me. O my God, do hurry to my assistance.

15054.label: Psalms 71:13
15054.text: May those be ashamed, may those come to their end, who are resisting my soul. May those cover themselves with reproach and humiliation who are seeking calamity for me.

15055.label: Psalms 71:14
15055.text: But as for me, I shall wait constantly, And I will add to all your praise.

15056.label: Psalms 71:15
15056.text: My own mouth will recount your righteousness, All day long your salvation, For I have not come to know the numbers [of them].

15057.label: Psalms 71:16
15057.text: I shall come in grand mightiness, O Sovereign Lord Jehovah;I shall mention your righteousness, yours alone.

15058.label: Psalms 71:17
15058.text: O God, you have taught me from my youth on, And until now I keep telling about your wonderful works.

15059.label: Psalms 71:18
15059.text: And even until old age and gray-headedness, O God, do not leave me, Until I may tell about your arm to the generation, To all those who are to come, about your mightiness.

15060.label: Psalms 71:19
15060.text: Your righteousness, O God, is up to the height; As respects the great things that you have done, O God, who is like you?

15061.label: Psalms 71:20
15061.text: Because you have made me see many distresses and calamities, May you revive me again; And from the watery deeps of the earth may you again bring me up.

15062.label: Psalms 71:21
15062.text: May you enlarge my greatness, And may you surround [and] comfort me.

15063.label: Psalms 71:22
15063.text: I too, I shall laud you on an instrument of a stringed sort, As regards your trueness, O my God. I will make melody to you on the harp, O Holy One of Israel.

15064.label: Psalms 71:23
15064.text: My lips will cry out joyfully when I am inclined to make melody to you, Even my soul that you have redeemed.

15065.label: Psalms 71:24
15065.text: Also, my own tongue, all day long, will utter in an undertone your righteousness, For they have become ashamed, for they have become abashed, who are seeking calamity for me.

15067.label: Psalms 72:1
15067.text: O God, give your own judicial decisions to the king, And your righteousness to the son of the king.

15068.label: Psalms 72:2
15068.text: May he plead the cause of your people with righteousness And of your afflicted ones with judicial decision.

15069.label: Psalms 72:3
15069.text: Let the mountains carry peace to the people, Also the hills, through righteousness.

15070.label: Psalms 72:4
15070.text: Let him judge the afflicted ones of the people, Let him save the sons of the poor one,And let him crush the defrauder.

15071.label: Psalms 72:5
15071.text: They will fear you as long as there is a sun, And before the moon for generation after generation.

15072.label: Psalms 72:6
15072.text: He will descend like the rain upon the mown grass, Like copious showers that wet the earth.

15073.label: Psalms 72:7
15073.text: In his days the righteous one will sprout, And the abundance of peace until the moon is no more.

15074.label: Psalms 72:8
15074.text: And he will have subjects from sea to sea And from the River to the ends of the earth.

15075.label: Psalms 72:9
15075.text: Before him the inhabitants of waterless regions will bow down, And his very enemies will lick the dust itself.

15076.label: Psalms 72:10
15076.text: The kings of Tarʹshish and of the islands —Tribute they will pay. The kings of Sheʹba and of Seʹba—A gift they will present.

15077.label: Psalms 72:11
15077.text: And to him all the kings will prostrate themselves; All the nations, for their part, will serve him.

15078.label: Psalms 72:12
15078.text: For he will deliver the poor one crying for help, Also the afflicted one and whoever has no helper.

15079.label: Psalms 72:13
15079.text: He will feel sorry for the lowly one and the poor one, And the souls of the poor ones he will save.

15080.label: Psalms 72:14
15080.text: From oppression and from violence he will redeem their soul,And their blood will be precious in his eyes.

15081.label: Psalms 72:15
15081.text: And let him live, and to him let some of the gold of Sheʹba be given. And in his behalf let prayer be made constantly;All day long let him be blessed.

15082.label: Psalms 72:16
