15082.text: There will come to be plenty of grain on the earth; On the top of the mountains there will be an overflow. His fruit will be as in Lebʹa·non, And those who are from the city will blossom like the vegetation of the earth.

15083.label: Psalms 72:17
15083.text: Let his name prove to be to time indefinite; Before the sun let his name have increase,And by means of him let them bless themselves; Let all nations pronounce him happy.

15084.label: Psalms 72:18
15084.text: Blessed be Jehovah God, Israel’s God, Who alone is doing wonderful works.

15085.label: Psalms 72:19
15085.text: And blessed be his glorious name to time indefinite, And let his glory fill the whole earth. Amen and Amen.

15086.label: Psalms 72:20
15086.text: The prayers of David, the son of Jesʹse, have come to their end.

15088.label: Psalms 73:1
15088.text: God is indeed good to Israel, to those clean in heart.

15089.label: Psalms 73:2
15089.text: As for me, my feet had almost turned aside, My steps had nearly been made to slip.

15090.label: Psalms 73:3
15090.text: For I became envious of the boasters, [When] I would see the very peace of wicked people.

15091.label: Psalms 73:4
15091.text: For they have no deathly pangs; And their paunch is fat.

15092.label: Psalms 73:5
15092.text: They are not even in the trouble of mortal man, And they are not plagued the same as other men.

15093.label: Psalms 73:6
15093.text: Therefore haughtiness has served as a necklace to them; Violence envelops them as a garment.

15094.label: Psalms 73:7
15094.text: Their eye has bulged from fatness; They have exceeded the imaginations of the heart.

15095.label: Psalms 73:8
15095.text: They scoff and speak about what is bad; About defrauding they speak in an elevated style.

15096.label: Psalms 73:9
15096.text: They have put their mouth in the very heavens, And their tongue itself walks about in the earth.

15097.label: Psalms 73:10
15097.text: Therefore he brings his people back hither,And the waters of what is full are drained out for them.

15098.label: Psalms 73:11
15098.text: And they have said: “How has God come to know? And does there exist knowledge in the Most High?”

15099.label: Psalms 73:12
15099.text: Look! These are the wicked, who are at ease indefinitely. They have increased [their] means of maintenance.

15100.label: Psalms 73:13
15100.text: Surely it is in vain that I have cleansed my heart And that I wash my hands in innocence itself.

15101.label: Psalms 73:14
15101.text: And I came to be plagued all day long, And my correction is every morning.

15102.label: Psalms 73:15
15102.text: If I had said: “I will tell a story like that,”Look! against the generation of your sonsI should have acted treacherously.

15103.label: Psalms 73:16
15103.text: And I kept considering so as to know this; It was a trouble in my eyes,

15104.label: Psalms 73:17
15104.text: Until I proceeded to come into the grand sanctuary of God. I wanted to discern their future.

15105.label: Psalms 73:18
15105.text: Surely on slippery ground is where you place them. You have made them fall to ruins.

15106.label: Psalms 73:19
15106.text: O how they have become an object of astonishment as in a moment! [How] they have reached their end, have been brought to their finish through sudden terrors!

15107.label: Psalms 73:20
15107.text: Like a dream after awaking, O Jehovah, [So] when arousing [yourself] you will despise their very image.

15108.label: Psalms 73:21
15108.text: For my heart was soured And in my kidneys I was sharply pained,

15109.label: Psalms 73:22
15109.text: And I was unreasoning and I could not know; I became as mere beasts from your standpoint.

15110.label: Psalms 73:23
15110.text: But I am constantly with you; You have taken hold of my right hand.

15111.label: Psalms 73:24
15111.text: With your counsel you will lead me, And afterward you will take me even to glory.

15112.label: Psalms 73:25
15112.text: Whom do I have in the heavens? And besides you I do have no other delight on the earth.

15113.label: Psalms 73:26
15113.text: My organism and my heart have failed. God is the rock of my heart and my share to time indefinite.

15114.label: Psalms 73:27
15114.text: For, look! the very ones keeping away from you will perish. You will certainly silence every one immorally leaving you.

15115.label: Psalms 73:28
15115.text: But as for me, the drawing near to God is good for me. In the Sovereign Lord Jehovah I have placed my refuge, To declare all your works.

15117.label: Psalms 74:1
15117.text: Why, O God, have you cast off forever? Why does your anger keep smoking against the flock of your pasturage?

15118.label: Psalms 74:2
15118.text: Remember your assembly that you acquired long ago, The tribe that you redeemed as your inheritance, This Mount Zion in which you have resided.

15119.label: Psalms 74:3
15119.text: Do lift up your steps to the long-lasting desolations. Everything the enemy has treated badly in the holy place.

15120.label: Psalms 74:4
15120.text: Those showing hostility to you have roared in the middle of your meeting place. They have set their own signs as [the] signs.

15121.label: Psalms 74:5
15121.text: One is notorious in being like him that brings up axes on high against a thicket of trees.

15122.label: Psalms 74:6
15122.text: And now the very engravings of it, one and all, they strike even with hatchet and iron-tipped beams.

15123.label: Psalms 74:7
15123.text: They have thrust your sanctuary into the fire itself. They have profaned the tabernacle of your name to the very earth.

15124.label: Psalms 74:8
15124.text: They, even their offspring, have said together in their own heart:“All the meeting places of God must be burned in the land.”

15125.label: Psalms 74:9
15125.text: Our signs we have not seen; there is no prophet anymore, And there is no one with us knowing how long.

15126.label: Psalms 74:10
15126.text: How long, O God, will the adversary keep reproaching? Will the enemy keep treating your name with disrespect forever?

15127.label: Psalms 74:11
15127.text: Why do you keep your hand, even your right hand, withdrawn From the midst of your bosom to make an end [of us]?

15128.label: Psalms 74:12
15128.text: And yet God is my King from long ago, The One performing grand salvation in the midst of the earth.

15129.label: Psalms 74:13
15129.text: You yourself stirred up the sea with your own strength; You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

15130.label: Psalms 74:14
15130.text: You yourself crushed to pieces the heads of Le·viʹa·than. You proceeded to give it as food to the people, to those inhabiting the waterless regions.

15131.label: Psalms 74:15
15131.text: You were the One that split the spring and the torrent; You yourself dried up ever-flowing rivers.

15132.label: Psalms 74:16
15132.text: To you the day belongs; also, to you the night belongs. You yourself prepared the luminary, even the sun.

15133.label: Psalms 74:17
15133.text: It was you that set up all the boundaries of the earth; Summer and winter—you yourself formed them.

15134.label: Psalms 74:18
15134.text: Remember this: The enemy himself has reproached, O Jehovah, And a senseless people have treated your name with disrespect.

15135.label: Psalms 74:19
15135.text: Do not give to the wild beast the soul of your turtledove. Do not forget the very life of your afflicted ones forever.

15136.label: Psalms 74:20
15136.text: Take a look at the covenant, For the dark places of the earth have become full of the abodes of violence.

15137.label: Psalms 74:21
15137.text: O may the crushed one not return humiliated. May the afflicted one and the poor one praise your name.

15138.label: Psalms 74:22
15138.text: Do arise, O God, do conduct your own case at law. Remember your reproach from the senseless one all day long.

15139.label: Psalms 74:23
15139.text: Do not forget the voice of those showing hostility to you. The noise of those rising up against you is ascending constantly.

15141.label: Psalms 75:1
15141.text: We give thanks to you, O God; we give thanks to you, And your name is near. Men have to declare your wondrous works.

15142.label: Psalms 75:2
15142.text: “For I proceeded to take a set time; I myself began judging with uprightness.

15143.label: Psalms 75:3
15143.text: The earth and all its inhabitants being dissolved, It was I that adjusted its pillars.” Seʹlah.

15144.label: Psalms 75:4
15144.text: I said to the foolish ones: “Do not be foolish,” And to the wicked ones: “Do not exalt the horn.

15145.label: Psalms 75:5
15145.text: Do not exalt YOUR horn on high.Do not speak with an arrogant neck.

15146.label: Psalms 75:6
15146.text: For neither from the east nor from the west,Nor from the south is there an exalting.

15147.label: Psalms 75:7
15147.text: For God is the judge. This one he abases, and that one he exalts.

15148.label: Psalms 75:8
15148.text: For there is a cup in the hand of Jehovah, And the wine is foaming, it is full of mixture.And he will surely pour out its dregs from it;All the wicked ones of the earth will drain [them] out, drink [them].”

15149.label: Psalms 75:9
15149.text: But as for me, I shall tell [of it] to time indefinite;I will make melody to the God of Jacob.

15150.label: Psalms 75:10
15150.text: And all the horns of the wicked ones I shall cut down. The horns of the righteous one will be exalted.

15152.label: Psalms 76:1
15152.text: God is known in Judah; In Israel his name is great.

15153.label: Psalms 76:2
15153.text: And his covert proves to be in Saʹlem itself, And his dwelling place in Zion.

15154.label: Psalms 76:3
15154.text: There he broke the flaming shafts of the bow, The shield and the sword and the battle. Seʹlah.

15155.label: Psalms 76:4
15155.text: You are enveloped with light, more majestic than the mountains of prey.

15156.label: Psalms 76:5
15156.text: The ones powerful in heart have been despoiled, They have drowsed away to their sleep, And none of all the valiant men have found their hands.

15157.label: Psalms 76:6
15157.text: From your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the charioteer and the horse have fallen fast asleep.

15158.label: Psalms 76:7
15158.text: You—fear-inspiring you are, And who can stand before you because of the strength of your anger?

15159.label: Psalms 76:8
15159.text: From heaven you caused the legal contest to be heard; The earth itself feared and kept quiet

15160.label: Psalms 76:9
15160.text: When God rose up to judgment, To save all the meek of the earth. Seʹlah.

15161.label: Psalms 76:10
15161.text: For the very rage of man will laud you; The remainder of raging you will gird upon yourself.

15162.label: Psalms 76:11
15162.text: Vow and pay to Jehovah YOUR God, all YOU who are round about him. Let them bring a gift in fear.

15163.label: Psalms 76:12
15163.text: He will humble the spirit of leaders; Fear-inspiring he is to the kings of the earth.

15165.label: Psalms 77:1
15165.text: With my voice I will even cry out to God himself, With my voice to God, and he will certainly give ear to me.

15166.label: Psalms 77:2
15166.text: In the day of my distress I have searched for Jehovah himself. At night my very hand has been stretched out and does not grow numb;My soul has refused to be comforted.

15167.label: Psalms 77:3
15167.text: I will remember God and be boisterous; I will show concern, that my spirit may faint away. Seʹlah.

15168.label: Psalms 77:4
15168.text: You have seized hold of my eyelids; I have become agitated, and I cannot speak.

15169.label: Psalms 77:5
15169.text: I have thought upon the days of long ago, On the years in the indefinite past.

15170.label: Psalms 77:6
15170.text: I will remember my string music in the night; With my heart I will show concern, And my spirit will carefully search.

15171.label: Psalms 77:7
15171.text: Will it be to times indefinite that Jehovah keeps casting off, And will he no more be pleased again?

15172.label: Psalms 77:8
15172.text: Has his loving-kindness terminated forever? Has [his] saying come to nothing for generation after generation?

15173.label: Psalms 77:9
15173.text: Has God forgotten to be favorable, Or has he shut off his mercies in anger? Seʹlah.

15174.label: Psalms 77:10
15174.text: And shall I keep saying: “This is what pierces me through, The changing of the right hand of the Most High”?

15175.label: Psalms 77:11
15175.text: I shall remember the practices of Jah; For I will remember your marvelous doing of long ago.

15176.label: Psalms 77:12
15176.text: And I shall certainly meditate on all your activity, And with your dealings I will concern myself.

15177.label: Psalms 77:13
15177.text: O God, your way is in the holy place. Who is a great God like God?

15178.label: Psalms 77:14
15178.text: You are the [true] God, doing marvelously. Among the peoples you have made your strength known.

15179.label: Psalms 77:15
15179.text: With [your] arm you have recovered your people, The sons of Jacob and of Joseph. Seʹlah.

15180.label: Psalms 77:16
15180.text: The waters have seen you, O God,The waters have seen you; they began to be in severe pains. Also, the watery deeps began to be agitated.

15181.label: Psalms 77:17
15181.text: The clouds have thunderously poured down water; A sound the cloudy skies have given forth.Also, your own arrows proceeded to go here and there.

15182.label: Psalms 77:18
15182.text: The sound of your thunder was like chariot wheels; Lightnings have lighted up the productive land; The earth became agitated and began to rock.

15183.label: Psalms 77:19
15183.text: Through the sea your way was, And your path was through many waters;And your very footprints have not come to be known.

15184.label: Psalms 77:20
15184.text: You have led your people just like a flock, By the hand of Moses and Aaron.

15186.label: Psalms 78:1
15186.text: Do give ear, O my people, to my law; Incline YOUR ear to the sayings of my mouth.

15187.label: Psalms 78:2
15187.text: In a proverbial saying I will open my mouth; I will cause riddles of long ago to bubble forth,

15188.label: Psalms 78:3
15188.text: Which we have heard and know, And which our own fathers have related to us;

15189.label: Psalms 78:4
15189.text: Which we do not hide from their sons, Relating [them] even to the generation to come, The praises of Jehovah and his strength And his wonderful things that he has done.

15190.label: Psalms 78:5
15190.text: And he proceeded to raise up a reminder in Jacob, And a law he set in Israel, Things that he commanded our forefathers, To make them known to their sons;

15191.label: Psalms 78:6
15191.text: In order that the generation to come, the sons that were to be born, might know [them], That they might rise up and relate [them] to their sons,

15192.label: Psalms 78:7
15192.text: And that they might set their confidence in God himself And not forget the practices of God but observe his own commandments.

15193.label: Psalms 78:8
15193.text: And they should not become like their forefathers, A generation stubborn and rebellious, A generation who had not prepared their heart And whose spirit was not trustworthy with God.

15194.label: Psalms 78:9
15194.text: The sons of Eʹphra·im, though armed shooters of the bow, Retreated in the day of fight.

15195.label: Psalms 78:10
15195.text: They did not keep the covenant of God, And in his law they refused to walk.

15196.label: Psalms 78:11
15196.text: They also began to forget his dealings And his wonderful works that he caused them to see.

15197.label: Psalms 78:12
15197.text: In front of their forefathers he had done marvelously In the land of Egypt, the field of Zoʹan.

15198.label: Psalms 78:13
15198.text: He split the sea, that he might let them pass over, And he caused the waters to stand like a dam.

15199.label: Psalms 78:14
15199.text: And he continued to lead them with a cloud by day And the whole night with a light of fire.

15200.label: Psalms 78:15
15200.text: He proceeded to split rocks in the wilderness, That he might cause [them] to drink an abundance just like watery deeps.

15201.label: Psalms 78:16
15201.text: And he went bringing forth streams out of a crag And causing waters to descend just like rivers.

15202.label: Psalms 78:17
15202.text: And they kept sinning still more against him By rebelling against the Most High in the waterless region;

15203.label: Psalms 78:18
15203.text: And they proceeded to test God in their heart By asking for something to eat for their soul.

15204.label: Psalms 78:19
15204.text: So they began to speak against God. They said: “Is God able to arrange a table in the wilderness?”

15205.label: Psalms 78:20
15205.text: Look! He struck a rock That waters might flow and torrents themselves might flood forth. “Is he able also to give bread itself, Or can he prepare sustenance for his people?”

15206.label: Psalms 78:21
15206.text: That was why Jehovah heard and began to be furious; And fire itself was kindled against Jacob, And anger also ascended against Israel.

15207.label: Psalms 78:22
15207.text: For they did not put faith in God, And they did not trust in salvation by him.

15208.label: Psalms 78:23
15208.text: And he proceeded to command the cloudy skies above,And he opened the very doors of heaven.

15209.label: Psalms 78:24
15209.text: And he kept raining upon them manna to eat, And the grain of heaven he gave to them.

15210.label: Psalms 78:25
15210.text: Men ate the very bread of powerful ones; Provisions he sent them to satisfaction.

15211.label: Psalms 78:26
15211.text: He began making an east wind burst forth in the heavens And making a south wind blow by his own strength.

15212.label: Psalms 78:27
15212.text: And he proceeded to make sustenance rain upon them just like dust, Even winged flying creatures just like the sand grains of the seas.

15213.label: Psalms 78:28
15213.text: And he kept making [them] fall in the middle of his camp, All around his tabernacles.

15214.label: Psalms 78:29
15214.text: And they went eating and satisfying themselves very much, And what they desired he proceeded to bring to them.

15215.label: Psalms 78:30
15215.text: They had not turned aside from their desire,While their food was yet in their mouth,

15216.label: Psalms 78:31
15216.text: When God’s wrath itself ascended against them. And he went killing among their stout ones; And the young men of Israel he made collapse.

15217.label: Psalms 78:32
15217.text: Despite all this they sinned some more And did not put faith in his wonderful works.

15218.label: Psalms 78:33
15218.text: So he brought their days to an end as if a mere exhalation, And their years by the disturbance.

15219.label: Psalms 78:34
15219.text: As often as he killed them, they also inquired for him, And they returned and looked for God.

15220.label: Psalms 78:35
15220.text: And they began to remember that God was their Rock, And that God the Most High was their Avenger.

15221.label: Psalms 78:36
15221.text: And they tried to fool him with their mouth; And with their tongue they tried to lie to him.

15222.label: Psalms 78:37
15222.text: And their heart was not steadfast with him; And they did not prove faithful in his covenant.

15223.label: Psalms 78:38
15223.text: But he was merciful; he would cover the error and not bring ruin. And many times he made his anger turn back, And he would not rouse up all his rage.

15224.label: Psalms 78:39
15224.text: And he kept remembering that they were flesh, That the spirit is going forth and does not come back.

15225.label: Psalms 78:40
15225.text: How often they would rebel against him in the wilderness, They would make him feel hurt in the desert!

15226.label: Psalms 78:41
15226.text: And again and again they would put God to the test, And they pained even the Holy One of Israel.

15227.label: Psalms 78:42
15227.text: They did not remember his hand, The day that he redeemed them from the adversary,

15228.label: Psalms 78:43
15228.text: How he put his signs in Egypt itself And his miracles in the field of Zoʹan;

15229.label: Psalms 78:44
15229.text: And how he began changing to blood their Nile canals, So that they could not drink from their own streams.

15230.label: Psalms 78:45
15230.text: He proceeded to send upon them gadflies, that these might eat them up; And frogs, that these might bring them to ruin.

15231.label: Psalms 78:46
15231.text: And he began to give to the cockroaches their yield,And their toil to the locusts.

15232.label: Psalms 78:47
15232.text: He went killing their vine even by the hail And their sycamore trees by hailstones.

15233.label: Psalms 78:48
15233.text: And he proceeded to hand over their beasts of burden even to the hail And their livestock to the flaming fever.

15234.label: Psalms 78:49
15234.text: He went sending upon them his burning anger, Fury and denunciation and distress, Deputations of angels bringing calamity.

15235.label: Psalms 78:50
15235.text: He proceeded to prepare a pathway for his anger. He did not hold back their soul from death itself;And their life he handed over even to the pestilence.

15236.label: Psalms 78:51
15236.text: Finally he struck down all the firstborn in Egypt, The beginning of their generative power in the tents of Ham.

15237.label: Psalms 78:52
15237.text: Afterward he caused his people to depart just like a flock, And conducted them like a drove in the wilderness.

15238.label: Psalms 78:53
15238.text: And he kept leading them in security, and they felt no dread; And the sea covered their enemies themselves.

15239.label: Psalms 78:54
15239.text: And he proceeded to bring them to his holy territory, This mountainous region that his right hand acquired.

15240.label: Psalms 78:55
15240.text: And because of them he gradually drove out the nations, And by the measuring line he went allotting them an inheritance, So that he caused the tribes of Israel to reside in their own homes.

15241.label: Psalms 78:56
15241.text: And they began to test and rebel against God the Most High, And his reminders they did not keep.

15242.label: Psalms 78:57
15242.text: They also kept turning back and acting treacherously like their forefathers; They turned around like a loose bow.

15243.label: Psalms 78:58
15243.text: And they kept offending him with their high places, And with their graven images they kept inciting him to jealousy.

15244.label: Psalms 78:59
15244.text: God heard and got to be furious, And so he contemned Israel very much.

15245.label: Psalms 78:60
15245.text: And he finally forsook the tabernacle of Shiʹloh, The tent in which he resided among earthling men.

15246.label: Psalms 78:61
15246.text: And he proceeded to give his strength even to captivity And his beauty into the hand of the adversary.

15247.label: Psalms 78:62
15247.text: And he kept handing over his people to the sword itself, And against his inheritance he became furious.

15248.label: Psalms 78:63
15248.text: His young men a fire ate up,And his virgins were not praised.

15249.label: Psalms 78:64
15249.text: As for his priests, they fell by the very sword, And their own widows did not give way to weeping.

15250.label: Psalms 78:65
15250.text: Then Jehovah began to awake as from sleeping, Like a mighty one sobering up from wine.

15251.label: Psalms 78:66
15251.text: And he went striking down his adversaries from behind; A reproach of indefinite duration he gave to them.

15252.label: Psalms 78:67
15252.text: And he proceeded to reject the tent of Joseph; And the tribe of Eʹphra·im he did not choose.

15253.label: Psalms 78:68
15253.text: But he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.

15254.label: Psalms 78:69
15254.text: And he began to build his sanctuary just like the heights, Like the earth that he has founded to time indefinite.

15255.label: Psalms 78:70
15255.text: And so he chose David his servant And took him from the pens of the flock.

15256.label: Psalms 78:71
15256.text: From following the females giving suck He brought him in to be a shepherd over Jacob his people And over Israel his inheritance.

15257.label: Psalms 78:72
15257.text: And he began to shepherd them according to the integrity of his heart, And with the skillfulness of his hands he began leading them.

15259.label: Psalms 79:1
15259.text: O God, the nations have come into your inheritance; They have defiled your holy temple; They have laid Jerusalem in a heap of ruins.

15260.label: Psalms 79:2
15260.text: They have given the dead body of your servants as food to the fowls of the heavens, The flesh of your loyal ones to the wild beasts of the earth.

15261.label: Psalms 79:3
15261.text: They have poured out their blood like waterAll around Jerusalem, and there is no one to do the burying.

15262.label: Psalms 79:4
15262.text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, A derision and a jeering to those round about us.

15263.label: Psalms 79:5
15263.text: How long, O Jehovah, will you be incensed? Forever? How long will your ardor burn just like fire?

15264.label: Psalms 79:6
15264.text: Pour out your rage upon the nations that have not known you, And upon the kingdoms that have not called upon your own name.

15265.label: Psalms 79:7
15265.text: For they have eaten up Jacob, And they have caused his own abiding place to be desolated.

15266.label: Psalms 79:8
15266.text: Do not remember against us the errors of ancestors. Hurry! Let your mercies confront us, For we have become greatly impoverished.

15267.label: Psalms 79:9
15267.text: Help us, O God of our salvation, For the sake of the glory of your name; And deliver us and cover over our sins on account of your name.

15268.label: Psalms 79:10
15268.text: Why should the nations say: “Where is their God?” Among the nations let there be known before our eyes The avenging of the blood of your servants that has been shed.

15269.label: Psalms 79:11
15269.text: May the sighing of the prisoner come in even before you. According to the greatness of your arm preserve those appointed to death.

15270.label: Psalms 79:12
15270.text: And repay to our neighbors seven times into their bosom Their reproach with which they have reproached you, O Jehovah.

15271.label: Psalms 79:13
15271.text: As for us your people and the flock of your pasturage, We shall give thanks to you to time indefinite;From generation to generation we shall declare your praise.

15273.label: Psalms 80:1
15273.text: O Shepherd of Israel, do give ear, You who are conducting Joseph just like a flock. O you who are sitting upon the cherubs, do beam forth.

15274.label: Psalms 80:2
15274.text: Before Eʹphra·im and Benjamin and Ma·nasʹseh do rouse up your mightiness, And do come to our salvation.

15275.label: Psalms 80:3
15275.text: O God, bring us back; And light up your face, that we may be saved.

15276.label: Psalms 80:4
15276.text: O Jehovah God of armies, how long must you fume against the prayer of your people?

15277.label: Psalms 80:5
15277.text: You have made them eat the bread of tears, And you keep making them drink tears upon tears in [great] measure.

15278.label: Psalms 80:6
15278.text: You set us for strife to our neighbors, And our very enemies keep deriding as they please.

15279.label: Psalms 80:7
15279.text: O God of armies, bring us back; And light up your face, that we may be saved.

15280.label: Psalms 80:8
15280.text: You proceeded to make a vine depart from Egypt. You kept driving out the nations, that you might plant it.

15281.label: Psalms 80:9
15281.text: You made a clearing before it, that it might take root and fill the land.

15282.label: Psalms 80:10
15282.text: The mountains were covered with its shadow,And the cedars of God with its boughs.

15283.label: Psalms 80:11
15283.text: It gradually sent forth its boughs as far as the sea, And to the River its twigs.

15284.label: Psalms 80:12
15284.text: Why have you broken down its stone walls, And [why] have all those passing by on the road plucked at it?

15285.label: Psalms 80:13
15285.text: A boar out of the woods keeps eating it away, And the animal throngs of the open field keep feeding upon it.

15286.label: Psalms 80:14
15286.text: O God of armies, return, please; Look down from heaven and see and take care of this vine,

15287.label: Psalms 80:15
15287.text: And the stock that your right hand has planted, And [look] upon the son whom you have made strong for yourself.

15288.label: Psalms 80:16
15288.text: It is burned with fire, cut off. From the rebuke of your face they perish.

15289.label: Psalms 80:17
15289.text: Let your hand prove to be upon the man of your right hand, Upon the son of mankind whom you have made strong for yourself,

15290.label: Psalms 80:18
15290.text: And we shall not turn back from you. May you preserve us alive, that we may call upon your own name.

15291.label: Psalms 80:19
15291.text: O Jehovah God of armies, bring us back; Light up your face, that we may be saved.

15293.label: Psalms 81:1
15293.text: O cry out joyfully, YOU people, to God our strength; Shout in triumph to the God of Jacob.

15294.label: Psalms 81:2
15294.text: Strike up a melody and take a tambourine, The pleasant harp together with the stringed instrument.

15295.label: Psalms 81:3
15295.text: On the new moon, BLOW the horn; On the full moon, for the day of our festival.

15296.label: Psalms 81:4
15296.text: For it is a regulation for Israel, A judicial decision of the God of Jacob.

15297.label: Psalms 81:5
15297.text: As a reminder he laid it upon Joseph himself, When he was going forth over the land of Egypt. A language that I did not know I kept hearing.

15298.label: Psalms 81:6
15298.text: “I turned aside his shoulder even from [the] burden; His own hands got to be free even from the basket.

15299.label: Psalms 81:7
15299.text: In distress you called, and I proceeded to rescue you; I began to answer you in the concealed place of thunder. I went examining you at the waters of Merʹi·bah. Seʹlah.

15300.label: Psalms 81:8
15300.text: Hear, O my people, and I will bear witness against you, O Israel, if you will listen to me.

15301.label: Psalms 81:9
15301.text: Among you there will prove to be no strange god; And you will not bow down to a foreign god.

15302.label: Psalms 81:10
15302.text: I, Jehovah, am your God, The One bringing you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I shall fill it.

15303.label: Psalms 81:11
15303.text: But my people has not listened to my voice; And Israel itself has not showed any willingness toward me.

15304.label: Psalms 81:12
15304.text: And so I let them go in the stubbornness of their heart; They went walking in their own counsels.

15305.label: Psalms 81:13
15305.text: O that my people were listening to me, O that Israel itself would walk in my very ways!

15306.label: Psalms 81:14
15306.text: Their enemies I would easily subdue, And against their adversaries I would turn my hand.

15307.label: Psalms 81:15
15307.text: As for those intensely hating Jehovah, they will come cringing to him, And their time will prove to be to time indefinite.

15308.label: Psalms 81:16
15308.text: And he will keep feeding him off the fat of the wheat, And out of the rock I shall satisfy you with honey itself.”

15310.label: Psalms 82:1
15310.text: God is stationing himself in the assembly of the Divine One; In the middle of the gods he judges:

15311.label: Psalms 82:2
15311.text: “How long will YOU keep on judging with injustice And showing partiality to the wicked themselves? Seʹlah.

15312.label: Psalms 82:3
15312.text: Be judges for the lowly one and the fatherless boy. To the afflicted one and the one of little means do justice.

15313.label: Psalms 82:4
15313.text: Provide escape for the lowly one and the poor one; Out of the hand of the wicked ones deliver [them].”

15314.label: Psalms 82:5
15314.text: They have not known, and they do not understand; In darkness they keep walking about; All the foundations of the earth are made to totter.

15315.label: Psalms 82:6
15315.text: “I myself have said, ‘YOU are gods, And all of YOU are sons of the Most High.

15316.label: Psalms 82:7
15316.text: Surely YOU will die just as men do; And like any one of the princes YOU will fall!’”

15317.label: Psalms 82:8
15317.text: Do rise up, O God, do judge the earth; For you yourself should take possession of all the nations.

15319.label: Psalms 83:1
15319.text: O God, let there be no silence on your part; Do not keep speechless, and do not stay quiet, O Divine One.

15320.label: Psalms 83:2
15320.text: For, look! your very enemies are in an uproar; And the very ones intensely hating you have raised [their] head.

15321.label: Psalms 83:3
15321.text: Against your people they cunningly carry on their confidential talk; And they conspire against your concealed ones.

15322.label: Psalms 83:4
15322.text: They have said: “Come and let us efface them from being a nation, That the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

15323.label: Psalms 83:5
15323.text: For with the heart they have unitedly exchanged counsel; Against you they proceeded to conclude even a covenant,

15324.label: Psalms 83:6
15324.text: The tents of Eʹdom and the Ishʹma·el·ites, Moʹab and the Hagʹrites,

15325.label: Psalms 83:7
15325.text: Geʹbal and Amʹmon and Amʹa·lek,Phi·lisʹti·a together with the inhabitants of Tyre.

15326.label: Psalms 83:8
15326.text: Also, As·syrʹi·a itself has become joined with them; They have become an arm to the sons of Lot. Seʹlah.

15327.label: Psalms 83:9
15327.text: Do to them as to Midʹi·an, as to Sisʹe·ra, As to Jaʹbin at the torrent valley of Kiʹshon.

15328.label: Psalms 83:10
15328.text: They were annihilated at En-dor; They became manure for the ground.

15329.label: Psalms 83:11
15329.text: As for their nobles, make these like Oʹreb and like Zeʹeb, And like Zeʹbah and like Zal·munʹna all their dukes,

15330.label: Psalms 83:12
15330.text: Who have said: “Let us take possession of the abiding places of God for ourselves.”

15331.label: Psalms 83:13
15331.text: O my God, make them like a thistle whirl, Like stubble before a wind.

15332.label: Psalms 83:14
15332.text: Like a fire that burns up the forest And like a flame that scorches the mountains,

15333.label: Psalms 83:15
15333.text: In just that way may you pursue them with your tempest And may you disturb them with your own storm wind.

15334.label: Psalms 83:16
15334.text: Fill their faces with dishonor, That people may search for your name, O Jehovah.

15335.label: Psalms 83:17
15335.text: O may they be ashamed and be disturbed for all times, And may they become abashed and perish;

15336.label: Psalms 83:18
15336.text: That people may know that you, whose name is Jehovah, You alone are the Most High over all the earth.

15338.label: Psalms 84:1
15338.text: How lovely your grand tabernacle is, O Jehovah of armies!

15339.label: Psalms 84:2
15339.text: My soul has yearned and also pined away for the courtyards of Jehovah. My own heart and my very flesh cry out joyfully to the living God.

15340.label: Psalms 84:3
15340.text: Even the bird itself has found a house,And the swallow a nest for herself,Where she has put her young ones—Your grand altar, O Jehovah of armies, my King and my God!

15341.label: Psalms 84:4
15341.text: Happy are those dwelling in your house! They still keep on praising you. Seʹlah.

15342.label: Psalms 84:5
15342.text: Happy are the men whose strength is in you, In whose heart are the highways.

15343.label: Psalms 84:6
15343.text: Passing along through the low plain of the baʹca bushes, They turn it into a spring itself;Even with blessings the instructor enwraps himself.

15344.label: Psalms 84:7
15344.text: They will walk on from vital energy to vital energy; Each one appears to God in Zion.

15345.label: Psalms 84:8
15345.text: O Jehovah God of armies, do hear my prayer; Do give ear, O God of Jacob. Seʹlah.

15346.label: Psalms 84:9
15346.text: O shield of ours, see, O God, And look upon the face of your anointed one.

15347.label: Psalms 84:10
15347.text: For a day in your courtyards is better than a thousand [elsewhere]. I have chosen to stand at the threshold in the house of my God Rather than to move around in the tents of wickedness.

15348.label: Psalms 84:11
15348.text: For Jehovah God is a sun and a shield; Favor and glory are what he gives. Jehovah himself will not hold back anything good from those walking in faultlessness.

15349.label: Psalms 84:12
15349.text: O Jehovah of armies, happy is the man that is trusting in you.

15351.label: Psalms 85:1
15351.text: You have taken pleasure, O Jehovah, in your land; You have brought back the ones taken captive of Jacob.

15352.label: Psalms 85:2
15352.text: You have pardoned the error of your people; You have covered all their sin. Seʹlah.

15353.label: Psalms 85:3
15353.text: You have controlled all your fury; You have turned back from the heat of your anger.

15354.label: Psalms 85:4
15354.text: Gather us back, O God of our salvation, And break off your vexation with us.

15355.label: Psalms 85:5
15355.text: Is it to time indefinite that you will be incensed at us? Will you draw out your anger to generation after generation?

15356.label: Psalms 85:6
15356.text: Will you yourself not enliven us again, That your people themselves may rejoice in you?

15357.label: Psalms 85:7
15357.text: Show us, O Jehovah, your loving-kindness, And your salvation may you give to us.

15358.label: Psalms 85:8
15358.text: I will hear what the [true] God Jehovah will speak, For he will speak peace to his people and to his loyal ones,But let them not return to self-confidence.

15359.label: Psalms 85:9
15359.text: Surely his salvation is near to those fearing him, For glory to reside in our land.

15360.label: Psalms 85:10
15360.text: As for loving-kindness and trueness, they have met each other; Righteousness and peace—they have kissed each other.

15361.label: Psalms 85:11
15361.text: Trueness itself will sprout out of the very earth, And righteousness itself will look down from the very heavens.

15362.label: Psalms 85:12
15362.text: Also, Jehovah, for his part, will give what is good, And our own land will give its yield.

15363.label: Psalms 85:13
15363.text: Before him righteousness itself will walk, And it will make a way by his steppings.

15365.label: Psalms 86:1
15365.text: Incline, O Jehovah, your ear. Answer me, For I am afflicted and poor.

15366.label: Psalms 86:2
15366.text: O do guard my soul, for I am loyal. Save your servant—you are my God—that is trusting in you.

15367.label: Psalms 86:3
15367.text: Show me favor, O Jehovah, For to you I keep calling all day long.

15368.label: Psalms 86:4
15368.text: Make the soul of your servant rejoice, For to you, O Jehovah, I lift up my very soul.

15369.label: Psalms 86:5
15369.text: For you, O Jehovah, are good and ready to forgive; And the loving-kindness to all those calling upon you is abundant.

15370.label: Psalms 86:6
15370.text: Do give ear, O Jehovah, to my prayer; And do pay attention to the voice of my entreaties.

15371.label: Psalms 86:7
15371.text: In the day of my distress I will call upon you, For you will answer me.

15372.label: Psalms 86:8
15372.text: There is none like you among the gods, O Jehovah, Neither are there any works like yours.

15373.label: Psalms 86:9
15373.text: All the nations whom you have made will themselves come, And they will bow down before you, O Jehovah, And will give glory to your name.

15374.label: Psalms 86:10
15374.text: For you are great and are doing wondrous things; You are God, you alone.

15375.label: Psalms 86:11
15375.text: Instruct me, O Jehovah, about your way. I shall walk in your truth. Unify my heart to fear your name.

15376.label: Psalms 86:12
15376.text: I laud you, O Jehovah my God, with all my heart, And I will glorify your name to time indefinite,

15377.label: Psalms 86:13
15377.text: For your loving-kindness is great toward me, And you have delivered my soul out of Sheʹol, its lowest place.

15378.label: Psalms 86:14
15378.text: O God, the presumptuous ones themselves have risen up against me; And the very assembly of tyrannical ones have looked for my soul, And they have not set you in front of themselves.

15379.label: Psalms 86:15
15379.text: But you, O Jehovah, are a God merciful and gracious, Slow to anger and abundant in loving-kindness and trueness.

15380.label: Psalms 86:16
15380.text: Turn to me and show me favor. Do give your strength to your servant, And do save the son of your slave girl.

15381.label: Psalms 86:17
15381.text: Work out with me a sign meaning goodness,That those hating me may see [it] and be ashamed. For you yourself, O Jehovah, have helped me and comforted me.

15383.label: Psalms 87:1
15383.text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

15384.label: Psalms 87:2
15384.text: Jehovah is more in love with the gates of Zion Than with all the tabernacles of Jacob.

15385.label: Psalms 87:3
15385.text: Glorious things are being spoken about you, O city of the [true] God. Seʹlah.

15386.label: Psalms 87:4
15386.text: I shall make mention of Raʹhab and Babylon as among those knowing me;Here are Phi·lisʹti·a and Tyre, together with Cush: “This is one who was born there.”

15387.label: Psalms 87:5
15387.text: And respecting Zion it will be said:“Each and every one was born in her.” And the Most High himself will firmly establish her.

15388.label: Psalms 87:6
15388.text: Jehovah himself will declare, when recording the peoples: “This is one who was born there.” Seʹlah.

15389.label: Psalms 87:7
15389.text: There will also be singers as well as dancers of circle dances: “All my springs are in you.”

15391.label: Psalms 88:1
15391.text: O Jehovah, the God of my salvation, By day I have cried out, In the night [also] in front of you.

15392.label: Psalms 88:2
15392.text: Before you my prayer will come. Incline your ear to my entreating cry.

15393.label: Psalms 88:3
15393.text: For my soul has had enough of calamities, And my very life has come in touch even with Sheʹol.

15394.label: Psalms 88:4
15394.text: I have been reckoned in among those going down to the pit; I have become like an able-bodied man without strength,

15395.label: Psalms 88:5
15395.text: Set free among the dead themselves, Like slain ones lying in the burial place, Whom you have remembered no longerAnd who have been severed from your own [helping] hand.

15396.label: Psalms 88:6
15396.text: You have put me in a pit of the lowest depths,In dark places, in a large abyss.

15397.label: Psalms 88:7
15397.text: Upon me your rage has thrown itself, And with all your breaking waves you have afflicted [me]. Seʹlah.

15398.label: Psalms 88:8
15398.text: You have put my acquaintances far away from me; You have set me as something very detestable to them. I am under restraint and cannot go forth.

15399.label: Psalms 88:9
15399.text: My own eye has languished because of my affliction. I have called on you, O Jehovah, all day long; To you I have spread out my palms.

15400.label: Psalms 88:10
15400.text: For those who are dead will you do a marvel? Or will those impotent in death themselves arise, Will they laud you? Seʹlah.

15401.label: Psalms 88:11
15401.text: Will your loving-kindness be declared in the burial place itself,Your faithfulness in [the place of] destruction?

15402.label: Psalms 88:12
15402.text: Will a marvel by you be known in the darkness itself, Or your righteousness in the land of oblivion?

15403.label: Psalms 88:13
15403.text: And yet to you, O Jehovah, I myself have cried for help, And in the morning my own prayer keeps confronting you.

15404.label: Psalms 88:14
15404.text: Why is it, O Jehovah, that you cast off my soul? Why do you keep your face concealed from me?

15405.label: Psalms 88:15
15405.text: I am afflicted and about to expire from boyhood on; I have borne frightful things from you very much.

15406.label: Psalms 88:16
15406.text: Over me your flashes of burning anger have passed; Terrors from you yourself have brought me to silence.

15407.label: Psalms 88:17
15407.text: They have surrounded me like waters all day long; They have closed in upon me all at one time.

15408.label: Psalms 88:18
15408.text: You have put far away from me friend and companion; My acquaintances are a dark place.

15410.label: Psalms 89:1
15410.text: Jehovah’s expressions of loving-kindness I will sing about even to time indefinite. For generation after generation I shall make your faithfulness known with my mouth.

15411.label: Psalms 89:2
15411.text: For I have said: “Loving-kindness will stay built even to time indefinite; As for the heavens, you keep your faithfulness firmly established in them.”

15412.label: Psalms 89:3
15412.text: “I have concluded a covenant toward my chosen one; I have sworn to David my servant,

15413.label: Psalms 89:4
15413.text: ‘Even to time indefinite I shall firmly establish your seed, And I will build your throne to generation after generation.’” Seʹlah.

15414.label: Psalms 89:5
15414.text: And the heavens will laud your marvelous act, O Jehovah, Yes, your faithfulness in the congregation of the holy ones.

15415.label: Psalms 89:6
15415.text: For who in the skies can be compared to Jehovah? Who can resemble Jehovah among the sons of God?

15416.label: Psalms 89:7
15416.text: God is to be held in awe among the intimate group of holy ones; He is grand and fear-inspiring over all who are round about him.

15417.label: Psalms 89:8
15417.text: O Jehovah God of armies, Who is vigorous like you, O Jah? And your faithfulness is all around you.

15418.label: Psalms 89:9
15418.text: You are ruling over the swelling of the sea; When it raises up its waves you yourself calm them.

15419.label: Psalms 89:10
15419.text: You yourself have crushed Raʹhab, even as someone slain. By the arm of your strength you have scattered your enemies.

15420.label: Psalms 89:11
15420.text: Heaven is yours, the earth also is yours; The productive land and what fills it —you yourself have founded them.

15421.label: Psalms 89:12
15421.text: The north and the south —you yourself created them; Taʹbor and Herʹmon —in your name they cry out joyfully.

15422.label: Psalms 89:13
15422.text: An arm with mightiness is yours, Your hand is strong, Your right hand is exalted.

15423.label: Psalms 89:14
15423.text: Righteousness and judgment are the established place of your throne; Loving-kindness and trueness themselves come in before your face.

15424.label: Psalms 89:15
15424.text: Happy are the people knowing the joyful shouting. O Jehovah, in the light of your face they keep walking.

15425.label: Psalms 89:16
15425.text: In your name they are joyful all day long And in your righteousness they are exalted.

15426.label: Psalms 89:17
15426.text: For you are the beauty of their strength; And by your goodwill our horn is exalted.

15427.label: Psalms 89:18
15427.text: For our shield belongs to Jehovah, And our king belongs to the Holy One of Israel.

15428.label: Psalms 89:19
15428.text: At that time you spoke in a vision to your loyal ones, And you proceeded to say:“I have placed help upon a mighty one; I have exalted a chosen one from among the people.

15429.label: Psalms 89:20
15429.text: I have found David my servant; With my holy oil I have anointed him,

15430.label: Psalms 89:21
15430.text: With whom my own hand will be firm, Whom my own arm also will strengthen.

15431.label: Psalms 89:22
15431.text: No enemy will make exactions upon him, Neither will any son of unrighteousness afflict him.

15432.label: Psalms 89:23
15432.text: And from before him I crushed his adversaries to pieces, And to those intensely hating him I kept dealing out blows.

15433.label: Psalms 89:24
15433.text: And my faithfulness and my loving-kindness are with him, And in my name his horn is exalted.

15434.label: Psalms 89:25
15434.text: And on the sea I have put his hand And on the rivers his right hand.

15435.label: Psalms 89:26
15435.text: He himself calls out to me, ‘You are my Father, My God and the Rock of my salvation.’

15436.label: Psalms 89:27
15436.text: Also, I myself shall place him as firstborn, The most high of the kings of the earth.

15437.label: Psalms 89:28
15437.text: To time indefinite I shall preserve my loving-kindness toward him, And my covenant will be faithful to him.

15438.label: Psalms 89:29
15438.text: And I shall certainly set up his seed forever And his throne as the days of heaven.

15439.label: Psalms 89:30
15439.text: If his sons leave my law And in my judicial decisions they do not walk,

15440.label: Psalms 89:31
15440.text: If they profane my own statutesAnd they do not keep my own commandments,

15441.label: Psalms 89:32
15441.text: I must also turn my attention to their transgression even with a rod And to their error even with strokes.

15442.label: Psalms 89:33
15442.text: But my loving-kindness I shall not break off from him, Nor shall I prove false with regard to my faithfulness.

15443.label: Psalms 89:34
15443.text: I shall not profane my covenant, And the expression out of my lips I shall not change.

15444.label: Psalms 89:35
15444.text: Once I have sworn in my holiness, To David I will not tell lies.

15445.label: Psalms 89:36
15445.text: His seed itself will prove to be even to time indefinite, And his throne as the sun in front of me.

15446.label: Psalms 89:37
15446.text: As the moon it will be firmly established for time indefinite,And [as] a faithful witness in the skies.” Seʹlah.

15447.label: Psalms 89:38
15447.text: But you—you have cast off and you keep contemning; You have become furious toward your anointed one.

15448.label: Psalms 89:39
15448.text: You have spurned the covenant of your servant;You have profaned his diadem to the very earth.

15449.label: Psalms 89:40
15449.text: You have broken down all his stone pens; You have laid his fortifications in ruin.

15450.label: Psalms 89:41
15450.text: All those passing along the way have pillaged him; He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

15451.label: Psalms 89:42
15451.text: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries; You have caused all his enemies to rejoice.

15452.label: Psalms 89:43
15452.text: What is more, you again treat his sword as a foe, And you have caused him not to gain ground in the battle.

15453.label: Psalms 89:44
15453.text: You have made [him] cease from his luster, And his throne you have hurled to the very earth.

15454.label: Psalms 89:45
15454.text: You have shortened the days of his youth;You have enwrapped him with shame. Seʹlah.

15455.label: Psalms 89:46
15455.text: How long, O Jehovah, will you keep yourself concealed? For all time? Will your rage keep on burning just like a fire?

15456.label: Psalms 89:47
15456.text: Remember of what duration of life I am. Is it all in vain that you have created all the sons of men?

15457.label: Psalms 89:48
15457.text: What able-bodied man is there alive who will not see death? Can he provide escape for his soul from the hand of Sheʹol? Seʹlah.

15458.label: Psalms 89:49
15458.text: Where are your former acts of loving-kindness, O Jehovah, About which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

15459.label: Psalms 89:50
15459.text: Remember, O Jehovah, the reproach upon your servants, My carrying in my bosom [the reproach of] all the many peoples,

15460.label: Psalms 89:51
15460.text: How your enemies have reproached, O Jehovah, How they have reproached the footprints of your anointed one.

15461.label: Psalms 89:52
15461.text: Blessed be Jehovah to time indefinite. Amen and Amen.

15463.label: Psalms 90:1
15463.text: O Jehovah, you yourself have proved to be a real dwelling for us During generation after generation.

15464.label: Psalms 90:2
15464.text: Before the mountains themselves were born, Or you proceeded to bring forth as with labor pains the earth and the productive land, Even from time indefinite to time indefinite you are God.

15465.label: Psalms 90:3
15465.text: You make mortal man go back to crushed matter, And you say: “GO back, YOU sons of men.”

15466.label: Psalms 90:4
15466.text: For a thousand years are in your eyes but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch during the night.

15467.label: Psalms 90:5
15467.text: You have swept them away; they become a mere sleep; In the morning [they are] just like green grass that changes.

15468.label: Psalms 90:6
15468.text: In the morning it puts forth blossoms and must change; At evening it withers and certainly dries up.

15469.label: Psalms 90:7
15469.text: For we have come to an end in your anger, And by your rage we have been disturbed.

15470.label: Psalms 90:8
15470.text: You have set our errors right in front of you, Our hidden things before your bright face.

15471.label: Psalms 90:9
15471.text: For all our days have come to their decline in your fury; We have finished our years just like a whisper.

15472.label: Psalms 90:10
15472.text: In themselves the days of our years are seventy years; And if because of special mightiness they are eighty years, Yet their insistence is on trouble and hurtful things; For it must quickly pass by, and away we fly.

15473.label: Psalms 90:11
15473.text: Who is there knowing the strength of your anger And your fury according to the fear of you?

15474.label: Psalms 90:12
15474.text: Show [us] just how to count our days in such a way That we may bring a heart of wisdom in.

15475.label: Psalms 90:13
15475.text: Do return, O Jehovah! How long will it be? And feel regret over your servants.

15476.label: Psalms 90:14
15476.text: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving-kindness, That we may cry out joyfully and may rejoice during all our days.

15477.label: Psalms 90:15
15477.text: Make us rejoice correspondingly to the days that you have afflicted us, The years that we have seen calamity.

15478.label: Psalms 90:16
15478.text: May your activity appear to your own servants And your splendor upon their sons.

15479.label: Psalms 90:17
15479.text: And let the pleasantness of Jehovah our God prove to be upon us, And the work of our hands do you firmly establish upon us. Yes, the work of our hands, do you firmly establish it.

15480.label: Psalms 91:1
15480.text: Anyone dwelling in the secret place of the Most High Will procure himself lodging under the very shadow of the Almighty One.

15481.label: Psalms 91:2
15481.text: I will say to Jehovah: “[You are] my refuge and my stronghold, My God, in whom I will trust.”

15482.label: Psalms 91:3
15482.text: For he himself will deliver you from the trap of the birdcatcher, From the pestilence causing adversities.

15483.label: Psalms 91:4
15483.text: With his pinions he will block approach to you, And under his wings you will take refuge. His trueness will be a large shield and bulwark.

15484.label: Psalms 91:5
15484.text: You will not be afraid of anything dreadful by night, Nor of the arrow that flies by day,

15485.label: Psalms 91:6
15485.text: Nor of the pestilence that walks in the gloom, Nor of the destruction that despoils at midday.

15486.label: Psalms 91:7
15486.text: A thousand will fall at your very sideAnd ten thousand at your right hand;To you it will not come near.

15487.label: Psalms 91:8
15487.text: Only with your eyes will you look on And see the retribution itself of the wicked ones.

15488.label: Psalms 91:9
15488.text: Because you [said]: “Jehovah is my refuge,” You have made the Most High himself your dwelling;

15489.label: Psalms 91:10
15489.text: No calamity will befall you, And not even a plague will draw near to your tent.

15490.label: Psalms 91:11
15490.text: For he will give his own angels a command concerning you, To guard you in all your ways.

15491.label: Psalms 91:12
15491.text: Upon their hands they will carry you, That you may not strike your foot against any stone.

15492.label: Psalms 91:13
15492.text: Upon the young lion and the cobra you will tread; You will trample down the maned young lion and the big snake.

15493.label: Psalms 91:14
15493.text: Because on me he has set his affection, I shall also provide him with escape. I shall protect him because he has come to know my name.

15494.label: Psalms 91:15
15494.text: He will call upon me, and I shall answer him. I shall be with him in distress. I shall rescue him and glorify him.

15495.label: Psalms 91:16
15495.text: With length of days I shall satisfy him, And I shall cause him to see salvation by me.

15497.label: Psalms 92:1
15497.text: It is good to give thanks to Jehovah And to make melody to your name, O Most High;

15498.label: Psalms 92:2
15498.text: To tell in the morning about your loving-kindness And about your faithfulness during the nights,

15499.label: Psalms 92:3
15499.text: Upon a ten-stringed instrument and upon the lute, By resounding music on the harp.

15500.label: Psalms 92:4
15500.text: For you have made me rejoice, O Jehovah, because of your activity;Because of the works of your hands I cry out joyfully.

15501.label: Psalms 92:5
15501.text: How great your works are, O Jehovah! Very deep your thoughts are.

15502.label: Psalms 92:6
15502.text: No unreasoning man himself can know [them], And no one stupid can understand this.

15503.label: Psalms 92:7
15503.text: When the wicked ones sprout as the vegetation And all the practicers of what is hurtful blossom forth,It is that they may be annihilated forever.

15504.label: Psalms 92:8
15504.text: But you are on high to time indefinite, O Jehovah.

15505.label: Psalms 92:9
15505.text: For, look! your enemies, O Jehovah, For, look! your own enemies will perish; All the practicers of what is hurtful will be separated from one another.

15506.label: Psalms 92:10
15506.text: But you will exalt my horn like that of a wild bull; I shall moisten [myself] with fresh oil.

15507.label: Psalms 92:11
15507.text: And my eye will look on my foes; My ears will hear about the very ones who rise up against me, the evildoers.

15508.label: Psalms 92:12
15508.text: The righteous himself will blossom forth as a palm tree does; As a cedar in Lebʹa·non does, he will grow big.

15509.label: Psalms 92:13
15509.text: Those who are planted in the house of Jehovah, In the courtyards of our God, they will blossom forth.

15510.label: Psalms 92:14
15510.text: They will still keep on thriving during gray-headedness, Fat and fresh they will continue to be,

15511.label: Psalms 92:15
15511.text: To tell that Jehovah is upright. [He is] my Rock, in whom there is no unrighteousness.

15512.label: Psalms 93:1
15512.text: Jehovah himself has become king! With eminence he is clothed; Jehovah is clothed—with strength he has girded himself. The productive land also becomes firmly established so that it cannot be made to totter.

15513.label: Psalms 93:2
15513.text: Your throne is firmly established from long ago; You are from time indefinite.

15514.label: Psalms 93:3
15514.text: The rivers have raised, O Jehovah,The rivers have raised their sound; The rivers keep raising their pounding.

15515.label: Psalms 93:4
15515.text: Above the sounds of vast waters, the majestic breaking waves of the sea, Jehovah is majestic in the height.

15516.label: Psalms 93:5
15516.text: Your own reminders have proved very trustworthy. Holiness is befitting to your own house, O Jehovah, for length of days.

15517.label: Psalms 94:1
15517.text: O God of acts of vengeance, Jehovah, O God of acts of vengeance, beam forth!

15518.label: Psalms 94:2
15518.text: Raise yourself up, O Judge of the earth. Bring back a retribution upon the haughty ones.

15519.label: Psalms 94:3
15519.text: How long are the wicked, O Jehovah, How long are the wicked themselves going to exult?

15520.label: Psalms 94:4
15520.text: They keep bubbling forth, they keep speaking unrestrained; All the practicers of what is hurtful keep bragging about themselves.

15521.label: Psalms 94:5
15521.text: Your people, O Jehovah, they keep crushing, And your inheritance they keep afflicting.

15522.label: Psalms 94:6
15522.text: The widow and the alien resident they kill, And the fatherless boys they murder.

15523.label: Psalms 94:7
15523.text: And they keep saying: “Jah does not see; And the God of Jacob does not understand [it].”

15524.label: Psalms 94:8
15524.text: Understand, YOU who are unreasoning among the people; And as for YOU stupid ones, when will YOU have any insight?

15525.label: Psalms 94:9
15525.text: The One planting the ear, can he not hear? Or the One forming the eye, can he not look?

15526.label: Psalms 94:10
15526.text: The One correcting the nations, can he not reprove, Even the One teaching men knowledge?

15527.label: Psalms 94:11
15527.text: Jehovah is knowing the thoughts of men, that they are as an exhalation.

15528.label: Psalms 94:12
15528.text: Happy is the able-bodied man whom you correct, O Jah,And whom you teach out of your own law,

15529.label: Psalms 94:13
15529.text: To give him quietness from days of calamity, Until for the wicked one a pit is excavated.

15530.label: Psalms 94:14
15530.text: For Jehovah will not forsake his people, Nor will he leave his own inheritance.

15531.label: Psalms 94:15
15531.text: For judicial decision will return even to righteousness, And all the upright in heart will follow it.

15532.label: Psalms 94:16
15532.text: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? Who will take his stand for me against the practicers of hurtfulness?

15533.label: Psalms 94:17
15533.text: Unless Jehovah had been of assistance to me, In a little while my soul would have resided in silence.

15534.label: Psalms 94:18
15534.text: When I said: “My foot will certainly move unsteadily,” Your own loving-kindness, O Jehovah, kept sustaining me.

15535.label: Psalms 94:19
15535.text: When my disquieting thoughts became many inside of me, Your own consolations began to fondle my soul.

15536.label: Psalms 94:20
15536.text: Will the throne causing adversities be allied with you While it is framing trouble by decree?

15537.label: Psalms 94:21
15537.text: They make sharp attacks on the soul of the righteous one And pronounce wicked even the blood of the innocent one.

15538.label: Psalms 94:22
15538.text: But Jehovah will become a secure height for me, And my God the rock of my refuge.

15539.label: Psalms 94:23
15539.text: And he will turn back upon them their hurtfulness And will silence them with their own calamity. Jehovah our God will silence them.

15540.label: Psalms 95:1
15540.text: O come let us cry out joyfully to Jehovah! Let us shout in triumph to our Rock of salvation.

15541.label: Psalms 95:2
15541.text: Let us come before his person with thanksgiving; Let us with melodies shout in triumph to him.

15542.label: Psalms 95:3
15542.text: For Jehovah is a great God And a great King over all [other] gods,

15543.label: Psalms 95:4
15543.text: He in whose hand are the inmost depths of the earth And to whom the peaks of the mountains belong;

15544.label: Psalms 95:5
15544.text: To whom the sea, which he himself made, belongs And whose own hands formed the dry land itself.

15545.label: Psalms 95:6
15545.text: O come in, let us worship and bow down; Let us kneel before Jehovah our Maker.

15546.label: Psalms 95:7
15546.text: For he is our God, and we are the people of his pasturage and the sheep of his hand. Today if YOU people listen to his own voice,

15547.label: Psalms 95:8
15547.text: Do not harden YOUR heart as at Merʹi·bah, As in the day of Masʹsah in the wilderness,

15548.label: Psalms 95:9
15548.text: When YOUR forefathers put me to the proof; They examined me, they also saw my activity.

15549.label: Psalms 95:10
15549.text: For forty years I kept feeling a loathing toward [that] generation, And I proceeded to say:“They are a people wayward at heart, And they themselves have not come to know my ways”;

15550.label: Psalms 95:11
15550.text: Concerning whom I swore in my anger: “They shall not enter into my resting-place.”

15551.label: Psalms 96:1
15551.text: Sing to Jehovah a new song. Sing to Jehovah, all [YOU people of] the earth.

15552.label: Psalms 96:2
15552.text: Sing to Jehovah, bless his name. From day to day tell the good news of salvation by him.

15553.label: Psalms 96:3
15553.text: Declare among the nations his glory, Among all the peoples his wonderful works.

15554.label: Psalms 96:4
15554.text: For Jehovah is great and very much to be praised.He is fear-inspiring above all [other] gods.

15555.label: Psalms 96:5
15555.text: For all the gods of the peoples are valueless gods; But as for Jehovah, he has made the very heavens.

15556.label: Psalms 96:6
15556.text: Dignity and splendor are before him; Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

15557.label: Psalms 96:7
15557.text: Ascribe to Jehovah, O YOU families of the peoples, Ascribe to Jehovah glory and strength.

15558.label: Psalms 96:8
15558.text: Ascribe to Jehovah the glory belonging to his name; Carry a gift and come into his courtyards.

15559.label: Psalms 96:9
15559.text: Bow down to Jehovah in holy adornment; Be in severe pains because of him, all [YOU people of] the earth.

15560.label: Psalms 96:10
15560.text: Say among the nations: “Jehovah himself has become king. The productive land also becomes firmly established so that it cannot be made to totter. He will plead the cause of the peoples in uprightness.”

15561.label: Psalms 96:11
15561.text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be joyful. Let the sea thunder and that which fills it.

15562.label: Psalms 96:12
15562.text: Let the open field exult and all that is in it. At the same time let all the trees of the forest break out joyfully

15563.label: Psalms 96:13
15563.text: Before Jehovah. For he has come; For he has come to judge the earth. He will judge the productive land with righteousness And the peoples with his faithfulness.

15564.label: Psalms 97:1
15564.text: Jehovah himself has become king! Let the earth be joyful. Let the many islands rejoice.

15565.label: Psalms 97:2
15565.text: Clouds and thick gloom are all around him; Righteousness and judgment are the established place of his throne.

15566.label: Psalms 97:3
15566.text: Before him a very fire goes, And it consumes his adversaries all around.

15567.label: Psalms 97:4
15567.text: His lightnings lighted up the productive land; The earth saw and came to be in severe pains.

15568.label: Psalms 97:5
15568.text: The mountains themselves proceeded to melt just like wax on account of Jehovah, On account of the Lord of the whole earth.

15569.label: Psalms 97:6
15569.text: The heavens have told forth his righteousness, And all the peoples have seen his glory.

15570.label: Psalms 97:7
15570.text: Let all those serving any carved image be ashamed, Those who are making their boast in valueless gods. Bow down to him, all YOU gods.

15571.label: Psalms 97:8
15571.text: Zion heard and began to rejoice, And the dependent towns of Judah began to be joyful By reason of your judicial decisions, O Jehovah.

15572.label: Psalms 97:9
15572.text: For you, O Jehovah, are the Most High over all the earth; You are very high in your ascent over all [other] gods.

15573.label: Psalms 97:10
15573.text: O YOU lovers of Jehovah, hate what is bad. He is guarding the souls of his loyal ones; Out of the hand of the wicked ones he delivers them.

15574.label: Psalms 97:11
15574.text: Light itself has flashed up for the righteous one, And rejoicing even for the ones upright in heart.

15575.label: Psalms 97:12
15575.text: Rejoice in Jehovah, O YOU righteous ones, And give thanks to his holy memorial.

15577.label: Psalms 98:1
15577.text: SING to Jehovah a new song, For wonderful are the things that he has done. His right hand, even his holy arm, has gained salvation for him.

15578.label: Psalms 98:2
15578.text: Jehovah has made his salvation known; In the eyes of the nations he has revealed his righteousness.

15579.label: Psalms 98:3
15579.text: He has remembered his loving-kindness and his faithfulness to the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation by our God.

15580.label: Psalms 98:4
15580.text: Shout in triumph to Jehovah, all [YOU people of] the earth. Be cheerful and cry out joyfully and make melody.

15581.label: Psalms 98:5
15581.text: Make melody to Jehovah with the harp, With the harp and the voice of melody.

15582.label: Psalms 98:6
15582.text: With the trumpets and the sound of the horn Shout in triumph before the King, Jehovah.

15583.label: Psalms 98:7
15583.text: Let the sea thunder and that which fills it, The productive land and those dwelling in it.

15584.label: Psalms 98:8
15584.text: Let the rivers themselves clap their hands; All together let the very mountains cry out joyfully

15585.label: Psalms 98:9
15585.text: Before Jehovah, for he has come to judge the earth. He will judge the productive land with righteousness And the peoples with uprightness.

15586.label: Psalms 99:1
15586.text: Jehovah himself has become king. Let the peoples be agitated. He is sitting upon the cherubs. Let the earth quiver.

15587.label: Psalms 99:2
15587.text: Jehovah is great in Zion, And he is high over all the peoples.

15588.label: Psalms 99:3
15588.text: Let them laud your name. Great and fear-inspiring, holy it is.

15589.label: Psalms 99:4
15589.text: And with the strength of a king judgment he has loved. You yourself have firmly established uprightness. Judgment and righteousness in Jacob are what you yourself have effected.

15590.label: Psalms 99:5
15590.text: Exalt Jehovah our God and bow down yourselves at his footstool; He is holy.

15591.label: Psalms 99:6
15591.text: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, And Samuel was among those calling upon his name. They were calling to Jehovah, and he himself kept answering them.

15592.label: Psalms 99:7
15592.text: In the pillar of cloud he continued speaking to them. They kept his reminders and the regulation that he gave to them.

15593.label: Psalms 99:8
15593.text: O Jehovah our God, you yourself answered them. A God granting pardon you proved to be to them, And executing vengeance against their notorious deeds.

15594.label: Psalms 99:9
15594.text: Exalt Jehovah our God And bow down yourselves at his holy mountain. For Jehovah our God is holy.

15596.label: Psalms 100:1
15596.text: Shout in triumph to Jehovah, all [YOU people of] the earth.

15597.label: Psalms 100:2
15597.text: Serve Jehovah with rejoicing. Come in before him with a joyful cry.

15598.label: Psalms 100:3
15598.text: Know that Jehovah is God. It is he that has made us, and not we ourselves. [We are] his people and the sheep of his pasturage.

15599.label: Psalms 100:4
15599.text: Come into his gates with thanksgiving, Into his courtyards with praise. Give thanks to him, bless his name.

15600.label: Psalms 100:5
15600.text: For Jehovah is good; His loving-kindness is to time indefinite, And his faithfulness to generation after generation.

15602.label: Psalms 101:1
15602.text: About loving-kindness and judgment I will sing. To you, O Jehovah, I will make melody.

15603.label: Psalms 101:2
15603.text: I will act with discretion in a faultless way. When will you come to me? I shall walk about in the integrity of my heart inside my house.

15604.label: Psalms 101:3
15604.text: I shall not set in front of my eyes any good-for-nothing thing. The doing of those who fall away I have hated; It does not cling to me.

15605.label: Psalms 101:4
15605.text: A crooked heart departs from me; Nothing bad do I know.

15606.label: Psalms 101:5
15606.text: Anyone slandering his companion in secrecy, Him I silence. Anyone of haughty eyes and of arrogant heart, Him I cannot endure.

15607.label: Psalms 101:6
15607.text: My eyes are upon the faithful ones of the earth, That they may dwell with me. The one walking in a faultless way, He it is who will minister to me.

15608.label: Psalms 101:7
15608.text: There will dwell inside my house no worker of trickiness. As for anyone speaking falsehoods, he will not be firmly established In front of my eyes.

15609.label: Psalms 101:8
15609.text: Every morning I shall silence all the wicked ones of the earth, To cut off from the city of Jehovah all the practicers of what is hurtful.

15611.label: Psalms 102:1
15611.text: O Jehovah, do hear my prayer; And to you may my own cry for help come.

15612.label: Psalms 102:2
15612.text: Do not conceal your face from me on the day that I am in sore straits. Incline to me your ear; On the day that I call, hurry, answer me.

15613.label: Psalms 102:3
15613.text: For my days have come to an end just like smoke, And my very bones have been made red-hot just like a fireplace.

15614.label: Psalms 102:4
15614.text: My heart has been struck just like vegetation and is dried up, For I have forgotten to eat my food.

15615.label: Psalms 102:5
15615.text: Because of the sound of my sighing My bones have stuck to my flesh.

15616.label: Psalms 102:6
15616.text: I do resemble the pelican of the wilderness. I have become like a little owl of desolated places.

15617.label: Psalms 102:7
15617.text: I have grown emaciated, And I am become like a bird isolated upon a roof.

15618.label: Psalms 102:8
15618.text: All day long my enemies have reproached me. Those making a fool of me have sworn even by me.

15619.label: Psalms 102:9
15619.text: For I have eaten ashes themselves just like bread; And the things I drink I have mingled even with weeping,

15620.label: Psalms 102:10
15620.text: Because of your denunciation and your indignation; For you have lifted me up, that you might throw me away.

15621.label: Psalms 102:11
15621.text: My days are like a shadow that has declined, And I myself am dried up like mere vegetation.

15622.label: Psalms 102:12
15622.text: As for you, O Jehovah, to time indefinite you will dwell, And your memorial will be for generation after generation.

15623.label: Psalms 102:13
15623.text: You yourself will arise, you will have mercy on Zion, For it is the season to be favorable to her,For the appointed time has come.

15624.label: Psalms 102:14
15624.text: For your servants have found pleasure in her stones, And to her dust they direct their favor.

15625.label: Psalms 102:15
15625.text: And the nations will fear the name of Jehovah, And all the kings of the earth your glory.

15626.label: Psalms 102:16
15626.text: For Jehovah will certainly build up Zion; He must appear in his glory.

15627.label: Psalms 102:17
15627.text: He will certainly turn to the prayer of those stripped [of everything], And not despise their prayer.

15628.label: Psalms 102:18
15628.text: This is written for the future generation; And the people that is to be created will praise Jah.

15629.label: Psalms 102:19
15629.text: For he has looked down from his holy height, From the very heavens Jehovah himself has looked even at the earth,

15630.label: Psalms 102:20
15630.text: To hear the sighing of the prisoner, To loosen those appointed to death;

15631.label: Psalms 102:21
15631.text: For the name of Jehovah to be declared in Zion And his praise in Jerusalem,

15632.label: Psalms 102:22
15632.text: When the peoples are collected all together, And the kingdoms to serve Jehovah.

15633.label: Psalms 102:23
15633.text: On the way he afflicted my power, He cut short my days.

15634.label: Psalms 102:24
15634.text: I proceeded to say: “O my God, Do not take me off at the half of my days; Your years are throughout all generations.

15635.label: Psalms 102:25
15635.text: Long ago you laid the foundations of the earth itself, And the heavens are the work of your hands.

15636.label: Psalms 102:26
15636.text: They themselves will perish, but you yourself will keep standing; And just like a garment they will all of them wear out. Just like clothing you will replace them, and they will finish their turn.

15637.label: Psalms 102:27
15637.text: But you are the same, and your own years will not be completed.

15638.label: Psalms 102:28
15638.text: The sons of your servants will continue residing; And before you their own offspring will be firmly established.”

15640.label: Psalms 103:1
15640.text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul, Even everything within me, his holy name.

15641.label: Psalms 103:2
15641.text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul,And do not forget all his doings,

15642.label: Psalms 103:3
15642.text: Him who is forgiving all your error, Who is healing all your maladies,

15643.label: Psalms 103:4
15643.text: Who is reclaiming your life from the very pit, Who is crowning you with loving-kindness and mercies,

15644.label: Psalms 103:5
15644.text: Who is satisfying your lifetime with what is good; Your youth keeps renewing itself just like that of an eagle.

15645.label: Psalms 103:6
15645.text: Jehovah is executing acts of righteousness And judicial decisions for all those being defrauded.

15646.label: Psalms 103:7
15646.text: He made known his ways to Moses, His dealings even to the sons of Israel.

15647.label: Psalms 103:8
15647.text: Jehovah is merciful and gracious, Slow to anger and abundant in loving-kindness.

15648.label: Psalms 103:9
15648.text: He will not for all time keep finding fault, Neither will he to time indefinite keep resentful.

15649.label: Psalms 103:10
15649.text: He has not done to us even according to our sins; Nor according to our errors has he brought upon us what we deserve.

15650.label: Psalms 103:11
15650.text: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, His loving-kindness is superior toward those fearing him.

15651.label: Psalms 103:12
15651.text: As far off as the sunrise is from the sunset, So far off from us he has put our transgressions.

15652.label: Psalms 103:13
15652.text: As a father shows mercy to his sons, Jehovah has shown mercy to those fearing him.

15653.label: Psalms 103:14
15653.text: For he himself well knows the formation of us, Remembering that we are dust.

15654.label: Psalms 103:15
15654.text: As for mortal man, his days are like those of green grass; Like a blossom of the field is the way he blossoms forth.

15655.label: Psalms 103:16
15655.text: For a mere wind has to pass over it, and it is no more; And its place will acknowledge it no further.

15656.label: Psalms 103:17
15656.text: But the loving-kindness of Jehovah is from time indefinite even to time indefinite Toward those fearing him, And his righteousness to the sons of sons,

15657.label: Psalms 103:18
15657.text: Toward those keeping his covenant And toward those remembering his orders so as to carry them out.

15658.label: Psalms 103:19
15658.text: Jehovah himself has firmly established his throne in the very heavens; And over everything his own kingship has held domination.

15659.label: Psalms 103:20
15659.text: Bless Jehovah, O YOU angels of his, mighty in power, carrying out his word, By listening to the voice of his word.

15660.label: Psalms 103:21
15660.text: Bless Jehovah, all YOU armies of his, You ministers of his, doing his will.

15661.label: Psalms 103:22
15661.text: Bless Jehovah, all YOU his works, In all places of his domination. Bless Jehovah, O my soul.

15662.label: Psalms 104:1
15662.text: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, you have proved very great. With dignity and splendor you have clothed yourself,

15663.label: Psalms 104:2
15663.text: Enwrapping yourself with light as with a garment, Stretching out the heavens like a tent cloth,

15664.label: Psalms 104:3
15664.text: The One building his upper chambers with beams in the very waters, Making the clouds his chariot, Walking upon the wings of the wind,

15665.label: Psalms 104:4
15665.text: Making his angels spirits, His ministers a devouring fire.

15666.label: Psalms 104:5
15666.text: He has founded the earth upon its established places; It will not be made to totter to time indefinite, or forever.

15667.label: Psalms 104:6
15667.text: With a watery deep just like a garment you covered it. The waters were standing above the very mountains.

15668.label: Psalms 104:7
