15668.text: At your rebuke they began to flee; At the sound of your thunder they were sent running in panic—

15669.label: Psalms 104:8
15669.text: Mountains proceeded to ascend, Valley plains proceeded to descend—To the place that you have founded for them.

15670.label: Psalms 104:9
15670.text: A boundary you set, beyond which they should not pass, That they should not again cover the earth.

15671.label: Psalms 104:10
15671.text: He is sending springs into the torrent valleys; Between the mountains they keep going on.

15672.label: Psalms 104:11
15672.text: They continually give drink to all the wild beasts of the open field; The zebras regularly quench their thirst.

15673.label: Psalms 104:12
15673.text: Above them roost the flying creatures of the heavens; From among the thick foliage they keep giving forth sound.

15674.label: Psalms 104:13
15674.text: He is watering the mountains from his upper chambers. With the fruitage of your works the earth is satisfied.

15675.label: Psalms 104:14
15675.text: He is making green grass sprout for the beasts, And vegetation for the service of mankind, To cause food to go forth from the earth,

15676.label: Psalms 104:15
15676.text: And wine that makes the heart of mortal man rejoice, To make the face shine with oil, And bread that sustains the very heart of mortal man.

15677.label: Psalms 104:16
15677.text: The trees of Jehovah are satisfied,The cedars of Lebʹa·non that he planted,

15678.label: Psalms 104:17
15678.text: Where the birds themselves make nests. As for the stork, the juniper trees are its house.

15679.label: Psalms 104:18
15679.text: The high mountains are for the mountain goats; The crags are a refuge for the rock badgers.

15680.label: Psalms 104:19
15680.text: He has made the moon for appointed times; The sun itself knows well where it sets.

15681.label: Psalms 104:20
15681.text: You cause darkness, that it may become night; In it all the wild animals of the forest move forth.

15682.label: Psalms 104:21
15682.text: The maned young lions are roaring for the prey And for seeking their food from God himself.

15683.label: Psalms 104:22
15683.text: The sun begins to shine —they withdrawAnd they lie down in their own hiding places.

15684.label: Psalms 104:23
15684.text: Man goes forth to his activity And to his service until evening.

15685.label: Psalms 104:24
15685.text: How many your works are, O Jehovah! All of them in wisdom you have made. The earth is full of your productions.

15686.label: Psalms 104:25
15686.text: As for this sea so great and wide, There there are moving things without number, Living creatures, small as well as great.

15687.label: Psalms 104:26
15687.text: There the ships go; As for Le·viʹa·than, him you have formed to play about in it.

15688.label: Psalms 104:27
15688.text: All of them—for you they keep waiting To give [them] their food in its season.

15689.label: Psalms 104:28
15689.text: What you give them they pick up. You open your hand—they get satisfied with good things.

15690.label: Psalms 104:29
15690.text: If you conceal your face, they get disturbed. If you take away their spirit, they expire, And back to their dust they go.

15691.label: Psalms 104:30
15691.text: If you send forth your spirit, they are created; And you make the face of the ground new.

15692.label: Psalms 104:31
15692.text: The glory of Jehovah will prove to be to time indefinite. Jehovah will rejoice in his works.

15693.label: Psalms 104:32
15693.text: He is looking at the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

15694.label: Psalms 104:33
15694.text: I will sing to Jehovah throughout my life; I will make melody to my God as long as I am.

15695.label: Psalms 104:34
15695.text: Let my musing about him be pleasurable. I, for my part, shall rejoice in Jehovah.

15696.label: Psalms 104:35
15696.text: The sinners will be finished off from the earth; And as for the wicked, they will be no longer. Bless Jehovah, O my soul. Praise Jah, YOU people!

15697.label: Psalms 105:1
15697.text: GIVE thanks to Jehovah, call upon his name, Make known among the peoples his dealings.

15698.label: Psalms 105:2
15698.text: Sing to him, make melody to him, Concern yourselves with all his wonderful works.

15699.label: Psalms 105:3
15699.text: Make YOUR boast in his holy name. Let the heart of those seeking Jehovah rejoice.

15700.label: Psalms 105:4
15700.text: Search for Jehovah and his strength. Seek his face constantly.

15701.label: Psalms 105:5
15701.text: Remember his wonderful works that he has performed, His miracles and the judicial decisions of his mouth,

15702.label: Psalms 105:6
15702.text: O YOU seed of Abraham his servant, YOU sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

15703.label: Psalms 105:7
15703.text: He is Jehovah our God. His judicial decisions are in all the earth.

15704.label: Psalms 105:8
15704.text: He has remembered his covenant even to time indefinite, The word that he commanded, to a thousand generations,

15705.label: Psalms 105:9
15705.text: Which [covenant] he concluded with Abraham, And his sworn statement to Isaac,

15706.label: Psalms 105:10
15706.text: And which [statement] he kept standing as a regulation even to Jacob,As an indefinitely lasting covenant even to Israel,

15707.label: Psalms 105:11
15707.text: Saying: “To you I shall give the land of Caʹnaan As the allotment of YOUR inheritance.”

15708.label: Psalms 105:12
15708.text: [This was] when they happened to be few in number, Yes, very few, and alien residents in it.

15709.label: Psalms 105:13
15709.text: And they kept walking about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people.

15710.label: Psalms 105:14
15710.text: He did not allow any human to defraud them, But on their account he reproved kings,

15711.label: Psalms 105:15
15711.text: [Saying:] “Do not YOU men touch my anointed ones, And to my prophets do nothing bad.”

15712.label: Psalms 105:16
15712.text: And he proceeded to call for a famine upon the land; He broke every rod around which ring-shaped loaves were suspended.

15713.label: Psalms 105:17
15713.text: He sent ahead of them a man Who was sold to be a slave, Joseph.

15714.label: Psalms 105:18
15714.text: With fetters they afflicted his feet, Into irons his soul came;

15715.label: Psalms 105:19
15715.text: Until the time that his word came, The saying of Jehovah itself refined him.

15716.label: Psalms 105:20
15716.text: The king sent that he might release him, The ruler of the peoples, that he might let him loose.

15717.label: Psalms 105:21
15717.text: He set him as master to his household And as ruler over all his property,

15718.label: Psalms 105:22
15718.text: To bind his princes agreeably to his soul And that he might teach wisdom to even his elderly men.

15719.label: Psalms 105:23
15719.text: And Israel proceeded to come into Egypt, And Jacob himself resided as an alien in the land of Ham.

15720.label: Psalms 105:24
15720.text: And he kept making his people very fruitful, And gradually made them mightier than their adversaries.

15721.label: Psalms 105:25
15721.text: He let their heart change to hate his people, To behave cunningly against his servants.

15722.label: Psalms 105:26
15722.text: He sent Moses his servant, Aaron whom he had chosen.

15723.label: Psalms 105:27
15723.text: They set among them the matters of his signs, And the miracles in the land of Ham.

15724.label: Psalms 105:28
15724.text: He sent darkness and so made it dark; And they did not rebel against his words.

15725.label: Psalms 105:29
15725.text: He changed their waters into blood, And proceeded to put their fish to death.

15726.label: Psalms 105:30
15726.text: Their land swarmed with frogs, In the interior rooms of their kings.

15727.label: Psalms 105:31
15727.text: He said that the gadflies should come in, Gnats in all their territories.

15728.label: Psalms 105:32
15728.text: He made their downpours hail, A flaming fire on their land.

15729.label: Psalms 105:33
15729.text: And he proceeded to strike their vines and their fig treesAnd to break the trees of their territory.

15730.label: Psalms 105:34
15730.text: He said that the locusts should come in, And a species of locust, even without number.

15731.label: Psalms 105:35
15731.text: And they went eating all the vegetation in their land; They also went eating the fruitage of their ground.

15732.label: Psalms 105:36
15732.text: And he proceeded to strike down every firstborn in their land, The beginning of all their generative power.

15733.label: Psalms 105:37
15733.text: And he began to bring them out with silver and gold; And among his tribes there was no one stumbling along.

15734.label: Psalms 105:38
15734.text: Egypt rejoiced when they went out,For the dread of them had fallen upon them.

15735.label: Psalms 105:39
15735.text: He spread out a cloud for a screen, And fire to give light by night.

15736.label: Psalms 105:40
15736.text: They asked, and he proceeded to bring quails, And with bread from heaven he kept satisfying them.

15737.label: Psalms 105:41
15737.text: He opened a rock, and waters began to flow out; These went through the waterless regions as a river.

15738.label: Psalms 105:42
15738.text: For he remembered his holy word with Abraham his servant.

15739.label: Psalms 105:43
15739.text: So he brought out his people with exultation, His chosen ones even with a joyful cry.

15740.label: Psalms 105:44
15740.text: And gradually he gave them the lands of the nations, And they kept taking possession of the product of the hard work of national groups,

15741.label: Psalms 105:45
15741.text: To the end that they might keep his regulations And observe his own laws. Praise Jah, YOU people!

15742.label: Psalms 106:1
15742.text: Praise Jah, YOU people! Give thanks to Jehovah, for he is good; For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite.

15743.label: Psalms 106:2
15743.text: Who can utter the mighty performances of Jehovah, [Or] can make all his praise to be heard?

15744.label: Psalms 106:3
15744.text: Happy are those observing justice, Doing righteousness all the time.

15745.label: Psalms 106:4
15745.text: Remember me, O Jehovah, with the goodwill toward your people. Take care of me with your salvation,

15746.label: Psalms 106:5
15746.text: That I may see the goodness to your chosen ones, That I may rejoice with the rejoicing of your nation, That I may make my boast with your inheritance.

15747.label: Psalms 106:6
15747.text: We have sinned just the same as our forefathers; We have done wrong; we have acted wickedly.

15748.label: Psalms 106:7
15748.text: As for our forefathers in Egypt,They did not show any insight into your wonderful works. They did not remember the abundance of your grand loving-kindness, But they behaved rebelliously at the sea, by the Red Sea.

15749.label: Psalms 106:8
15749.text: And he proceeded to save them for the sake of his name, So as to make his mightiness known.

15750.label: Psalms 106:9
15750.text: Accordingly he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was gradually dried up; And he went walking them through the watery deep as through the wilderness;

15751.label: Psalms 106:10
15751.text: And so he saved them from the hand of the hater And reclaimed them from the hand of the enemy.

15752.label: Psalms 106:11
15752.text: And the waters came covering their adversaries; Not one of them was left.

15753.label: Psalms 106:12
15753.text: Then they had faith in his word; They began to sing his praise.

15754.label: Psalms 106:13
15754.text: Quickly they forgot his works; They did not wait for his counsel.

15755.label: Psalms 106:14
15755.text: But they showed their selfish desire in the wilderness And went putting God to the proof in the desert.

15756.label: Psalms 106:15
15756.text: And he proceeded to give them their request And to send a wasting disease into their soul.

15757.label: Psalms 106:16
15757.text: And they began to envy Moses in the camp, Even Aaron the holy one of Jehovah.

15758.label: Psalms 106:17
15758.text: The earth then opened up and swallowed down Daʹthan, And covered over the assembly of A·biʹram.

15759.label: Psalms 106:18
15759.text: And a fire went burning among their assembly; A flame itself went devouring the wicked ones.

15760.label: Psalms 106:19
15760.text: Furthermore, they made a calf in Hoʹreb And bowed down to a molten image,

15761.label: Psalms 106:20
15761.text: So that they exchanged my glory For a representation of a bull, an eater of vegetation.

15762.label: Psalms 106:21
15762.text: They forgot God their Savior, The Doer of great things in Egypt,

15763.label: Psalms 106:22
15763.text: Wonderful works in the land of Ham, Fear-inspiring things at the Red Sea.

15764.label: Psalms 106:23
15764.text: And he was about to say to annihilate them, If it had not been for Moses his chosen one,Who stood in the gap before him, To turn back his rage from bringing [them] to ruin.

15765.label: Psalms 106:24
15765.text: And they got to contemning the desirable land; They had no faith in his word.

15766.label: Psalms 106:25
15766.text: And they kept grumbling in their tents; They did not listen to the voice of Jehovah.

15767.label: Psalms 106:26
15767.text: So he proceeded to raise his hand [in an oath] concerning them, That he would make them fall in the wilderness,

15768.label: Psalms 106:27
15768.text: And that he would make their offspring fall among the nations, And that he would scatter them among the lands.

15769.label: Psalms 106:28
15769.text: And they began to attach themselves to Baʹal of Peʹor And to eat the sacrifices of the dead ones.

15770.label: Psalms 106:29
15770.text: As they were causing offense by their dealings, A scourge now broke out among them.

15771.label: Psalms 106:30
15771.text: When Phinʹe·has stood up and intervened, Then the scourge was halted.

15772.label: Psalms 106:31
15772.text: And it came to be counted to him as righteousnessFor generation after generation to time indefinite.

15773.label: Psalms 106:32
15773.text: Further, they caused provocation at the waters of Merʹi·bah, So that it went badly with Moses by reason of them.

15774.label: Psalms 106:33
15774.text: For they embittered his spirit And he began to speak rashly with his lips.

15775.label: Psalms 106:34
15775.text: They did not annihilate the peoples, As Jehovah had said to them.

15776.label: Psalms 106:35
15776.text: And they went mingling with the nations And took up learning their works.

15777.label: Psalms 106:36
15777.text: And they kept serving their idols, And these came to be a snare to them.

15778.label: Psalms 106:37
15778.text: And they would sacrifice their sons And their daughters to demons.

15779.label: Psalms 106:38
15779.text: So they kept spilling innocent blood, The blood of their sons and their daughters,Whom they sacrificed to the idols of Caʹnaan; And the land came to be polluted with bloodshed.

15780.label: Psalms 106:39
15780.text: And they got to be unclean by their works And kept having immoral intercourse by their dealings.

15781.label: Psalms 106:40
15781.text: And the anger of Jehovah began to blaze against his people, And he came to detest his inheritance.

15782.label: Psalms 106:41
15782.text: And he repeatedly gave them into the hand of the nations, That those hating them might rule over them,

15783.label: Psalms 106:42
15783.text: And that their enemies might oppress them,And that they might be subdued under their hand.

15784.label: Psalms 106:43
15784.text: Many times he would deliver them, But they themselves would behave rebelliously in their disobedient course, And they would be brought low for their error.

15785.label: Psalms 106:44
15785.text: And he would see the distress of theirs When he heard their entreating cry.

15786.label: Psalms 106:45
15786.text: And he would remember concerning them his covenant, And he would feel regret according to the abundance of his grand loving-kindness.

15787.label: Psalms 106:46
15787.text: And he would grant them to be objects of pityBefore all those holding them captive.

15788.label: Psalms 106:47
15788.text: Save us, O Jehovah our God, And collect us together from the nations To give thanks to your holy name, To speak exultingly in your praise.

15789.label: Psalms 106:48
15789.text: Blessed be Jehovah the God of Israel From time indefinite even to time indefinite;And all the people must say Amen. Praise Jah, YOU people!

15790.label: Psalms 107:1
15790.text: O give thanks to Jehovah, YOU people, for he is good; For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite.

15791.label: Psalms 107:2
15791.text: Let the reclaimed ones of Jehovah say so, Whom he has reclaimed from the hand of the adversary,

15792.label: Psalms 107:3
15792.text: And whom he has collected together even from the lands, From the sunrise and from the sunset, From the north and from the south.

15793.label: Psalms 107:4
15793.text: They wandered about in the wilderness, in the desert; They did not find any way to a city of habitation.

15794.label: Psalms 107:5
15794.text: They were hungry, also thirsty; Their very soul within them began to faint away.

15795.label: Psalms 107:6
15795.text: And they kept crying out to Jehovah in their distress; Out of the stresses upon them he proceeded to deliver them,

15796.label: Psalms 107:7
15796.text: And to have them walk in the right way, So as to come to a city of habitation.

15797.label: Psalms 107:8
15797.text: O let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loving-kindness And for his wonderful works to the sons of men.

15798.label: Psalms 107:9
15798.text: For he has satisfied the dried-out soul; And the hungry soul he has filled with good things.

15799.label: Psalms 107:10
15799.text: There were those dwelling in darkness and deep shadow, Prisoners in affliction and irons.

15800.label: Psalms 107:11
15800.text: For they had behaved rebelliously against the sayings of God; And the counsel of the Most High they had disrespected.

15801.label: Psalms 107:12
15801.text: So with trouble he proceeded to subdue their heart; They stumbled, and there was no one helping.

15802.label: Psalms 107:13
15802.text: And they began calling to Jehovah for help in their distress; Out of the stresses upon them he as usual saved them.

15803.label: Psalms 107:14
15803.text: He went bringing them out from darkness and deep shadow, And tearing even their bands apart.

15804.label: Psalms 107:15
15804.text: O let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loving-kindness And for his wonderful works to the sons of men.

15805.label: Psalms 107:16
15805.text: For he has broken the doors of copper, And he has cut down even the bars of iron.

15806.label: Psalms 107:17
15806.text: Those who were foolish, due to the way of their transgression And due to their errors, finally caused themselves affliction.

15807.label: Psalms 107:18
15807.text: Their soul got to detest even every sort of food, And they were arriving at the gates of death.

15808.label: Psalms 107:19
15808.text: And they began calling to Jehovah for help in their distress; Out of the stresses upon them he as usual saved them.

15809.label: Psalms 107:20
15809.text: He proceeded to send his word and heal them And to provide [them] escape out of their pits.

15810.label: Psalms 107:21
15810.text: O let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loving-kindness And for his wonderful works to the sons of men.

15811.label: Psalms 107:22
15811.text: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving And declare his works with a joyful cry.

15812.label: Psalms 107:23
15812.text: Those going down to the sea in the ships, Doing business on vast waters,

15813.label: Psalms 107:24
15813.text: They are the ones that have seen the works of Jehovah And his wonderful works in the depths;

15814.label: Psalms 107:25
15814.text: How he says [the word] and causes a tempestuous wind to arise, So that it lifts up its waves.

15815.label: Psalms 107:26
15815.text: They go up to the heavens,They go down to the bottoms. Because of the calamity their very soul finds itself melting.

15816.label: Psalms 107:27
15816.text: They reel and move unsteadily like a drunken man, And even all their wisdom proves confused.

15817.label: Psalms 107:28
15817.text: And they begin crying out to Jehovah in their distress, And out of the stresses upon them he brings them forth.

15818.label: Psalms 107:29
15818.text: He causes the windstorm to stand at a calm, So that the waves of the sea keep quiet.

15819.label: Psalms 107:30
15819.text: And they rejoice because these become still,And he leads them to the haven of their delight.

15820.label: Psalms 107:31
15820.text: O let people give thanks to Jehovah for his loving-kindness And for his wonderful works to the sons of men.

15821.label: Psalms 107:32
15821.text: And let them extol him in the congregation of the people; And in the seat of the elderly men let them praise him.

15822.label: Psalms 107:33
15822.text: He converts rivers into a wilderness, And the outflows of water into thirsty ground,

15823.label: Psalms 107:34
15823.text: Fruitful land into salt country, Owing to the badness of those dwelling in it.

15824.label: Psalms 107:35
15824.text: He converts a wilderness into a reedy pool of water, And the land of a waterless region into outflows of water.

15825.label: Psalms 107:36
15825.text: And there he causes the hungry ones to dwell, So that they firmly establish a city of habitation.

15826.label: Psalms 107:37
15826.text: And they sow fields and plant vineyards, That they may yield fruitful crops.

15827.label: Psalms 107:38
15827.text: And he blesses them so that they become very many; And he does not let their cattle become few.

15828.label: Psalms 107:39
15828.text: Again they become few and crouch down Owing to restraint, calamity and grief.

15829.label: Psalms 107:40
15829.text: He is pouring out contempt upon nobles, So that he makes them wander about in a featureless place, where there is no way.

15830.label: Psalms 107:41
15830.text: But he protects the poor one from affliction And converts him into families just like a flock.

15831.label: Psalms 107:42
15831.text: The upright ones see and rejoice; But as for all unrighteousness, it has to shut its mouth.

15832.label: Psalms 107:43
15832.text: Who is wise? He will both observe these things And show himself attentive toward Jehovah’s acts of loving-kindness.

15834.label: Psalms 108:1
15834.text: My heart is steadfast, O God. I will sing and make melody, Even my glory.

15835.label: Psalms 108:2
15835.text: Do awake, O stringed instrument; you too, O harp. I will awaken the dawn.

15836.label: Psalms 108:3
15836.text: I shall laud you among the peoples, O Jehovah; And I shall make melody to you among the national groups.

15837.label: Psalms 108:4
15837.text: For your loving-kindness is great up to the heavens, And your trueness up to the skies.

15838.label: Psalms 108:5
15838.text: O be exalted above the heavens, O God; And let your glory be above all the earth.

15839.label: Psalms 108:6
15839.text: In order that your beloved ones may be rescued, O do save with your right hand and answer me.

15840.label: Psalms 108:7
15840.text: God himself has spoken in his holiness: “I will exult, I will give out Sheʹchem as a portion; And the low plain of Sucʹcoth I shall measure off.

15841.label: Psalms 108:8
15841.text: Gilʹe·ad belongs to me; Ma·nasʹseh belongs to me;And Eʹphra·im is the fortress of my head one; Judah is my commander’s staff.

15842.label: Psalms 108:9
15842.text: Moʹab is my washing pot. Over Eʹdom I shall throw my sandal. Over Phi·lisʹti·a I shall shout in triumph.”

15843.label: Psalms 108:10
15843.text: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will actually lead me as far as Eʹdom?

15844.label: Psalms 108:11
15844.text: Is it not [you], O God, who have cast us off And who do not go forth with our armies as God?

15845.label: Psalms 108:12
15845.text: Do give us assistance from distress, As salvation by earthling man is worthless.

15846.label: Psalms 108:13
15846.text: By God we shall gain vital energy, And he himself will tread down our adversaries.

15848.label: Psalms 109:1
15848.text: O God of my praise, do not keep silent.

15849.label: Psalms 109:2
15849.text: For the mouth of the wicked one and the mouth of deception have opened against me. They have spoken about me with the tongue of falsehood;

15850.label: Psalms 109:3
15850.text: And with words of hatred they have surrounded me, And they keep fighting against me without cause.

15851.label: Psalms 109:4
15851.text: For my love they keep resisting me; But on my part there is prayer.

15852.label: Psalms 109:5
15852.text: And they render to me bad for good And hatred for my love.

15853.label: Psalms 109:6
15853.text: Appoint over him someone wicked,And may a resister himself keep standing at his right hand.

15854.label: Psalms 109:7
15854.text: When he is judged, let him go forth as someone wicked;And let his very prayer become a sin.

15855.label: Psalms 109:8
15855.text: Let his days prove to be few; His office of oversight let someone else take.

15856.label: Psalms 109:9
15856.text: Let his sons become fatherless boys And his wife be a widow.

15857.label: Psalms 109:10
15857.text: And without fail let his sons go wandering about; And they must do begging,And they must look for [food] from their desolate places.

15858.label: Psalms 109:11
15858.text: Let the usurer lay out traps for all that he has, And let strangers make plunder of his product of toil.

15859.label: Psalms 109:12
15859.text: May he come to have no one extending loving-kindness, And may there prove to be no one showing favor to his fatherless boys.

15860.label: Psalms 109:13
15860.text: Let his posterity be for cutting off. In the following generation let their name be wiped out.

15861.label: Psalms 109:14
15861.text: Let the error of his forefathers be remembered to Jehovah, And the sin of his mother —may it not be wiped out.

15862.label: Psalms 109:15
15862.text: Let them prove to be in front of Jehovah constantly; And may he cut off the remembrance of them from the very earth;

15863.label: Psalms 109:16
15863.text: For the reason that he did not remember to exercise loving-kindness, But he kept pursuing the afflicted and poor man And the one dejected at heart, to put [him] to death.

15864.label: Psalms 109:17
15864.text: And he kept loving the malediction, so that it came upon him; And he did not take delight in the blessing, So that it became far away from him;

15865.label: Psalms 109:18
15865.text: And he came to be clothed with malediction as his garment. So it came like waters into the midst of him And like oil into his bones.

15866.label: Psalms 109:19
15866.text: May it prove to be for him like a garment with which he enwraps himself And as a girdle that he keeps girded about himself constantly.

15867.label: Psalms 109:20
15867.text: This is the wages from Jehovah of the one resisting me And of those speaking evil against my soul.

15868.label: Psalms 109:21
15868.text: But you are Jehovah the Sovereign Lord.Deal with me for the sake of your name. Because your loving-kindness is good, deliver me.

15869.label: Psalms 109:22
15869.text: For I am afflicted and poor, And my heart itself has been pierced within me.

15870.label: Psalms 109:23
15870.text: Like a shadow when it declines, I am obliged to go away; I have been shaken off like a locust.

15871.label: Psalms 109:24
15871.text: My knees themselves have swayed from fasting, And my very flesh has grown lean, without any oil.

15872.label: Psalms 109:25
15872.text: And to them I myself have become something reproachable. They see me—they begin wagging their head.

15873.label: Psalms 109:26
15873.text: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Save me according to your loving-kindness.

15874.label: Psalms 109:27
15874.text: And may they know that this is your hand; That you yourself, O Jehovah, have done it.

15875.label: Psalms 109:28
15875.text: Let them, for their part, pronounce a malediction, But may you, for your part, pronounce a blessing. They have risen up, but let them be ashamed, And let your own servant rejoice.

15876.label: Psalms 109:29
15876.text: Let those resisting me be clothed with humiliation, And let them enwrap themselves with their shame just as with a sleeveless coat.

15877.label: Psalms 109:30
15877.text: I shall laud Jehovah very much with my mouth, And in among many people I shall praise him.

15878.label: Psalms 109:31
15878.text: For he will stand at the right hand of the poor, To save [him] from those judging his soul.

15880.label: Psalms 110:1
15880.text: The utterance of Jehovah to my Lord is: “Sit at my right hand Until I place your enemies as a stool for your feet.”

15881.label: Psalms 110:2
15881.text: The rod of your strength Jehovah will send out of Zion, [saying:]“Go subduing in the midst of your enemies.”

15882.label: Psalms 110:3
15882.text: Your people will offer themselves willingly on the day of your military force. In the splendors of holiness, from the womb of the dawn, You have your company of young men just like dewdrops.

15883.label: Psalms 110:4
15883.text: Jehovah has sworn (and he will feel no regret): “You are a priest to time indefinite According to the manner of Mel·chizʹe·dek!”

15884.label: Psalms 110:5
15884.text: Jehovah himself at your right hand Will certainly break kings to pieces on the day of his anger.

15885.label: Psalms 110:6
15885.text: He will execute judgment among the nations; He will cause a fullness of dead bodies. He will certainly break to pieces the head one over a populous land.

15886.label: Psalms 110:7
15886.text: From the torrent valley in the way he will drink. That is why he will raise high [his] head.

15887.label: Psalms 111:1
15887.text: Praise Jah, YOU people! א [ʼAʹleph]I shall laud Jehovah with all [my] heart ב [Behth]In the intimate group of upright ones and the assembly.

15888.label: Psalms 111:2
15888.text: The works of Jehovah are great, ד [Daʹleth]Searched for on the part of all those delighting in them.

15889.label: Psalms 111:3
15889.text: His activity is dignity and splendor themselves, ו [Waw]And his righteousness is standing forever.

15890.label: Psalms 111:4
15890.text: A memorial he has made for his wonderful works. ח [Chehth]Jehovah is gracious and merciful.

15891.label: Psalms 111:5
15891.text: Food he has given to those fearing him. י [Yohdh]To time indefinite he will remember his covenant.

15892.label: Psalms 111:6
15892.text: The power of his works he has told to his people, ל [Laʹmedh]In giving them the inheritance of the nations.

15893.label: Psalms 111:7
15893.text: The works of his hands are truth and judgment; נ [Nun]Trustworthy are all the orders he gives,

15894.label: Psalms 111:8
15894.text: Well supported forever, to time indefinite, ע [ʽAʹyin]Done in truth and uprightness.

15895.label: Psalms 111:9
15895.text: He has sent redemption itself to his people. צ [Tsa·dhehʹ]To time indefinite he has commanded his covenant. ק [Qohph]His name is holy and fear-inspiring.

15896.label: Psalms 111:10
15896.text: The fear of Jehovah is the beginning of wisdom. ש [Sin]All those doing them have a good insight. ת [Taw]His praise is standing forever.

15897.label: Psalms 112:1
15897.text: Praise Jah, YOU people! א [ʼAʹleph]Happy is the man in fear of Jehovah, ב [Behth]In whose commandments he has taken very much delight.

15898.label: Psalms 112:2
15898.text: Mighty in the earth his offspring will become. ד [Daʹleth]As for the generation of the upright ones, it will be blessed.

15899.label: Psalms 112:3
15899.text: Valuable things and riches are in his house; ו [Waw]And his righteousness is standing forever.

15900.label: Psalms 112:4
15900.text: He has flashed up in the darkness as a light to the upright ones. ח [Chehth]He is gracious and merciful and righteous.

15901.label: Psalms 112:5
15901.text: The man is good who is gracious and is lending. י [Yohdh]He sustains his affairs with justice.

15902.label: Psalms 112:6
15902.text: For at no time will he be made to totter. ל [Laʹmedh]The righteous one will prove to be for remembrance to time indefinite.

15903.label: Psalms 112:7
15903.text: He will not be afraid even of bad news. נ [Nun]His heart is steadfast, made reliant upon Jehovah.

15904.label: Psalms 112:8
15904.text: His heart is unshakable; he will not be afraid, ע [ʽAʹyin]Until he looks on his adversaries.

15905.label: Psalms 112:9
15905.text: He has distributed widely; he has given to the poor ones. צ [Tsa·dhehʹ]His righteousness is standing forever. ק [Qohph]His own horn will be exalted with glory.

15906.label: Psalms 112:10
15906.text: The wicked one himself will see and certainly become vexed. ש [Shin]He will grind his very teeth and actually melt away. ת [Taw]The desire of the wicked ones will perish.

15907.label: Psalms 113:1
15907.text: Praise Jah, YOU people! Offer praise, O YOU servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.

15908.label: Psalms 113:2
15908.text: May Jehovah’s name become blessed From now on and to time indefinite.

15909.label: Psalms 113:3
15909.text: From the rising of the sun until its setting Jehovah’s name is to be praised.

15910.label: Psalms 113:4
15910.text: Jehovah has become high above all the nations; His glory is above the heavens.

15911.label: Psalms 113:5
15911.text: Who is like Jehovah our God, Him who is making his dwelling on high?

15912.label: Psalms 113:6
15912.text: He is condescending to look on heaven and earth,

15913.label: Psalms 113:7
15913.text: Raising up the lowly one from the very dust; He exalts the poor one from the ashpit itself,

15914.label: Psalms 113:8
15914.text: To make [him] sit with nobles, With the nobles of his people.

15915.label: Psalms 113:9
15915.text: He is causing the barren woman to dwell in a house As a joyful mother of sons. Praise Jah, YOU people!

15916.label: Psalms 114:1
15916.text: When Israel went forth from Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people speaking unintelligibly,

15917.label: Psalms 114:2
15917.text: Judah became his holy place, Israel his grand dominion.

15918.label: Psalms 114:3
15918.text: The sea itself saw and took to flight; As for the Jordan, it began to turn back.

15919.label: Psalms 114:4
15919.text: The mountains themselves skipped about like rams, The hills like lambs.

15920.label: Psalms 114:5
15920.text: What was the matter with you, O sea, that you took to flight, O Jordan, that you began to turn back?

15921.label: Psalms 114:6
15921.text: O mountains, that YOU went skipping about like rams; O hills, like lambs?

15922.label: Psalms 114:7
15922.text: Because of the Lord be in severe pains, O earth, Because of the God of Jacob,

15923.label: Psalms 114:8
15923.text: Who is changing the rock into a reedy pool of water, A flinty rock into a spring of water.

15924.label: Psalms 115:1
15924.text: To us belongs nothing, O Jehovah, to us belongs nothing, But to your name give glory According to your loving-kindness, according to your trueness.

15925.label: Psalms 115:2
15925.text: Why should the nations say: “Where, now, is their God?”

15926.label: Psalms 115:3
15926.text: But our God is in the heavens; Everything that he delighted [to do] he has done.

15927.label: Psalms 115:4
15927.text: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of the hands of earthling man.

15928.label: Psalms 115:5
15928.text: A mouth they have, but they cannot speak; Eyes they have, but they cannot see;

15929.label: Psalms 115:6
15929.text: Ears they have, but they cannot hear. A nose they have, but they cannot smell.

15930.label: Psalms 115:7
15930.text: Hands are theirs, but they cannot feel. Feet are theirs, but they cannot walk; They utter no sound with their throat.

15931.label: Psalms 115:8
15931.text: Those making them will become just like them, All those who are trusting in them.

15932.label: Psalms 115:9
15932.text: O Israel, trust in Jehovah; He is their help and their shield.

15933.label: Psalms 115:10
15933.text: O house of Aaron, put YOUR trust in Jehovah; He is their help and their shield.

15934.label: Psalms 115:11
15934.text: YOU that fear Jehovah, trust in Jehovah; He is their help and their shield.

15935.label: Psalms 115:12
15935.text: Jehovah himself has remembered us; he will bless, He will bless the house of Israel, He will bless the house of Aaron.

15936.label: Psalms 115:13
15936.text: He will bless those fearing Jehovah, The small ones as well as the great ones.

15937.label: Psalms 115:14
15937.text: Jehovah will give increase to YOU, To YOU and to YOUR sons.

15938.label: Psalms 115:15
15938.text: YOU are the ones blessed by Jehovah, The Maker of heaven and earth.

15939.label: Psalms 115:16
15939.text: As regards the heavens, to Jehovah the heavens belong, But the earth he has given to the sons of men.

15940.label: Psalms 115:17
15940.text: The dead themselves do not praise Jah, Nor do any going down into silence.

15941.label: Psalms 115:18
15941.text: But we ourselves will bless Jah From now on and to time indefinite. Praise Jah, YOU people!

15942.label: Psalms 116:1
15942.text: I do love, because Jehovah hears My voice, my entreaties.

15943.label: Psalms 116:2
15943.text: For he has inclined his ear to me, And throughout my days I shall call.

15944.label: Psalms 116:3
15944.text: The ropes of death encircled me And the distressing circumstances of Sheʹol themselves found me. Distress and grief I kept finding.

15945.label: Psalms 116:4
15945.text: But upon the name of Jehovah I proceeded to call: “Ah, Jehovah, do provide my soul with escape!”

15946.label: Psalms 116:5
15946.text: Jehovah is gracious and righteous; And our God is One showing mercy.

15947.label: Psalms 116:6
15947.text: Jehovah is guarding the inexperienced ones. I was impoverished, and he proceeded to save even me.

15948.label: Psalms 116:7
15948.text: Return to your resting-place, O my soul, For Jehovah himself has acted appropriately toward you.

15949.label: Psalms 116:8
15949.text: For you have rescued my soul from death, My eye from tears, my foot from stumbling.

15950.label: Psalms 116:9
15950.text: I will walk before Jehovah in the lands of those living.

15951.label: Psalms 116:10
15951.text: I had faith, for I proceeded to speak. I myself was very much afflicted.

15952.label: Psalms 116:11
15952.text: I, for my part, said, when I became panicky: “Every man is a liar.”

15953.label: Psalms 116:12
15953.text: What shall I repay to Jehovah For all his benefits to me?

15954.label: Psalms 116:13
15954.text: The cup of grand salvation I shall take up,And on the name of Jehovah I shall call.

15955.label: Psalms 116:14
15955.text: My vows I shall pay to Jehovah, Yes, in front of all his people.

15956.label: Psalms 116:15
15956.text: Precious in the eyes of JehovahIs the death of his loyal ones.

15957.label: Psalms 116:16
15957.text: Ah, now, O Jehovah, For I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your slave girl. You have loosened my bands.

15958.label: Psalms 116:17
15958.text: To you I shall offer the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And on the name of Jehovah I shall call.

15959.label: Psalms 116:18
15959.text: My vows I shall pay to Jehovah, Yes, in front of all his people,

15960.label: Psalms 116:19
15960.text: In the courtyards of the house of Jehovah, In the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise Jah, YOU people!

15961.label: Psalms 117:1
15961.text: Praise Jehovah, all YOU nations; Commend him, all YOU clans.

15962.label: Psalms 117:2
15962.text: For toward us his loving-kindness has proved mighty; And the trueness of Jehovah is to time indefinite.Praise Jah, YOU people!

15963.label: Psalms 118:1
15963.text: Give thanks to Jehovah, YOU people, for he is good; For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite.

15964.label: Psalms 118:2
15964.text: Let Israel now say:“For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite.”

15965.label: Psalms 118:3
15965.text: Let those of the house of Aaron now say: “For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite.”

15966.label: Psalms 118:4
15966.text: Let those fearing Jehovah now say: “For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite.”

15967.label: Psalms 118:5
15967.text: Out of the distressing circumstances I called upon Jah; Jah answered [and put] me into a roomy place.

15968.label: Psalms 118:6
15968.text: Jehovah is on my side; I shall not fear. What can earthling man do to me?

15969.label: Psalms 118:7
15969.text: Jehovah is on my side among those helping me, So that I myself shall look upon those hating me.

15970.label: Psalms 118:8
15970.text: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to trust in earthling man.

15971.label: Psalms 118:9
15971.text: It is better to take refuge in Jehovah Than to trust in nobles.

15972.label: Psalms 118:10
15972.text: All the nations themselves surrounded me. It was in the name of Jehovah that I kept holding them off.

15973.label: Psalms 118:11
15973.text: They surrounded me, yes, they had me surrounded. It was in the name of Jehovah that I kept holding them off.

15974.label: Psalms 118:12
15974.text: They surrounded me like bees; They were extinguished like a fire of thornbushes. It was in the name of Jehovah that I kept holding them off.

15975.label: Psalms 118:13
15975.text: You pushed me hard that I should fall, But Jehovah himself helped me.

15976.label: Psalms 118:14
15976.text: Jah is my shelter and [my] might, And to me he becomes salvation.

15977.label: Psalms 118:15
15977.text: The voice of a joyful cry and salvation Is in the tents of the righteous ones. The right hand of Jehovah is demonstrating vital energy.

15978.label: Psalms 118:16
15978.text: The right hand of Jehovah is exalting [itself]; The right hand of Jehovah is demonstrating vital energy.

15979.label: Psalms 118:17
15979.text: I shall not die, but I shall keep living, That I may declare the works of Jah.

15980.label: Psalms 118:18
15980.text: Jah corrected me severely, But he did not give me over to death itself.

15981.label: Psalms 118:19
15981.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness, YOU people.I shall go into them; I shall laud Jah.

15982.label: Psalms 118:20
15982.text: This is the gate of Jehovah. The righteous themselves will go into it.

15983.label: Psalms 118:21
15983.text: I shall laud you, for you answered me And you came to be my salvation.

15984.label: Psalms 118:22
15984.text: The stone that the builders rejected Has become the head of the corner.

15985.label: Psalms 118:23
15985.text: This has come to be from Jehovah himself; It is wonderful in our eyes.

15986.label: Psalms 118:24
15986.text: This is the day that Jehovah has made; We will be joyful and rejoice in it.

15987.label: Psalms 118:25
15987.text: Ah, now, Jehovah, do save, please! Ah, now, Jehovah, do grant success, please!

15988.label: Psalms 118:26
15988.text: Blessed be the One coming in the name of Jehovah; We have blessed YOU people out of the house of Jehovah.

15989.label: Psalms 118:27
15989.text: Jehovah is the Divine One, And he gives us light. Bind the festival procession with boughs, O YOU people,As far as the horns of the altar.

15990.label: Psalms 118:28
15990.text: You are my Divine One, and I shall laud you; My God —I shall exalt you.

15991.label: Psalms 118:29
15991.text: Give thanks to Jehovah, YOU people, for he is good; For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite.

15992.label: Psalms 119:1
15992.text: Happy are the ones faultless in [their] way, The ones walking in the law of Jehovah.

15993.label: Psalms 119:2
15993.text: Happy are those observing his reminders; With all the heart they keep searching for him.

15994.label: Psalms 119:3
15994.text: Really they have practiced no unrighteousness. In his ways they have walked.

15995.label: Psalms 119:4
15995.text: You yourself have commandingly given your orders To be carefully kept.

15996.label: Psalms 119:5
15996.text: O that my ways were firmly established To keep your regulations!

15997.label: Psalms 119:6
15997.text: In that case I should not be ashamed, When I look to all your commandments.

15998.label: Psalms 119:7
15998.text: I shall laud you in uprightness of heart, When I learn your righteous judicial decisions.

15999.label: Psalms 119:8
15999.text: Your regulations I continue to keep. O do not leave me entirely.

16000.label: Psalms 119:9
16000.text: How will a young man cleanse his path?By keeping on guard according to your word.

16001.label: Psalms 119:10
16001.text: With my whole heart I have searched for you. Do not cause me to go astray from your commandments.

16002.label: Psalms 119:11
16002.text: In my heart I have treasured up your saying, In order that I may not sin against you.

16003.label: Psalms 119:12
16003.text: Blessed you are, O Jehovah.Teach me your regulations.

16004.label: Psalms 119:13
16004.text: With my lips I have declared All the judicial decisions of your mouth.

16005.label: Psalms 119:14
16005.text: In the way of your reminders I have exulted, Just as over all other valuable things.

16006.label: Psalms 119:15
16006.text: With your orders I will concern myself, And I will look to your paths.

16007.label: Psalms 119:16
16007.text: For your statutes I shall show a fondness. I shall not forget your word.

16008.label: Psalms 119:17
16008.text: Act appropriately toward your servant, that I may live And that I may keep your word.

16009.label: Psalms 119:18
16009.text: Uncover my eyes, that I may look At the wonderful things out of your law.

16010.label: Psalms 119:19
16010.text: I am but an alien resident in the land. Do not conceal from me your commandments.

16011.label: Psalms 119:20
16011.text: My soul is crushed with longing For your judicial decisions all the time.

16012.label: Psalms 119:21
16012.text: You have rebuked the cursed presumptuous ones, Who are straying from your commandments.

16013.label: Psalms 119:22
16013.text: Roll off me reproach and contempt, For I have observed your own reminders.

16014.label: Psalms 119:23
16014.text: Even princes have sat; against me they have spoken with one another. As for your servant, he concerns himself with your regulations.

16015.label: Psalms 119:24
16015.text: Also, your reminders are what I am fond of, As men of my counsel.

16016.label: Psalms 119:25
16016.text: My soul has been cleaving to the very dust. Preserve me alive according to your word.

16017.label: Psalms 119:26
16017.text: I have declared my own ways, that you may answer me. Teach me your regulations.

16018.label: Psalms 119:27
16018.text: Make me understand the way of your own orders, That I may concern myself with your wonderful works.

16019.label: Psalms 119:28
16019.text: My soul has been sleepless from grief. Raise me up according to your word.

16020.label: Psalms 119:29
16020.text: Remove from me even the false way, And favor me with your own law.

16021.label: Psalms 119:30
16021.text: The way of faithfulness I have chosen. Your judicial decisions I have considered appropriate.

16022.label: Psalms 119:31
16022.text: I have cleaved to your reminders. O Jehovah, do not put me to shame.

16023.label: Psalms 119:32
16023.text: I shall run the very way of your commandments, Because you make my heart have the room.

16024.label: Psalms 119:33
16024.text: Instruct me, O Jehovah, in the way of your regulations, That I may observe it down to the last.

16025.label: Psalms 119:34
16025.text: Make me understand, that I may observe your law And that I may keep it with the whole heart.

16026.label: Psalms 119:35
16026.text: Cause me to tread in the pathway of your commandments, For in it I have taken delight.

16027.label: Psalms 119:36
16027.text: Incline my heart to your reminders, And not to profits.

16028.label: Psalms 119:37
16028.text: Make my eyes pass on from seeing what is worthless; Preserve me alive in your own way.

16029.label: Psalms 119:38
16029.text: Carry out to your servant your saying That [tends] to the fear of you.

16030.label: Psalms 119:39
16030.text: Make my reproach pass away, of which I have been scared, For your judicial decisions are good.

16031.label: Psalms 119:40
16031.text: Look! I have longed for your orders. In your righteousness preserve me alive.

16032.label: Psalms 119:41
16032.text: And may your loving-kindnesses come to me, O Jehovah, Your salvation according to your saying,

16033.label: Psalms 119:42
16033.text: That I may answer the one reproaching me with a word, For I have trusted in your word.

16034.label: Psalms 119:43
16034.text: And do not take away from my mouth the word of truth entirely, For I have waited for your own judicial decision.

16035.label: Psalms 119:44
16035.text: And I will keep your law constantly, To time indefinite, even forever.

16036.label: Psalms 119:45
16036.text: And I will walk about in a roomy place, For I have searched even for your orders.

16037.label: Psalms 119:46
16037.text: I will also speak about your reminders in front of kings, And I shall not be ashamed.

16038.label: Psalms 119:47
16038.text: And I shall show a fondness for your commandments That I have loved.

16039.label: Psalms 119:48
16039.text: And I shall raise my palms to your commandments that I have loved, And I will concern myself with your regulations.

16040.label: Psalms 119:49
16040.text: Remember the word to your servant, For which you have made me wait.

16041.label: Psalms 119:50
16041.text: This is my comfort in my affliction, For your own saying has preserved me alive.

16042.label: Psalms 119:51
16042.text: The presumptuous ones themselves have derided me to the extreme. From your law I have not deviated.

16043.label: Psalms 119:52
16043.text: I have remembered your judicial decisions from time indefinite, O Jehovah, And I find comfort for myself.

16044.label: Psalms 119:53
16044.text: A raging heat itself has taken hold of me because of the wicked, Who are leaving your law.

16045.label: Psalms 119:54
16045.text: Melodies your regulations have become to me In the house of my alien residences.

16046.label: Psalms 119:55
16046.text: In the night I have remembered your name, O Jehovah, That I may keep your law.

16047.label: Psalms 119:56
16047.text: Even this has become mine,Because your orders I have observed.

16048.label: Psalms 119:57
16048.text: Jehovah is my share; I have promised to keep your words.

16049.label: Psalms 119:58
16049.text: I have softened your face with all [my] heart. Show me favor according to your saying.

16050.label: Psalms 119:59
16050.text: I have considered my ways, That I may turn back my feet to your reminders.

16051.label: Psalms 119:60
16051.text: I hurried up, and I did not delay To keep your commandments.

16052.label: Psalms 119:61
16052.text: The very ropes of the wicked ones surrounded me. Your law I did not forget.

16053.label: Psalms 119:62
16053.text: At midnight I get up to give thanks to you For your righteous judicial decisions.

16054.label: Psalms 119:63
16054.text: A partner I am of all those who do fear you, And of those keeping your orders.

16055.label: Psalms 119:64
16055.text: Your loving-kindness, O Jehovah, has filled the earth. Teach me your own regulations.

16056.label: Psalms 119:65
16056.text: You have dealt well indeed with your servant, O Jehovah, according to your word.

16057.label: Psalms 119:66
16057.text: Teach me goodness, sensibleness and knowledge themselves, For in your commandments I have exercised faith.

16058.label: Psalms 119:67
16058.text: Before I was under affliction I was sinning by mistake, But now I have kept your very saying.

16059.label: Psalms 119:68
16059.text: You are good and are doing good. Teach me your regulations.

16060.label: Psalms 119:69
16060.text: The presumptuous have smeared me with falsehood. As for me, with all [my] heart I shall observe your orders.

16061.label: Psalms 119:70
16061.text: Their heart has become unfeeling just like fat. I, for my part, have been fond of your own law.

16062.label: Psalms 119:71
16062.text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, In order that I may learn your regulations.

16063.label: Psalms 119:72
16063.text: The law of your mouth is good for me, More so than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.

16064.label: Psalms 119:73
16064.text: Your own hands have made me, and they proceeded to fix me solidly. Make me understand, that I may learn your commandments.

16065.label: Psalms 119:74
16065.text: Those fearing you are the ones that see me and rejoice, For I have waited for your own word.

16066.label: Psalms 119:75
16066.text: I well know, O Jehovah, that your judicial decisions are righteousness And that with faithfulness you have afflicted me.

16067.label: Psalms 119:76
16067.text: May your loving-kindness serve, please, to comfort me, According to your saying to your servant.

16068.label: Psalms 119:77
16068.text: Let your mercies come to me, that I may keep living; For your law is what I am fond of.

16069.label: Psalms 119:78
16069.text: Let the presumptuous ones be ashamed, for without cause they have misled me. As for me, I concern myself with your orders.

16070.label: Psalms 119:79
16070.text: Let those fearing you turn back to me, Those also knowing your reminders.

16071.label: Psalms 119:80
16071.text: Let my heart prove faultless in your regulations, In order that I may not be ashamed.

16072.label: Psalms 119:81
16072.text: For your salvation my soul has pined away; For your word I have waited.

16073.label: Psalms 119:82
16073.text: My eyes have pined away for your saying, While I say: “When will you comfort me?”

16074.label: Psalms 119:83
16074.text: For I have become like a skin bottle in the smoke.Your regulations I have not forgotten.

16075.label: Psalms 119:84
16075.text: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment against those persecuting me?

16076.label: Psalms 119:85
16076.text: The presumptuous have excavated pitfalls to get me, Those who are not in accord with your law.

16077.label: Psalms 119:86
16077.text: All your commandments are faithfulness itself. Without cause they have persecuted me. O help me.

16078.label: Psalms 119:87
16078.text: In a little while they would have exterminated me in the earth; But I myself did not leave your orders.

16079.label: Psalms 119:88
16079.text: According to your loving-kindness preserve me alive, That I may keep the reminder of your mouth.

16080.label: Psalms 119:89
16080.text: To time indefinite, O Jehovah, Your word is stationed in the heavens.

16081.label: Psalms 119:90
16081.text: Your faithfulness is for generation after generation. You have solidly fixed the earth, that it may keep standing.

16082.label: Psalms 119:91
16082.text: According to your judicial decisions they have stood [till] today, For they are all your servants.

16083.label: Psalms 119:92
16083.text: If your law had not been what I am fond of, Then I should have perished in my affliction.

16084.label: Psalms 119:93
16084.text: To time indefinite I shall not forget your orders, Because by them you have preserved me alive.

16085.label: Psalms 119:94
16085.text: I am yours. O save me, Because I have searched for your own orders.

16086.label: Psalms 119:95
16086.text: For me the wicked have waited, to destroy me. To your reminders I keep showing myself attentive.

16087.label: Psalms 119:96
16087.text: To all perfection I have seen an end. Your commandment is very broad.

16088.label: Psalms 119:97
16088.text: How I do love your law! All day long it is my concern.

16089.label: Psalms 119:98
16089.text: Wiser than my enemies your commandment makes me, Because to time indefinite it is mine.

16090.label: Psalms 119:99
16090.text: More insight than all my teachers I have come to have, Because your reminders are a concern to me.

16091.label: Psalms 119:100
16091.text: With more understanding than older men I behave, Because I have observed your own orders.

16092.label: Psalms 119:101
16092.text: From every bad path I have restrained my feet, For the purpose that I may keep your word.

16093.label: Psalms 119:102
16093.text: From your judicial decisions I have not turned aside, For you yourself have instructed me.

16094.label: Psalms 119:103
16094.text: How smooth to my palate your sayings have been,More so than honey to my mouth!

16095.label: Psalms 119:104
16095.text: Owing to your orders I behave with understanding. That is why I have hated every false path.

16096.label: Psalms 119:105
16096.text: Your word is a lamp to my foot, And a light to my roadway.

16097.label: Psalms 119:106
16097.text: I have made a sworn statement, and I will carry it out, To keep your righteous judicial decisions.

16098.label: Psalms 119:107
16098.text: I have been afflicted to a great extent. O Jehovah, preserve me alive according to your word.

16099.label: Psalms 119:108
16099.text: Please take pleasure in the voluntary offerings of my mouth, O Jehovah, And teach me your own judicial decisions.

16100.label: Psalms 119:109
16100.text: My soul is in my palm constantly; But your law I have not forgotten.

16101.label: Psalms 119:110
16101.text: The wicked have set a trap for me, But from your orders I have not wandered.

16102.label: Psalms 119:111
16102.text: I have taken your reminders as a possession to time indefinite, For they are the exultation of my heart.

16103.label: Psalms 119:112
16103.text: I have inclined my heart to do your regulations To time indefinite, down to the last.

16104.label: Psalms 119:113
16104.text: The halfhearted ones I have hated, But your law I have loved.

16105.label: Psalms 119:114
16105.text: You are my place of concealment and my shield. For your word I have waited.

16106.label: Psalms 119:115
16106.text: Get away from me, YOU evildoers, That I may observe the commandments of my God.

16107.label: Psalms 119:116
16107.text: Support me according to your saying, that I may keep living, And do not put me to shame for my hope.

16108.label: Psalms 119:117
16108.text: Sustain me, that I may be saved, And I shall gaze upon your regulations constantly.

16109.label: Psalms 119:118
16109.text: You have tossed away all those straying from your regulations; For their trickiness is falsehood.

16110.label: Psalms 119:119
16110.text: As scummy dross you have made all the wicked ones of the earth to cease. Therefore I have loved your reminders.

16111.label: Psalms 119:120
16111.text: From the dread of you my flesh has had a creepy feeling; And because of your judicial decisions I have been afraid.

16112.label: Psalms 119:121
16112.text: I have executed judgment and righteousness. O do not abandon me to those defrauding me!

16113.label: Psalms 119:122
16113.text: Act as a surety for your servant for what is good. May the presumptuous ones not defraud me.

16114.label: Psalms 119:123
16114.text: My very eyes have pined away for your salvation And for your righteous saying.

16115.label: Psalms 119:124
16115.text: Do with your servant according to your loving-kindness, And teach me your own regulations.

16116.label: Psalms 119:125
16116.text: I am your servant. Make me understand, That I may know your reminders.

16117.label: Psalms 119:126
16117.text: It is the time for Jehovah to act. They have broken your law.

16118.label: Psalms 119:127
16118.text: That is why I have loved your commandments More than gold, even refined gold.

16119.label: Psalms 119:128
16119.text: That is why I have considered all orders regarding all things to be right; Every false path I have hated.

16120.label: Psalms 119:129
16120.text: Your reminders are wonderful. That is why my soul has observed them.

16121.label: Psalms 119:130
16121.text: The very disclosure of your words gives light, Making the inexperienced ones understand.

16122.label: Psalms 119:131
16122.text: My mouth I have opened wide, that I may pant, Because for your commandments I have longed.

16123.label: Psalms 119:132
16123.text: Turn to me and show me favor, According to [your] judicial decision toward those loving your name.

16124.label: Psalms 119:133
16124.text: Fix my own steps solidly in your saying, And may no kind of hurtful thing domineer over me.

16125.label: Psalms 119:134
16125.text: Redeem me from any defrauder of mankind, And I will keep your orders.

16126.label: Psalms 119:135
16126.text: Make your own face shine upon your servant, And teach me your regulations.

16127.label: Psalms 119:136
16127.text: Streams of water have run down my eyes Over the fact that they have not kept your law.

16128.label: Psalms 119:137
16128.text: You are righteous, O Jehovah, And your judicial decisions are upright.

16129.label: Psalms 119:138
16129.text: You have commanded your reminders in righteousnessAnd in exceeding faithfulness.

16130.label: Psalms 119:139
16130.text: My ardor has made an end of me, Because my adversaries have forgotten your words.

16131.label: Psalms 119:140
16131.text: Your saying is very much refined, And your own servant loves it.

16132.label: Psalms 119:141
16132.text: I am insignificant and contemptible. Your orders I have not forgotten.

16133.label: Psalms 119:142
16133.text: Your righteousness is a righteousness to time indefinite, And your law is truth.

16134.label: Psalms 119:143
16134.text: Distress and difficulty themselves found me. Your commandments I was fond of.

16135.label: Psalms 119:144
16135.text: The righteousness of your reminders is to time indefinite. Make me understand, that I may keep living.

16136.label: Psalms 119:145
16136.text: I have called with [my] whole heart. Answer me, O Jehovah. Your regulations I will observe.

16137.label: Psalms 119:146
16137.text: I have called upon you. O save me! And I will keep your reminders.

16138.label: Psalms 119:147
16138.text: I have been up early in the morning twilight, that I may cry for help. For your words I have waited.

16139.label: Psalms 119:148
16139.text: My eyes have been ahead of the night watches, [For me] to concern myself with your saying.

16140.label: Psalms 119:149
16140.text: O do hear my own voice according to your loving-kindness. O Jehovah, according to your judicial decision preserve me alive.

16141.label: Psalms 119:150
16141.text: Those in pursuit of loose conduct have come near; They have got far away from your own law.

16142.label: Psalms 119:151
16142.text: You are near, O Jehovah, And all your commandments are truth.

16143.label: Psalms 119:152
16143.text: Long ago I have known some of your reminders, For to time indefinite you have founded them.

16144.label: Psalms 119:153
16144.text: O see my affliction, and rescue me; For I have not forgotten your own law.

16145.label: Psalms 119:154
16145.text: O do conduct my legal case and recover me; Preserve me alive in agreement with your saying.

16146.label: Psalms 119:155
16146.text: Salvation is far away from the wicked ones, For they have not searched for your own regulations.

16147.label: Psalms 119:156
16147.text: Many are your mercies, O Jehovah. According to your judicial decisions, O preserve me alive.

16148.label: Psalms 119:157
16148.text: My persecutors and my adversaries are many. From your reminders I have not deviated.

16149.label: Psalms 119:158
16149.text: I have seen those who are treacherous in dealing, And I do feel a loathing, because they have not kept your own saying.

16150.label: Psalms 119:159
16150.text: O see that I have loved your own orders. O Jehovah, according to your loving-kindness preserve me alive.

16151.label: Psalms 119:160
16151.text: The substance of your word is truth, And every righteous judicial decision of yours is to time indefinite.

16152.label: Psalms 119:161
16152.text: Princes themselves have persecuted me for no cause, But my heart has been in dread of your own words.

16153.label: Psalms 119:162
16153.text: I am exulting over your saying Just as one does when finding much spoil.

16154.label: Psalms 119:163
16154.text: Falsehood I have hated, and I do keep detesting it. Your law I have loved.

16155.label: Psalms 119:164
16155.text: Seven times in the day I have praised you Because of your righteous judicial decisions.

16156.label: Psalms 119:165
16156.text: Abundant peace belongs to those loving your law, And for them there is no stumbling block.

16157.label: Psalms 119:166
16157.text: I have hoped for your salvation, O Jehovah, And I have done your own commandments.

16158.label: Psalms 119:167
16158.text: My soul has kept your reminders, And I love them exceedingly.

16159.label: Psalms 119:168
16159.text: I have kept your orders and your reminders, For all my ways are in front of you.

16160.label: Psalms 119:169
16160.text: May my entreating cry come near before you, O Jehovah. According to your word, O make me understand.

16161.label: Psalms 119:170
16161.text: May my request for favor enter in before you. According to your saying, O deliver me.

16162.label: Psalms 119:171
16162.text: May my lips bubble forth praise, For you teach me your regulations.

16163.label: Psalms 119:172
16163.text: May my tongue sing forth your saying, For all your commandments are righteousness.

16164.label: Psalms 119:173
16164.text: May your hand serve to help me, Because your orders I have chosen.

16165.label: Psalms 119:174
16165.text: I have longed for your salvation, O Jehovah, And your law I am fond of.

16166.label: Psalms 119:175
16166.text: May my soul keep living and praising you, And may your own judicial decisions help me.

16167.label: Psalms 119:176
16167.text: I have wandered like a lost sheep. O look for your servant, For I have not forgotten your own commandments.

16169.label: Psalms 120:1
16169.text: To Jehovah I called in the distress of mine, And he proceeded to answer me.

16170.label: Psalms 120:2
16170.text: O Jehovah, do deliver my soul from false lips, From the tricky tongue.

16171.label: Psalms 120:3
16171.text: What will one give to you, and what will one add to you,O you tricky tongue?

16172.label: Psalms 120:4
16172.text: Sharpened arrows of a mighty man, Along with burning coals of the broom trees.

16173.label: Psalms 120:5
16173.text: Woe to me, for I have resided as an alien in Meʹshech! I have tabernacled together with the tents of Keʹdar.

16174.label: Psalms 120:6
16174.text: For too long a time my soul has tabernacled With the haters of peace.

16175.label: Psalms 120:7
16175.text: I stand for peace; but when I speak,They are for war.

16177.label: Psalms 121:1
16177.text: I shall raise my eyes to the mountains. From where will my help come?

16178.label: Psalms 121:2
16178.text: My help is from Jehovah, The Maker of heaven and earth.

16179.label: Psalms 121:3
16179.text: He cannot possibly allow your foot to totter. The One guarding you cannot possibly be drowsy.

16180.label: Psalms 121:4
16180.text: Look! He will not be drowsy nor go to sleep, He that is guarding Israel.

16181.label: Psalms 121:5
16181.text: Jehovah is guarding you. Jehovah is your shade on your right hand.

16182.label: Psalms 121:6
16182.text: By day the sun itself will not strike you, Nor the moon by night.

16183.label: Psalms 121:7
16183.text: Jehovah himself will guard you against all calamity. He will guard your soul.

16184.label: Psalms 121:8
16184.text: Jehovah himself will guard your going out and your coming in From now on and to time indefinite.

16186.label: Psalms 122:1
16186.text: I rejoiced when they were saying to me: “To the house of Jehovah let us go.”

16187.label: Psalms 122:2
16187.text: Our feet proved to be standing Within your gates, O Jerusalem.

16188.label: Psalms 122:3
16188.text: Jerusalem is one that is built like a city That has been joined together in oneness,

16189.label: Psalms 122:4
16189.text: To which the tribes have gone up, The tribes of Jah, As a reminder to Israel To give thanks to the name of Jehovah.

16190.label: Psalms 122:5
16190.text: For there the thrones for judgment have been sitting, Thrones for the house of David.

16191.label: Psalms 122:6
16191.text: Ask, O YOU people, for the peace of Jerusalem. Those loving you, [O city,] will be free from care.

16192.label: Psalms 122:7
16192.text: May peace continue within your rampart, Freedom from care within your dwelling towers.

16193.label: Psalms 122:8
16193.text: For the sake of my brothers and my companions I will now speak: “May there be peace within you.”

16194.label: Psalms 122:9
16194.text: For the sake of the house of Jehovah our God I will keep seeking good for you.

16196.label: Psalms 123:1
16196.text: To you I have raised my eyes, O You who are dwelling in the heavens.

16197.label: Psalms 123:2
16197.text: Look! As the eyes of servants are toward the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maidservant are toward the hand of her mistress, So our eyes are toward Jehovah our God Until he shows us favor.

16198.label: Psalms 123:3
16198.text: Show us favor, O Jehovah, show us favor; For to an abundance we have been glutted with contempt.

16199.label: Psalms 123:4
16199.text: Abundantly our soul has been glutted with the derision of those who are at ease, Of the contempt on the part of the arrogant ones.

16201.label: Psalms 124:1
16201.text: “Had it not been that Jehovah proved to be for us,” Let Israel now say,

16202.label: Psalms 124:2
16202.text: “Had it not been that Jehovah proved to be for us When men rose up against us,

16203.label: Psalms 124:3
16203.text: Then they would have swallowed us up even alive, When their anger was burning against us.

16204.label: Psalms 124:4
16204.text: Then the very waters would have washed us away, The torrent itself would have passed over our soul.

16205.label: Psalms 124:5
16205.text: Then there would have passed over our soulThe waters of presumptuousness.

16206.label: Psalms 124:6
16206.text: Blessed be Jehovah, who has not given us As a prey to their teeth.

16207.label: Psalms 124:7
16207.text: Our soul is like a bird that is escaped From the trap of baiters. The trap is broken, And we ourselves have escaped.

16208.label: Psalms 124:8
16208.text: Our help is in the name of Jehovah, The Maker of heaven and earth.”

16210.label: Psalms 125:1
16210.text: Those trusting in Jehovah Are like Mount Zion, which cannot be made to totter, but dwells even to time indefinite.

16211.label: Psalms 125:2
16211.text: Jerusalem—as mountains are all around it, So Jehovah is all around his people From now on and to time indefinite.

16212.label: Psalms 125:3
16212.text: For the scepter of wickedness will not keep resting upon the lot of the righteous ones,In order that the righteous ones may not thrust out their hand upon any wrongdoing.

16213.label: Psalms 125:4
16213.text: O do good, O Jehovah, to the good ones, Even to the ones upright in their hearts.

16214.label: Psalms 125:5
16214.text: As for those turning aside to their crooked ways, Jehovah will make them go away with the practicers of what is hurtful. There will be peace upon Israel.

16216.label: Psalms 126:1
16216.text: When Jehovah gathered back the captive ones of Zion, We became like those who were dreaming.

16217.label: Psalms 126:2
16217.text: At that time our mouth came to be filled with laughter, And our tongue with a joyful cry. At that time they proceeded to say among the nations: “Jehovah has done a great thing in what he has done with them.”

16218.label: Psalms 126:3
16218.text: Jehovah has done a great thing in what he has done with us. We have become joyful.

16219.label: Psalms 126:4
16219.text: Do gather back, O Jehovah, our company of captives, Like streambeds in the Negʹeb.

16220.label: Psalms 126:5
16220.text: Those sowing seed with tears Will reap even with a joyful cry.

16221.label: Psalms 126:6
16221.text: The one that without fail goes forth, even weeping, Carrying along a bagful of seed, Will without fail come in with a joyful cry, Carrying along his sheaves.

16223.label: Psalms 127:1
16223.text: Unless Jehovah himself builds the house, It is to no avail that its builders have worked hard on it. Unless Jehovah himself guards the city, It is to no avail that the guard has kept awake.

16224.label: Psalms 127:2
16224.text: To no avail it is for YOU men that YOU are rising up early, That YOU are sitting down late, That YOU are eating food with pains. Just like this he gives sleep even to his beloved one.

16225.label: Psalms 127:3
16225.text: Look! Sons are an inheritance from Jehovah; The fruitage of the belly is a reward.

16226.label: Psalms 127:4
16226.text: Like arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the sons of youth.

16227.label: Psalms 127:5
16227.text: Happy is the able-bodied man that has filled his quiver with them.They will not be ashamed, For they will speak with enemies in the gate.

16229.label: Psalms 128:1
16229.text: Happy is everyone fearing Jehovah, Who is walking in his ways.

16230.label: Psalms 128:2
16230.text: For you will eat the toil of your own hands. Happy you will be and it will be well with you.

16231.label: Psalms 128:3
16231.text: Your wife will be like a fruit-bearing vine In the innermost parts of your house.Your sons will be like slips of olive trees all around your table.

16232.label: Psalms 128:4
16232.text: Look! That is how the able-bodied man will be blessed Who fears Jehovah.

16233.label: Psalms 128:5
16233.text: Jehovah will bless you out of Zion. See also the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life,

16234.label: Psalms 128:6
16234.text: And see the sons of your sons. May there be peace upon Israel.

16236.label: Psalms 129:1
16236.text: “Long enough they have shown hostility to me from my youth,” Let Israel now say,

16237.label: Psalms 129:2
16237.text: “Long enough they have shown hostility to me from my youth; Yet they have not prevailed over me.

16238.label: Psalms 129:3
16238.text: Plowmen have plowed upon my very back; They have lengthened their furrows.”

16239.label: Psalms 129:4
16239.text: Jehovah is righteous. He has cut in pieces the ropes of the wicked ones.

16240.label: Psalms 129:5
16240.text: They will be ashamed and turn themselves back, All those hating Zion.

16241.label: Psalms 129:6
16241.text: They will become like green grass of the roofs, Which before it has been torn out has dried up,

16242.label: Psalms 129:7
16242.text: With which the reaper has not filled his own hand, Nor anyone gathering sheaves his own bosom.

16243.label: Psalms 129:8
16243.text: Nor have those passing by said:“The blessing of Jehovah be upon YOU men. We have blessed YOU in the name of Jehovah.”

16245.label: Psalms 130:1
16245.text: Out of the depths I have called upon you, O Jehovah.

16246.label: Psalms 130:2
16246.text: O Jehovah, do hear my voice. May your ears prove to be attentive to the voice of my entreaties.

16247.label: Psalms 130:3
16247.text: If errors were what you watch, O Jah, O Jehovah, who could stand?

16248.label: Psalms 130:4
16248.text: For there is the [true] forgiveness with you, In order that you may be feared.

16249.label: Psalms 130:5
16249.text: I have hoped, O Jehovah, my soul has hoped, And for his word I have waited.

16250.label: Psalms 130:6
16250.text: My soul [has waited] for Jehovah More than watchmen for the morning, Watching for the morning.

16251.label: Psalms 130:7
16251.text: Let Israel keep waiting for Jehovah. For there is loving-kindness with Jehovah, And abundantly so is there redemption with him.

16252.label: Psalms 130:8
16252.text: And he himself will redeem Israel out of all his errors.

16254.label: Psalms 131:1
16254.text: O Jehovah, my heart has not been haughty, Nor have my eyes been lofty; Nor have I walked in things too great, Nor in things too wonderful for me.

16255.label: Psalms 131:2
16255.text: Surely I have soothed and quieted my soul Like a weanling upon his mother. My soul is like a weanling upon me.

16256.label: Psalms 131:3
16256.text: Let Israel wait for Jehovah From now on and to time indefinite.

16258.label: Psalms 132:1
16258.text: Remember, O Jehovah, concerning David All his humiliations;

16259.label: Psalms 132:2
16259.text: How he swore to Jehovah, How he vowed to the Powerful One of Jacob:

16260.label: Psalms 132:3
16260.text: “I will not go into the tent of my house. I will not go up on the divan of my grand lounge,

16261.label: Psalms 132:4
16261.text: I will not give sleep to my eyes, Nor slumber to my own beaming eyes,

16262.label: Psalms 132:5
16262.text: Until I find a place for Jehovah, A grand tabernacle for the Powerful One of Jacob.”

16263.label: Psalms 132:6
16263.text: Look! We have heard it in Ephʹra·thah, We have found it in the fields of the forest.

16264.label: Psalms 132:7
16264.text: Let us come into his grand tabernacle; Let us bow down at his footstool.

16265.label: Psalms 132:8
16265.text: Do arise, O Jehovah, to your resting-place, You and the ark of your strength.

16266.label: Psalms 132:9
16266.text: Let your priests themselves be clothed with righteousness, And let your own loyal ones cry out joyfully.

16267.label: Psalms 132:10
16267.text: On account of David your servant, Do not turn back the face of your anointed one.

16268.label: Psalms 132:11
16268.text: Jehovah has sworn to David, Truly he will not draw back from it: “Of the fruitage of your belly I shall set on your throne.

16269.label: Psalms 132:12
16269.text: If your sons will keep my covenant And my reminders that I shall teach them, Their sons also forever Will sit upon your throne.”

16270.label: Psalms 132:13
16270.text: For Jehovah has chosen Zion; He has longed for it as a dwelling for himself:

16271.label: Psalms 132:14
16271.text: “This is my resting-place forever; Here I shall dwell, for I have longed for it.

16272.label: Psalms 132:15
16272.text: Its provisions I shall bless without fail. Its poor ones I shall satisfy with bread.

16273.label: Psalms 132:16
16273.text: And its priests I shall clothe with salvation; And its loyal ones will without fail cry out joyfully.

16274.label: Psalms 132:17
16274.text: There I shall cause the horn of David to grow. I have set in order a lamp for my anointed one.

16275.label: Psalms 132:18
16275.text: His enemies I shall clothe with shame; But upon him his diadem will flourish.”

16277.label: Psalms 133:1
16277.text: Look! How good and how pleasant it isFor brothers to dwell together in unity!

16278.label: Psalms 133:2
16278.text: It is like the good oil upon the head, That is running down upon the beard,Aaron’s beard, That is running down to the collar of his garments.

16279.label: Psalms 133:3
16279.text: It is like the dew of Herʹmon That is descending upon the mountains of Zion. For there Jehovah commanded the blessing [to be], [Even] life to time indefinite.

16281.label: Psalms 134:1
16281.text: O bless Jehovah, All YOU servants of Jehovah, YOU who are standing in the house of Jehovah during the nights.

16282.label: Psalms 134:2
16282.text: Raise YOUR hands in holiness And bless Jehovah.

16283.label: Psalms 134:3
16283.text: May Jehovah bless you out of Zion, He the Maker of heaven and earth.

16284.label: Psalms 135:1
16284.text: Praise Jah, YOU people! Praise the name of Jehovah, Offer praise, O servants of Jehovah,

16285.label: Psalms 135:2
16285.text: YOU who are standing in the house of Jehovah, In the courtyards of the house of our God.

16286.label: Psalms 135:3
16286.text: Praise Jah, for Jehovah is good. Make melody to his name, for it is pleasant.

16287.label: Psalms 135:4
16287.text: For Jah has chosen even Jacob for himself, Israel for his special property.

16288.label: Psalms 135:5
16288.text: For I myself well know that Jehovah is great, And our Lord is more than all [other] gods.

16289.label: Psalms 135:6
16289.text: Everything that Jehovah delighted [to do] he has done In the heavens and in the earth, in the seas and all the watery deeps.

16290.label: Psalms 135:7
