16290.text: He is causing vapors to ascend from the extremity of the earth; He has made even sluices for the rain; He is bringing forth the wind from his storehouses,

16291.label: Psalms 135:8
16291.text: He who struck down the firstborn ones of Egypt, Both man and beast.

16292.label: Psalms 135:9
16292.text: He sent signs and miracles into the midst of you, O Egypt, Upon Pharʹaoh and upon all his servants;

16293.label: Psalms 135:10
16293.text: He who struck down many nations And killed potent kings,

16294.label: Psalms 135:11
16294.text: Even Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites And Og the king of Baʹshan And all the kingdoms of Caʹnaan,

16295.label: Psalms 135:12
16295.text: And who gave their land as an inheritance, An inheritance to Israel his people.

16296.label: Psalms 135:13
16296.text: O Jehovah, your name is to time indefinite. O Jehovah, your memorial is to generation after generation.

16297.label: Psalms 135:14
16297.text: For Jehovah will plead the cause of his people, And he will feel regret even over his servants.

16298.label: Psalms 135:15
16298.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of the hands of earthling man.

16299.label: Psalms 135:16
16299.text: A mouth they have, but they can speak nothing; Eyes they have, but they can see nothing;

16300.label: Psalms 135:17
16300.text: Ears they have, but they can give ear to nothing. Also there exists no spirit in their mouth.

16301.label: Psalms 135:18
16301.text: Those making them will become just like them, Everyone who is trusting in them.

16302.label: Psalms 135:19
16302.text: O house of Israel, do YOU men bless Jehovah. O house of Aaron, do YOU men bless Jehovah.

16303.label: Psalms 135:20
16303.text: O house of Leʹvi, do YOU men bless Jehovah. YOU fearers of Jehovah, bless Jehovah.

16304.label: Psalms 135:21
16304.text: Blessed out of Zion be Jehovah, Who is residing in Jerusalem. Praise Jah, YOU people!

16305.label: Psalms 136:1
16305.text: Give thanks to Jehovah, O YOU people, for he is good: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16306.label: Psalms 136:2
16306.text: Give thanks to the God of the gods: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16307.label: Psalms 136:3
16307.text: Give thanks to the Lord of the lords: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16308.label: Psalms 136:4
16308.text: To the Doer of wonderful, great things by himself: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16309.label: Psalms 136:5
16309.text: To the One making the heavens with understanding: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16310.label: Psalms 136:6
16310.text: To the One laying out the earth above the waters: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16311.label: Psalms 136:7
16311.text: To the One making the great lights: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16312.label: Psalms 136:8
16312.text: Even the sun for dominion by day: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16313.label: Psalms 136:9
16313.text: The moon and the stars for combined dominion by night: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16314.label: Psalms 136:10
16314.text: To the One striking down Egypt in their firstborn ones: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16315.label: Psalms 136:11
16315.text: And the One bringing Israel out of the midst of them: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16316.label: Psalms 136:12
16316.text: By a strong hand and by an arm stretched out: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16317.label: Psalms 136:13
16317.text: To the One severing the Red Sea into parts: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16318.label: Psalms 136:14
16318.text: And who caused Israel to pass through the middle of it: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16319.label: Psalms 136:15
16319.text: And who shook off Pharʹaoh and his military force into the Red Sea: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16320.label: Psalms 136:16
16320.text: To the One making his people walk through the wilderness: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16321.label: Psalms 136:17
16321.text: To the One striking down great kings: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16322.label: Psalms 136:18
16322.text: And who proceeded to kill majestic kings: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16323.label: Psalms 136:19
16323.text: Even Siʹhon the king of the Amʹor·ites: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16324.label: Psalms 136:20
16324.text: And Og the king of Baʹshan: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16325.label: Psalms 136:21
16325.text: And who gave their land as an inheritance: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16326.label: Psalms 136:22
16326.text: An inheritance to Israel his servant: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16327.label: Psalms 136:23
16327.text: Who during our low condition remembered us: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16328.label: Psalms 136:24
16328.text: And who repeatedly tore us away from our adversaries: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16329.label: Psalms 136:25
16329.text: The One giving food to all flesh: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite;

16330.label: Psalms 136:26
16330.text: Give thanks to the God of the heavens: For his loving-kindness is to time indefinite.

16331.label: Psalms 137:1
16331.text: By the rivers of Babylon —there we sat down. We also wept when we remembered Zion.

16332.label: Psalms 137:2
16332.text: Upon the poplar trees in the midst of her We hung our harps.

16333.label: Psalms 137:3
16333.text: For there those holding us captive asked us for the words of a song, And those mocking us—for rejoicing: “SING for us one of the songs of Zion.”

16334.label: Psalms 137:4
16334.text: How can we sing the song of Jehovah Upon foreign ground?

16335.label: Psalms 137:5
16335.text: If I should forget you, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand be forgetful.

16336.label: Psalms 137:6
16336.text: Let my tongue stick to my palate, If I were not to remember you, If I were not to make Jerusalem ascendAbove my chief cause for rejoicing.

16337.label: Psalms 137:7
16337.text: Remember, O Jehovah, regarding the sons of Eʹdom the day of Jerusalem, Who were saying: “Lay [it] bare! Lay [it] bare to the foundation within it!”

16338.label: Psalms 137:8
16338.text: O daughter of Babylon, who are to be despoiled, Happy will he be that rewards you With your own treatment with which you treated us.

16339.label: Psalms 137:9
16339.text: Happy will he be that grabs ahold and does dash to pieces Your children against the crag.

16341.label: Psalms 138:1
16341.text: I shall laud you with all my heart. In front of other gods I shall make melody to you.

16342.label: Psalms 138:2
16342.text: I shall bow down toward your holy temple, And I shall laud your name, Because of your loving-kindness and because of your trueness. For you have magnified your saying even above all your name.

16343.label: Psalms 138:3
16343.text: On the day that I called, you also proceeded to answer me; You began to make me bold in my soul with strength.

16344.label: Psalms 138:4
16344.text: All the kings of the earth will laud you, O Jehovah, For they will have heard the sayings of your mouth.

16345.label: Psalms 138:5
16345.text: And they will sing about the ways of Jehovah, For the glory of Jehovah is great.

16346.label: Psalms 138:6
16346.text: For Jehovah is high, and yet the humble one he sees; But the lofty one he knows only from a distance.

16347.label: Psalms 138:7
16347.text: If I should walk in the midst of distress, you will preserve me alive. Because of the anger of my enemies you will thrust out your hand, And your right hand will save me.

16348.label: Psalms 138:8
16348.text: Jehovah himself will complete what is in my behalf. O Jehovah, to time indefinite is your loving-kindness. Do not desert the works of your own hands.

16350.label: Psalms 139:1
16350.text: O Jehovah, you have searched through me, and you know [me].

16351.label: Psalms 139:2
16351.text: You yourself have come to know my sitting down and my rising up. You have considered my thought from far off.

16352.label: Psalms 139:3
16352.text: My journeying and my lying outstretched you have measured off, And you have become familiar even with all my ways.

16353.label: Psalms 139:4
16353.text: For there is not a word on my tongue, But, look! O Jehovah, you already know it all.

16354.label: Psalms 139:5
16354.text: Behind and before, you have besieged me;And you place your hand upon me.

16355.label: Psalms 139:6
16355.text: [Such] knowledge is too wonderful for me. It is so high up that I cannot attain to it.

16356.label: Psalms 139:7
16356.text: Where can I go from your spirit, And where can I run away from your face?

16357.label: Psalms 139:8
16357.text: If I should ascend to heaven, there you would be; And if I should spread out my couch in Sheʹol, look! you [would be there].

16358.label: Psalms 139:9
16358.text: Were I to take the wings of the dawn,That I might reside in the most remote sea,

16359.label: Psalms 139:10
16359.text: There, also, your own hand would lead me And your right hand would lay hold of me.

16360.label: Psalms 139:11
16360.text: And were I to say: “Surely darkness itself will hastily seize me!” Then night would be light about me.

16361.label: Psalms 139:12
16361.text: Even the darkness itself would not prove too dark for you, But night itself would shine just as the day does; The darkness might just as well be the light.

16362.label: Psalms 139:13
16362.text: For you yourself produced my kidneys; You kept me screened off in the belly of my mother.

16363.label: Psalms 139:14
16363.text: I shall laud you because in a fear-inspiring way I am wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful, As my soul is very well aware.

16364.label: Psalms 139:15
16364.text: My bones were not hidden from you When I was made in secret, When I was woven in the lowest parts of the earth.

16365.label: Psalms 139:16
16365.text: Your eyes saw even the embryo of me, And in your book all its parts were down in writing,As regards the days when they were formed And there was not yet one among them.

16366.label: Psalms 139:17
16366.text: So, to me how precious your thoughts are! O God, how much does the grand sum of them amount to!

16367.label: Psalms 139:18
16367.text: Were I to try to count them, they are more than even the grains of sand. I have awaked, and yet I am still with you.

16368.label: Psalms 139:19
16368.text: O that you, O God, would slay the wicked one! Then even the bloodguilty men will certainly depart from me,

16369.label: Psalms 139:20
16369.text: Who say things about you according to [their] idea; They have taken up [your name] in a worthless way —your adversaries.

16370.label: Psalms 139:21
16370.text: Do I not hate those who are intensely hating you, O Jehovah, And do I not feel a loathing for those revolting against you?

16371.label: Psalms 139:22
16371.text: With a complete hatred I do hate them. They have become to me real enemies.

16372.label: Psalms 139:23
16372.text: Search through me, O God, and know my heart. Examine me, and know my disquieting thoughts,

16373.label: Psalms 139:24
16373.text: And see whether there is in me any painful way, And lead me in the way of time indefinite.

16375.label: Psalms 140:1
16375.text: Rescue me, O Jehovah, from bad men; May you safeguard me even from the man of deeds of violence,

16376.label: Psalms 140:2
16376.text: Those who have schemed bad things in [their] heart, Who all day long keep attacking as in wars.

16377.label: Psalms 140:3
16377.text: They have sharpened their tongue like that of a serpent; The venom of the horned viper is under their lips. Seʹlah.

16378.label: Psalms 140:4
16378.text: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked one; May you safeguard me even from the man of deeds of violence, Those who have schemed to push my steps.

16379.label: Psalms 140:5
16379.text: The self-exalted ones have hidden a trap for me; And ropes they have spread out as a net at the side of the track. Snares they have set for me. Seʹlah.

16380.label: Psalms 140:6
16380.text: I have said to Jehovah: “You are my God. Do give ear, O Jehovah, to the voice of my entreaties.”

16381.label: Psalms 140:7
16381.text: O Jehovah the Sovereign Lord, the strength of my salvation, You have screened over my head in the day of the armed force.

16382.label: Psalms 140:8
16382.text: Do not grant, O Jehovah, the cravings of the wicked one. Do not promote his plotting, that they may not be exalted. Seʹlah.

16383.label: Psalms 140:9
16383.text: As for the heads of those surrounding me, May the trouble of their own lips cover them.

16384.label: Psalms 140:10
16384.text: May burning coals be dropped upon them. Let them be made to fall into the fire, into watery pits, that they may not get up.

16385.label: Psalms 140:11
16385.text: The big talker —let him not be firmly established in the earth. The man of violence—let evil itself hunt him with repeated thrusts.

16386.label: Psalms 140:12
16386.text: I well know that Jehovah will execute The legal claim of the afflicted one, the judgment of the poor ones.

16387.label: Psalms 140:13
16387.text: Surely the righteous themselves will give thanks to your name; The upright ones will dwell before your face.

16389.label: Psalms 141:1
16389.text: O Jehovah, I have called upon you. Do make haste to me. Do give ear to my voice when I call to you.

16390.label: Psalms 141:2
16390.text: May my prayer be prepared as incense before you, The raising up of my palms as the evening grain offering.

16391.label: Psalms 141:3
16391.text: Do set a guard, O Jehovah, for my mouth; Do set a watch over the door of my lips.

16392.label: Psalms 141:4
16392.text: Do not incline my heart to anything bad, So as to carry on notorious deeds in wickedness With men who are practicing what is hurtful, That I may not feed myself on their dainties.

16393.label: Psalms 141:5
16393.text: Should the righteous one strike me, it would be a loving-kindness; And should he reprove me, it would be oil upon the head, Which my head would not want to refuse. For still there would be even my prayer during their calamities.

16394.label: Psalms 141:6
16394.text: Their judges have been thrown down by the sides of the crag, But they have heard my sayings, that they are pleasant.

16395.label: Psalms 141:7
16395.text: As when one is doing cleaving and splitting on the earth,Our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheʹol.

16396.label: Psalms 141:8
16396.text: However, my eyes are to you, O Jehovah the Sovereign Lord. In you I have taken refuge. Do not pour out my soul.

16397.label: Psalms 141:9
16397.text: Keep me from the clutches of the trap that they have laid for me And from the snares of those practicing what is hurtful.

16398.label: Psalms 141:10
16398.text: The wicked will fall into their own nets all together, While I, for my part, pass by.

16400.label: Psalms 142:1
16400.text: With my voice, to Jehovah I proceeded to call for aid; With my voice, to Jehovah I began to cry for favor.

16401.label: Psalms 142:2
16401.text: Before him I kept pouring out my concern; Before him I continued to tell about my own distress,

16402.label: Psalms 142:3
16402.text: When my spirit fainted away within me.Then you yourself knew my roadway. In the path in which I walk They have hidden a trap for me.

16403.label: Psalms 142:4
16403.text: Look to the right hand and seeThat there is no one giving any recognition to me. My place for flight has perished from me; There is no one inquiring for my soul.

16404.label: Psalms 142:5
16404.text: I called to you, O Jehovah, for aid. I said: “You are my refuge, My share in the land of the living ones.”

16405.label: Psalms 142:6
16405.text: Do pay attention to my entreating cry, For I have become very much impoverished. Deliver me from my persecutors, For they are stronger than I am.

16406.label: Psalms 142:7
16406.text: Do bring my soul out of the very dungeon To laud your name. Around me let the righteous ones gather, Because you deal appropriately with me.

16408.label: Psalms 143:1
16408.text: O Jehovah, hear my prayer; Do give ear to my entreaty. In your faithfulness answer me in your righteousness.

16409.label: Psalms 143:2
16409.text: And do not enter into judgment with your servant; For before you no one alive can be righteous.

16410.label: Psalms 143:3
16410.text: For the enemy has pursued my soul; He has crushed my life to the very earth. He has caused me to dwell in dark places like those dead for time indefinite.

16411.label: Psalms 143:4
16411.text: And my spirit faints away within me;In the midst of me my heart shows itself numbed.

16412.label: Psalms 143:5
16412.text: I have remembered days of long ago; I have meditated on all your activity; I willingly kept myself concerned with the work of your own hands.

16413.label: Psalms 143:6
16413.text: I have spread out my hands to you; My soul is like an exhausted land to you. Seʹlah.

16414.label: Psalms 143:7
16414.text: O hurry, answer me, O Jehovah. My spirit has come to an end. Do not conceal your face from me, Or else I must become comparable with those going down into the pit.

16415.label: Psalms 143:8
16415.text: In the morning cause me to hear your loving-kindness, For in you I have put my trust. Make known to me the way in which I should walk, For to you I have lifted up my soul.

16416.label: Psalms 143:9
16416.text: Deliver me from my enemies, O Jehovah. I have taken cover even with you.

16417.label: Psalms 143:10
16417.text: Teach me to do your will, For you are my God. Your spirit is good; May it lead me in the land of uprightness.

16418.label: Psalms 143:11
16418.text: For the sake of your name, O Jehovah, may you preserve me alive. In your righteousness may you bring forth my soul out of distress.

16419.label: Psalms 143:12
16419.text: And in your loving-kindness may you silence my enemies; And you must destroy all those showing hostility to my soul, For I am your servant.

16421.label: Psalms 144:1
16421.text: Blessed be Jehovah my Rock, Who is teaching my hands for fighting, My fingers for warfare;

16422.label: Psalms 144:2
16422.text: My loving-kindness and my stronghold, My secure height and my Provider of escape for me, My shield and the One in whom I have taken refuge, The One subduing peoples under me.

16423.label: Psalms 144:3
16423.text: O Jehovah, what is man that you should notice him, The son of mortal man that you should take account of him?

16424.label: Psalms 144:4
16424.text: Man himself bears resemblance to a mere exhalation; His days are like a passing shadow.

16425.label: Psalms 144:5
16425.text: O Jehovah, bend down your heavens that you may descend; Touch the mountains that they may smoke.

16426.label: Psalms 144:6
16426.text: Lighten with lightning that you may scatter them; Send out your arrows that you may throw them into confusion.

16427.label: Psalms 144:7
16427.text: Thrust your hands out from the height; Set me free and deliver me from the many waters, From the hand of the foreigners,

16428.label: Psalms 144:8
16428.text: Whose mouth has spoken what is untrue And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

16429.label: Psalms 144:9
16429.text: O God, a new song I will sing to you. On an instrument of ten strings I will make melody to you,

16430.label: Psalms 144:10
16430.text: The One giving salvation to kings, The One setting David his servant free from the injurious sword.

16431.label: Psalms 144:11
16431.text: Set me free and deliver me from the hand of the foreigners, Whose mouth has spoken what is untrue And whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood,

16432.label: Psalms 144:12
16432.text: Who [say]: “Our sons are like little plants grown up in their youth, Our daughters like corners carved in palace style,

16433.label: Psalms 144:13
16433.text: Our garners full, furnishing products of one sort after another, Our flocks multiplying by thousands, ten thousand to one, in our streets,

16434.label: Psalms 144:14
16434.text: Our cattle loaded down, without any rupture and with no abortion, And with no outcry in our public squares.

16435.label: Psalms 144:15
16435.text: Happy is the people for whom it is just like [that]!”Happy is the people whose God is Jehovah!

16437.label: Psalms 145:1
16437.text: I will exalt you, O my God the King, And I will bless your name to time indefinite, even forever.

16438.label: Psalms 145:2
16438.text: All day long I will bless you, And I will praise your name to time indefinite, even forever.

16439.label: Psalms 145:3
16439.text: Jehovah is great and very much to be praised, And his greatness is unsearchable.

16440.label: Psalms 145:4
16440.text: Generation after generation will commend your works, And about your mighty acts they will tell.

16441.label: Psalms 145:5
16441.text: The glorious splendor of your dignity And the matters of your wonderful works I will make my concern.

16442.label: Psalms 145:6
16442.text: And they will talk about the strength of your own fear-inspiring things; And as for your greatness, I will declare it.

16443.label: Psalms 145:7
16443.text: With the mention of the abundance of your goodness they will bubble over, And [because of] your righteousness they will cry out joyfully.

16444.label: Psalms 145:8
16444.text: Jehovah is gracious and merciful, Slow to anger and great in loving-kindness.

16445.label: Psalms 145:9
16445.text: Jehovah is good to all, And his mercies are over all his works.

16446.label: Psalms 145:10
16446.text: All your works will laud you, O Jehovah, And your loyal ones will bless you.

16447.label: Psalms 145:11
16447.text: About the glory of your kingship they will talk, And about your mightiness they will speak,

16448.label: Psalms 145:12
16448.text: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts And the glory of the splendor of his kingship.

16449.label: Psalms 145:13
16449.text: Your kingship is a kingship for all times indefinite, And your dominion is throughout all successive generations.

16450.label: Psalms 145:14
16450.text: Jehovah is giving support to all who are falling, And is raising up all who are bowed down.

16451.label: Psalms 145:15
16451.text: To you the eyes of all look hopefully, And you are giving them their food in its season.

16452.label: Psalms 145:16
16452.text: You are opening your hand And satisfying the desire of every living thing.

16453.label: Psalms 145:17
16453.text: Jehovah is righteous in all his ways And loyal in all his works.

16454.label: Psalms 145:18
16454.text: Jehovah is near to all those calling upon him, To all those who call upon him in trueness.

16455.label: Psalms 145:19
16455.text: The desire of those fearing him he will perform, And their cry for help he will hear, and he will save them.

16456.label: Psalms 145:20
16456.text: Jehovah is guarding all those loving him, But all the wicked ones he will annihilate.

16457.label: Psalms 145:21
16457.text: The praise of Jehovah my mouth will speak; And let all flesh bless his holy name to time indefinite, even forever.

16458.label: Psalms 146:1
16458.text: Praise Jah, YOU people! Praise Jehovah, O my soul.

16459.label: Psalms 146:2
16459.text: I will praise Jehovah during my lifetime. I will make melody to my God as long as I am.

16460.label: Psalms 146:3
16460.text: Do not put YOUR trust in nobles, Nor in the son of earthling man, to whom no salvation belongs.

16461.label: Psalms 146:4
16461.text: His spirit goes out, he goes back to his ground; In that day his thoughts do perish.

16462.label: Psalms 146:5
16462.text: Happy is the one who has the God of Jacob for his help, Whose hope is in Jehovah his God,

16463.label: Psalms 146:6
16463.text: The Maker of heaven and earth, Of the sea, and of all that is in them, The One keeping trueness to time indefinite,

16464.label: Psalms 146:7
16464.text: The One executing judgment for the defrauded ones, The One giving bread to the hungry ones. Jehovah is releasing those who are bound.

16465.label: Psalms 146:8
16465.text: Jehovah is opening [the eyes of] the blind ones; Jehovah is raising up the ones bowed down; Jehovah is loving the righteous ones.

16466.label: Psalms 146:9
16466.text: Jehovah is guarding the alien residents; The fatherless boy and the widow he relieves, But the way of the wicked ones he makes crooked.

16467.label: Psalms 146:10
16467.text: Jehovah will be king to time indefinite, Your God, O Zion, for generation after generation. Praise Jah, YOU people!

16468.label: Psalms 147:1
16468.text: Praise Jah, YOU people, For it is good to make melody to our God; For it is pleasant—praise is fitting.

16469.label: Psalms 147:2
16469.text: Jehovah is building Jerusalem; The dispersed ones of Israel he brings together.

16470.label: Psalms 147:3
16470.text: He is healing the brokenhearted ones, And is binding up their painful spots.

16471.label: Psalms 147:4
16471.text: He is counting the number of the stars; All of them he calls by [their] names.

16472.label: Psalms 147:5
16472.text: Our Lord is great and is abundant in power; His understanding is beyond recounting.

16473.label: Psalms 147:6
16473.text: Jehovah is relieving the meek ones; He is abasing the wicked ones to the earth.

16474.label: Psalms 147:7
16474.text: Respond to Jehovah with thanksgiving, YOU people; Make melody to our God on the harp,

16475.label: Psalms 147:8
16475.text: The One who is covering the heavens with clouds, The One preparing rain for the earth, The One making the mountains to sprout green grass.

16476.label: Psalms 147:9
16476.text: To the beasts he is giving their food, To the young ravens that keep calling.

16477.label: Psalms 147:10
16477.text: Not in the mightiness of the horse does he take delight, Nor in the legs of the man does he find pleasure.

16478.label: Psalms 147:11
16478.text: Jehovah is finding pleasure in those fearing him, In those waiting for his loving-kindness.

16479.label: Psalms 147:12
16479.text: Commend Jehovah, O Jerusalem.Praise your God, O Zion.

16480.label: Psalms 147:13
16480.text: For he has made the bars of your gates strong;He has blessed your sons in the midst of you.

16481.label: Psalms 147:14
16481.text: He is putting peace in your territory; With the fat of the wheat he keeps satisfying you.

16482.label: Psalms 147:15
16482.text: He is sending his saying to the earth; With speed his word runs.

16483.label: Psalms 147:16
16483.text: He is giving snow like wool; Hoarfrost he scatters just like ashes.

16484.label: Psalms 147:17
16484.text: He is throwing his ice like morsels. Before his cold who can stand?

16485.label: Psalms 147:18
16485.text: He sends forth his word and melts them.He causes his wind to blow; The waters trickle.

16486.label: Psalms 147:19
16486.text: He is telling his word to Jacob, His regulations and his judicial decisions to Israel.

16487.label: Psalms 147:20
16487.text: He has not done that way to any other nation; And as for [his] judicial decisions, they have not known them. Praise Jah, YOU people!

16488.label: Psalms 148:1
16488.text: Praise Jah, YOU people! Praise Jehovah from the heavens, Praise him in the heights.

16489.label: Psalms 148:2
16489.text: Praise him, all YOU his angels. Praise him, all YOU his army.

16490.label: Psalms 148:3
16490.text: Praise him, YOU sun and moon. Praise him, all YOU stars of light.

16491.label: Psalms 148:4
16491.text: Praise him, YOU heavens of the heavens, And YOU waters that are above the heavens.

16492.label: Psalms 148:5
16492.text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah; For he himself commanded, and they were created.

16493.label: Psalms 148:6
16493.text: And he keeps them standing forever, to time indefinite. A regulation he has given, and it will not pass away.

16494.label: Psalms 148:7
16494.text: Praise Jehovah from the earth, YOU sea monsters and all YOU watery deeps,

16495.label: Psalms 148:8
16495.text: YOU fire and hail, snow and thick smoke, You tempestuous wind, accomplishing his word,

16496.label: Psalms 148:9
16496.text: YOU mountains and all YOU hills, YOU fruit trees and all YOU cedars,

16497.label: Psalms 148:10
16497.text: YOU wild animals and all YOU domestic animals, YOU creeping things and winged birds,

16498.label: Psalms 148:11
16498.text: YOU kings of the earth and all YOU national groups,YOU princes and all YOU judges of the earth,

16499.label: Psalms 148:12
16499.text: YOU young men and also YOU virgins, YOU old men together with boys.

16500.label: Psalms 148:13
16500.text: Let them praise the name of Jehovah, For his name alone is unreachably high. His dignity is above earth and heaven.

16501.label: Psalms 148:14
16501.text: And he will exalt the horn of his people, The praise of all his loyal ones, Of the sons of Israel, the people near to him. Praise Jah, YOU people!

16502.label: Psalms 149:1
16502.text: Praise Jah, YOU people! Sing to Jehovah a new song, His praise in the congregation of loyal ones.

16503.label: Psalms 149:2
16503.text: Let Israel rejoice in its grand Maker, The sons of Zion—let them be joyful in their King.

16504.label: Psalms 149:3
16504.text: Let them praise his name with dancing. With the tambourine and the harp let them make melody to him.

16505.label: Psalms 149:4
16505.text: For Jehovah is taking pleasure in his people. He beautifies the meek ones with salvation.

16506.label: Psalms 149:5
16506.text: Let the loyal ones exult in glory; Let them cry out joyfully on their beds.

16507.label: Psalms 149:6
16507.text: Let the songs extolling God be in their throat, And a two-edged sword be in their hand,

16508.label: Psalms 149:7
16508.text: To execute vengeance upon the nations, Rebukes upon the national groups,

16509.label: Psalms 149:8
16509.text: To bind their kings with shackles And their glorified ones with fetters of iron,

16510.label: Psalms 149:9
16510.text: To execute upon them the judicial decision written. Such splendor belongs to all his loyal ones. Praise Jah, YOU people!

16511.label: Psalms 150:1
16511.text: Praise Jah, YOU people! Praise God in his holy place. Praise him in the expanse of his strength.

16512.label: Psalms 150:2
16512.text: Praise him for his works of mightiness. Praise him according to the abundance of his greatness.

16513.label: Psalms 150:3
16513.text: Praise him with the blowing of the horn. Praise him with the stringed instrument and the harp.

16514.label: Psalms 150:4
16514.text: Praise him with the tambourine and the circle dance. Praise him with strings and the pipe.

16515.label: Psalms 150:5
16515.text: Praise him with the cymbals of melodious sound. Praise him with the clashing cymbals.

16516.label: Psalms 150:6
16516.text: Every breathing thing —let it praise Jah. Praise Jah, YOU people!
